name: Uttarakhand Uncovered | From Spiritual Heights to Nature Delights
description:
`Embark on a soul-stirring journey through the heart of Devbhoomi with our 'Uttarakhand Uncovered' package. Spanning 4 Nights and 5 Days, this curated itinerary seamlessly blends deep spirituality with raw natural beauty.

Begin your journey absorbing the sacred evening Ganga Aarti in Haridwar, before heading high into the Garhwal Himalayas to Joshimath—the gateway to Auli and Badrinath—where you will spend two days surrounded by majestic, snow-capped peaks. Wind down your adventure in the yoga capital of Rishikesh, exploring vibrant cafes and iconic suspension bridges, before concluding your memorable circuit back in Delhi. Perfect for travelers seeking a profound mountain escape filled with culture, peace, and unparalleled Himalayan views.`
shortDescription: A perfect 4N/5D blend of spiritual bliss in Haridwar & Rishikesh and majestic mountain landscapes in Joshimath.
highlights: 1 night stay in Haridwar with breakfast
2 nights stay in Joshimath with breakfast
1 night stay in Rishikesh with breakfast

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi | Transfer to Haridwar | Trip to Ganga Temple and Har Ki Pauri Ghat
itinerary.description: Welcome to Delhi! From Majnu-ka-tilla/Kashmere Gate, get driven to Haridwar. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to the hotel. After you check in, relax for some time. Later, get driven to Ganga Temple, known for its beautiful architecture set against the backdrop of the holy Ganga River. Next, visit the iconic Har ki Pauri ghat, one of India's most sacred ghats, where you can witness the holy Ganga Aarti in the evening. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Alpen Rose

itinerary.title: Haridwar Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Joshimath
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel & get driven to explore Haridwar. Begin by getting dropped at the parking space of Mansa & Chanda Devi Temple. From there, head to the cable car counter to take the ropeway ride up to the temple. Continue your temple tour with a visit to the Daksheshwar Mahadev Temple, a Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva & the Vaishno Devi Temple, a replica of the famous Vaishno Devi Temple in Jammu. Afterwards, continue the journey to Joshimath. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Devas Retreat

itinerary.title: Gorsan Bugyal Hike with Cable Car
itinerary.description: In the morning, get driven to Joshimath Ropeway Station and take the gondola (tickets not included) for a scenic 25-minute ride up to Auli, offering stunning views of the landscape. Upon arrival in Auli, embark on a 4-km hike from the Auli Cable Car Station to Gorson Bugyal, a renowned skiing destination, and enjoy the breathtaking vistas of lush meadows and snow-capped peaks. Afterward, return to Joshimath Ropeway Station. From there, you'll be transferred back to the hotel for overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Devas Retreat

itinerary.title: Transfer to Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Post check out from your hotel, board your transfer to Rishikesh. Along the way, enjoy scenic mountain views. Upon arrival, check into your hotel. Later, you can take a relaxing stroll near Ganga river. You can also explore the bustling local markets or unwind at a riverside café with stunning sunset views.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Trihari

itinerary.title: Half Day Rishikesh Sightseeing | Departure to Delhi
itinerary.description: Post check-out, get driven for a half-day tour of Rishikesh. After getting dropped-off at the parking space near Lakshman Jhula, take a local transport on your own to reach Triveni Ghat, where you can watch Ganga Arti. Next, admire the views of the Ganges River at Ram Jhula, followed by a visit to Shivanand Ashram for a glimpse into yoga practices. Explore Parmarth Niketan & conclude at Geeta Bhawan, a center for Hindu teachings. Afterward, get driven to Delhi. This marks the end of your trip.

name: Uttarakhand Couple Tour | A Romantic Escape
description:
Celebrate your love amidst the breathtaking landscapes of the Himalayas with our specially crafted 'Romantic Escape' package. Designed for couples seeking both serenity and adventure, this 5 Nights, 6 Days journey offers the perfect mountain backdrop for unforgettable memories.

Begin your romantic getaway in the misty, colonial lanes of Mussoorie, enjoying quiet walks and stunning valley views. From there, head high into the mountains to Joshimath for two days of pristine snow-peak vistas, perfect for cozy evening stays. Wrap up your beautiful journey by spending your final days exploring the vibrant cafes, tranquil riverbanks, and evening aartis of Rishikesh before returning to Delhi. It's an idyllic blend of luxury, romance, and scenic mountain beauty.
shortDescription: A dream 5N/6D romantic getaway blending the mist-covered hills of Mussoorie, mountain magic in Joshimath, and riverside serenity in Rishikesh.
highlights: Discover Mussoorie's hillside charm, Rishikesh's spiritual retreats, and Joshimath's sacred pilgrimage sites amid the breathtaking Himalayan scenery.
Hike to Gorson Bugyal in Auli, a pristine alpine meadow offering scenic views of the Himalayas, and experience the natural beauty of the region.
Explore Clouds End in Mussoorie, where the mountains stretch to touch the sky, providing peaceful views of the Himalayas.
Ascend to Lal Tibba in Mussoorie with your partner for unparalleled views of the Himalayas, where the majestic mountain range unfolds in stunning panorama.
Cross the iconic Ram Jhula in Rishikesh with your partner, and soak in the serene views of the sacred river and vibrant cityscape.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi | Transfer to Mussoorie | Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Delhi! Upon arrival at Majnu ka Tilla, get driven to Mussoorie. Once there, check into your hotel and explore the city on your own. You can visit Shedup Choepelling Temple and explore Tibetan Buddhist traditions amidst serene surroundings. You can also explore Library Bazaar, offering a delightful mix of local shops, cafes, and bookstores. Afterward, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: HOTEL WILD WOOD

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Post check out, explore Mussoorie with getting driven to the majestic Kempty Falls, where pristine waters cascade amidst lush greenery. Ascend Gun Hill via cable car for stunning Himalayan. Next, enjoy a peaceful stroll through Company Garden's colorful blooms & discover the vibrant Mall Road's shops. Then, visit Lal Tibba for snow-capped peaks and relax at Clouds End. Later, walk Camel's Back Road, before getting transferred to your hotel in Rishikesh. Check in and rest for the night.
itinerary.accommodation: Arctic Hills By Opulence Hotels - Rishikesh

itinerary.title: Transfer to Joshimath
itinerary.description: Post check out from your hotel, board your transfer to Joshimath. Along the way, marvel at the majestic mountains. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and rest for the night.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Auli D

itinerary.title: Gorsan Bugyal Hike with Cable Car
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to Joshimath Ropeway Station, and hop on the gondola to reach Auli (tickets not included). This 25-minute ride offers a aerial perspective of the rugged terrain below. Upon arrival in Auli, start your 4-kms hike from the Auli Cable Car Station to Gorson Bugyal, a famous skiing spot. Enjoy its lush greenery and panoramic views of towering peaks. Return to Joshimath Ropeway Station & board your transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Auli D

itinerary.title: Transfer to Rishikesh
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from your hotel and board your transfer to Rishikesh. En route, enjoy panoramic views of the mountains. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and you can take a leisurely stroll, or rest for the night.
itinerary.accommodation: Arctic Hills By Opulence Hotels - Rishikesh

itinerary.title: Half Day Rishikesh Sightseeing | Departure to Delhi
itinerary.description: Post check out, get driven for a half day sightseeing tour of Rishikesh. Begin at the iconic Ram Jhula, where you can marvel at panoramic views of the Ganges River. Next, explore the serene Shivanand Ashram, a center for yoga and meditation. Then, visit Parmarth Niketan, famous for its spiritual practices. End your tour at Geeta Bhawan, dedicated to Hindu religious studies and scriptures. Later, board your transfer to Delhi. Upon arrival at Majnu ka Tilla, continue your journey forward.

name: Uttarakhand Couple Special | Trail from Mountains to Meadows
description:
Experience the ultimate romantic journey through Devbhoomi with our grand 7 Nights, 8 Days 'Trail from Mountains to Meadows' luxury couple's itinerary. Carefully paced for couples, this long getaway offers a deep dive into Uttarakhand's most iconic landscapes.

Begin your romance with two peaceful days in the misty hills of Mussoorie and a scenic stop in Dehradun. Move down to the sacred town of Haridwar to witness the stunning evening Ganga Aarti together. The adventure heightens as you spend two thrilling days inside the wilderness of Jim Corbett National Park, enjoying open-jeep safaris and cozy forest resort stays. Conclude your dream vacation with two romantic nights in Nainital, boating on the emerald Naini Lake and walking along the vibrant Mall Road. It is the perfect blend of luxury, wildlife thrill, mountain peace, and timeless memories.
shortDescription: A grand 7N/8D romantic escape covering the mist of Mussoorie, wildlife safaris in Jim Corbett, serene lakes of Nainital, and the spiritual aura of Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dehradun | Transfer to Mussoorie | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Welcome to Uttarakhand! Upon arrival at Delhi/Dehradun airport or railway station, meet your private chauffeur and head towards Dehradun. Explore the beautiful Sahastradhara waterfalls and Robber's Cave (Guchhupani). Later, drive up through winding mountain roads to the charming hill station of Mussoorie. Check into your hotel, unwind, and spend a cozy evening exploring the vibrant Mall Road hand-in-hand.
itinerary.accommodation: Silver by La Casa

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Local Sightseeing & Leisure
itinerary.description: Wake up to a beautiful misty morning in the Queen of Hills. After a delicious breakfast, head out for a full day of romantic sightseeing. Visit the famous Kempty Falls, where you can enjoy the refreshing cascading waters. Later, head to Gun Hill point via a scenic cable car ride for panoramic views of the Doon Valley and snow-capped Himalayan peaks. Conclude your day with a peaceful walk along the scenic Camel's Back Road.
itinerary.accommodation: Silver by La Casa

itinerary.title: Mussoorie to Haridwar | Trip to Ganga Temple & Har Ki Pauri Ghat
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and drive towards the holy city of Haridwar. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and relax. In the late afternoon, proceed to the sacred ghat of Har Ki Pauri. Witness the world-famous, soul-stirring evening Maha Ganga Aarti together. The sight of thousands of floating diyas reflecting on the sacred river Ganges creates a truly magical and unforgettable memory for couples.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Alpen Rose

itinerary.title: Haridwar Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Jim Corbett
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel and journey towards Haridwar. Begin your day with visits to Chanda Devi Temple and Mansa Devi Temple, accessible via a scenic ropeway ride from the cable car counter after being dropped off at the parking space. Later visit Daksheshwar Mahadev Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, and the Vaishno Devi Temple, a replica of the famous shrine in Jammu. Concluding your day, travel to Joshimath and check into your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Corbett D Resort

itinerary.title: Jungle Safari in Corbett National Park | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Wake up early in the morning for an exciting safari in Corbett National Park. Encounter a variety of wildlife, including leopards, black bears etc. You’ll also have the opportunity to catch a glimpse of the majestic Royal Bengal Tigers in their natural habitat. After the safari, get transferred back to the hotel. Spend some leisure time at the resort or you can indulge in adventure activities such as rock climbing, river rafting, and more.
itinerary.accommodation: Corbett D Resort

itinerary.title: Transfer to Nainital | Trip to Naina Devi Temple and Naini Lake
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from the hotel and get transferred to Nainital. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and relax. Later, visit Naini Lake, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding seven hills. Enjoy a boat ride (extra cost) and capture stunning photographs. Next, explore the famous Naina Devi Temple, believed to be the spot where the eyes of Goddess Sati fell. Afterward, take a stroll along the lively Mall Road, lined with shops, cafes, and local handicrafts before returning back.
itinerary.accommodation: Naina Greens

itinerary.title: Lakes Tour around Nainital
itinerary.description: Begin with a visit to Bhimtal Lake, renowned for its charming island in the middle. You can even opt for a scenic boat ride here with the perfect backdrop of the surrounding hills. Then, visit Naukuchiatal Lake, a nine-cornered lake considered an ideal spot for birdwatching. Conclude your tour at Sattal Lake, a unique cluster of seven interconnected lakes nestled in the forested hills. Admire the picturesque views and capture the rich birdlife before being transferred back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Naina Greens

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Savor your final breakfast overlooking the mountains. Check out from your hotel as your unforgettable 8-day Himalayan journey comes to an end. Your private cab will drive you back to Dehradun/Delhi airport or railway station for your onward journey home, carrying a heart full of beautiful, romantic memories.

name: Uttarakhand Treasures | A Journey Through Sacred Hills & Misty Peaks
description:
Uncover the hidden gems of Devbhoomi with our 'Uttarakhand Treasures' curated travel package. Spanning 4 Nights and 5 Days, this itinerary is beautifully paced to offer a refreshing blend of lively hill stations, tranquil alpine meadows, and deep spiritual vibes.

Begin your journey with two immersive days exploring the colonial charm, panoramic viewpoints, and cascading waterfalls of Mussoorie. Escape the crowds on Day 3 as you head into the peaceful, pine-fringed heights of Dhanaulti, famous for its eco-parks and quiet mountain trails. Conclude your mountain adventure in the world-renowned yoga capital of Rishikesh, taking in the iconic suspension bridges and a soul-stirring evening Ganga Aarti before heading back to Delhi. This package is ideal for weekend explorers, families, and couples looking for a quick yet deeply fulfilling Himalayan retreat.
shortDescription: A refreshing 4N/5D escape featuring the misty waterfalls of Mussoorie, serene alpine forests of Dhanaulti, and the spiritual riversides of Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Transfer from Delhi to Mussoorie | En-route Visit to Robber's Cave & Sahastradhara in Dehradun
itinerary.description: Head to the pickup point in Delhi and board your transfer to Mussoorie. En route, stop in Dehradun to explore Robber's Cave, a natural cave formation known for its unique streams and hidden waterfalls. Next, visit Sahastradhara, famous for its sulphur-rich spring water, believed to have healing properties. Continue your journey to Mussoorie and upon arrival, check in at your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: HOTEL WILD WOOD

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day by getting driven for city sightseeing tour. Visit the Kempty Falls, where you can click stunning photos and take a refreshing retreat amidst lush greenery. Next, head to Gun Hill, the second-highest peak in Mussoorie and enjoy the panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. Later, stroll along the bustling Mall Road, lined with shops, cafes, and local vendors. Afterward, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: HOTEL WILD WOOD

itinerary.title: Transfer to Dhanaulti | Dhanaulti Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Check out & get driven to Dhanaulti. Upon arrival, embark on a city tour. Enjoy a leisurely stroll at the Eco Park & experience the thrill of mountain activities at Dhanaulti Adventure Park. Visit the sacred Surkanda Devi Temple, perched at 2,757 meters, offering panoramic views of the valleys below. End your tour with a visit to the Kaudia Forest, a picturesque spot perfect for birdwatching and photography. Later, check in to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: The Green Valley Resorts

itinerary.title: Transfer to Rishikesh | En route Visit to Tehri Dam
itinerary.description: Check out & get driven to Rishikesh. En route, stop at the Tehri Dam, a marvel of modern engineering built on the Bhagirathi River. Explore its vast reservoir and learn about the dam's construction. While at the reservoir, you can indulge in exciting water sports such as jet skiing, kayaking, and paddleboarding (available at an additional cost). Afterward, continue your journey to Rishikesh. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Enjoy your time at Leisure or Fill up your day with some of the highly recommended experiences.
Paragliding , Jet Skiing, Banana Boat Ride  experience water Sports at tehri dam (By own expence)
itinerary.accommodation: Arctic Hills By Opulence Hotels - Rishikesh

itinerary.title: Rishikesh Sightseeing Tour | Depature from Rishikesh to Delhi
itinerary.description: Post check-out, get driven for a Rishikesh sightseeing tour. Visit the iconic Ram Jhula, a suspension bridge offering stunning views of the Ganges. Explore the Shivanand Ashram, where you can delve into spiritual practices and visit Parmarth Niketan, famous for its evening Ganga Aarti. Later, explore other sites such as Geeta Bhawan & Triveni Ghat. Afterward, get driven to Delhi and upon arrival, make your way home on your own, carrying memories of your trip.

name: Best of Uttarakhand | Spiritual Heaven and Wildlife Treasures
description:
Discover the absolute highlights of Devbhoomi with our classic 'Best of Uttarakhand' holiday circuit. Perfectly optimized as a hassle-free 4 Nights and 5 Days private Delhi-to-Delhi road trip, this itinerary offers an incredible introduction to the region's diverse landscapes.

Your journey begins along the sacred banks of the Ganges in Rishikesh, where you can explore vibrant cafes, suspension bridges, and peaceful river ghats. Next, travel up into the pristine Kumaon hills to spend two beautiful days in Nainital, taking in scenic panoramic mountain viewpoints and enjoying relaxing boat rides on Naini Lake. The adventure finishes with a thrill as you enter the dense wilderness of Jim Corbett National Park for an unforgettable stay at a jungle resort and an exciting open-jeep wildlife safari. Returning directly back to Delhi, this private tour provides a seamless vacation tailored perfectly for families, friend groups, and corporate getaways.
shortDescription: A seamless 4N/5D Delhi-to-Delhi loop featuring peaceful river ghats in Rishikesh, scenic lake boating in Nainital, and thrilling tiger safaris in Jim Corbett.
highlights: Discover the peaceful and spiritual atmosphere of Rishikesh, where people come to find peace and enlightenment in the Himalayan foothills.
Witness the holy Ganga Aarti in Rishikesh, set against the backdrop of the sacred Ganges River, offering a soul-soothing experience.
Enjoy a wildlife safari through Jim Corbett National Park, India's oldest national park, known for its rich biodiversity.
Relax at a handpicked premium nature resort near the wilderness of Jim Corbett.

itinerary.title: Transfer from Delhi to Rishikesh | Rishikesh Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Board your transfer from Delhi to Rishikesh. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and start your sightseeing tour. First, you will be taken to visit Ram Jhula, where you can stroll across the bridge while enjoying the surrounding views. Then, visit Shivanand Ashram, where you can participate in calming yoga sessions followed by Geeta Bhawan, where you will gain insights into ancient Hindu scriptures. Lastly, visit Triveni Ghat to witness the Ganga Aarti before being driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Arctic Hills By Opulence Hotels - Rishikesh / Similer

itinerary.title: Transfer from Rishikesh to Nainital | Welcome to the 'City of Lakes'
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll check out from your hotel and will be taken to Nainital. Enjoy the scenic journey through hills and valleys. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax briefly before getting driven to the heart of Nainital - the Naini Lake where you can soak in the stunning views of the seven hills. Then, visit the historic Naina Devi Temple, believed to mark the spot where the eyes of Goddess Sati fell. Lastly, visit Mall Road for shopping and local delights before getting back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Dynasty Resort / Similer

itinerary.title: Half Day Nainital Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Today, you'll be transferred to explore the famous sites of Nainital starting Eco Cave Gardens, where you can wander through interconnected caves. then, visit Snow View Point to marvel at the panoramic views of the majestic Himalayan peaks and the Nainital Lake below. Don't miss Tiffin Top, also known as Dorothy's Seat, perfect for capturing photos of the himalayas. Lastly, head to Lover's Point where you can enjoy peaceful moments amidst picturesque landscapes before getting back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Dynasty Resort / Similer

itinerary.title: Transfers from Nainital to Jim Corbett | Drive to the Land of Tigers
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and get driven to Jim Corbett. Upon arrival, check into your hotel. Later, you'll be taken to visit Garjia Devi Temple, beautifully located amidst the river Kosi. Admire the picturesque surroundings of this place before heading to Corbett Waterfall. Take a refreshing dip in the waterfall and capture some pictures. Finally, explore the Jim Corbett Museum to gain insights into his conservation efforts and wildlife encounters before being driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Click Resort, Corbett Tiger Den / Similer

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: In the morning, get ready to be transferred to Delhi after checking out of the hotel. Once you reach Delhi, the trip will come to an end.

name: Delhi To Kedarnath | Group Tour Package
description:
Embark on the ultimate spiritual pilgrimage with our 'Delhi to Kedarnath Group Tour Package'. Perfectly curated across 4 Nights and 5 Days, this fixed-departure group tour is designed for devotees and adventure lovers who want a seamless, high-energy journey to the seat of Lord Shiva.

Depart from Delhi and head straight into the mountains to Guptkashi, your base camp for the pilgrimage. Day 3 brings the ultimate highlight: a breathtaking 16km trek up to the sacred Kedarnath Temple, nestled amidst majestic snow-capped peaks, where you will experience an unforgettable night stay close to the divine shrine. After descending, wind down and celebrate your journey with your group by the holy Ganges in Rishikesh, exploring local cafes and suspension bridges before driving back to Delhi. This tour package includes comfortable group transport, stays, meals, and experienced tour coordinators to guide you every step of the way.
shortDescription: A thrilling 4N/5D spiritual group journey from Delhi to the sacred shrine of Kedarnath, featuring a scenic stop in Rishikesh
highlights: Experience the profound spiritual energy of a night stay near the sacred Kedarnath Temple.
Trek 16 km alongside fellow travelers amidst dramatic, snow-capped Himalayan peaks.
Travel comfortably in a shared traveler bus/coach with a friendly group of like-minded seekers.
Wind down your pilgrimage with river exploration and cafe hopping in the vibrant town of Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi | Transfer to Haridwar | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Today, upon arrival at Majnu-ka-tila/Kashmere Gate, embark on a journey to Haridwar, one of India's holiest cities. Upon reaching Haridwar, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can head out and explore the vibrant lanes filled with handicrafts and spices at Bara Bazar. Also, you can witness the stunning Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri, with diyas lighting up the river or stroll through the garden of Shanti Kunj.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Riverdale / Similer

itinerary.title: Transfer to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: In the morning, after check-out from your hotel in Haridwar, enjoy a scenic drive to Guptkashi, a stunning town nestled amidst the Himalayas. En route, make a stop at Devprayag. Here, witness the sacred confluence of the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda rivers, the point where they merge to form the Ganga. Afterwards, continue your journey, soaking in the beauty of stunning landscapes that unfold along the way. Upon reaching Guptkashi, check into your hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Shri Narayan Residency / Similer

itinerary.title: Transfer to Sonprayag | Trek to Kedarnath
itinerary.description: Post check-out, get driven to Sonprayag. Upon reaching, head to the Government Union taxi stand & take a taxi (at your own cost) to Gaurikund, the starting point of the trek. Begin your trek through the trail, surrounded by stunning views of towering peaks, cascading waterfalls, & river streams. Along the way, climb steps carved into the mountainside while soaking in the Himalayan views. As you reach the temple, soak in its calming atmosphere and pay your respects. Later, settle into your camp.
itinerary.accommodation: GMVN Dormitory Beds , Tent ,Cottages / Similer

itinerary.title: Trek to Gaurikund | Transfer to Rishikesh from Sonprayag
itinerary.description: Today, wake up to the amazing views of the sunrise over the Himalayas and get ready for your downhill trek to Gaurikund. After check-out, begin your descent, retracing back your steps and soaking in the stunning views of the Himalayas. Later, upon reaching Gaurikund, take a taxi (at your own cost) and reach Sonprayag. Once in Sonprayag, board your transfer to Rishikesh—the Yoga Capital of the World. As you reach, check-in to your hotel, relax, and enjoy the stunning atmosphere of this city.
activities: Downhill Trek from Kedarnath to Sonprayag
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Trihari - Rishikesh  / Similer

itinerary.description:
In the morning, you can head out to experience the thrill of rafting through the cold waters of the Ganga. Get transferred to the rafting start point, where you'll face the exhilarating rapids, feeling the cool rush of water as you drift through the river's curves. Afterwards, get driven back to your hotel and check-out. Later, enjoy your journey back to Delhi, marking the end of your amazing trip!

A small, lightweight 20-30L backpack to carry your trek essentials (leave main luggage at base hotel)

name: Sacred Paths of Uttarakhand | From Holy Sites to Heavenly Heights
description:
Embark on an unforgettable 9 Nights, 10 Days grand journey across Devbhoomi with our masterfully curated 'Sacred Paths of Uttarakhand' package. This comprehensive tour is beautifully designed to show your guests the absolute best of the state, seamlessly blending ancient spiritual roots with breathtaking mountain heights and raw wilderness.

Begin with the soul-stirring evening Ganga Aarti in Haridwar and the serene yoga capital of Rishikesh. From there, explore the scenic valleys of Dehradun before spending two crisp, misty days in the colonial hill station of Mussoorie. The adventure heightens as you spend two action-packed days in Jim Corbett National Park enjoying open-jeep tiger safaris, before winding down your epic vacation with two peaceful nights amidst the emerald lakes and vibrant Mall Roads of Nainital. Perfectly paced and completely private, this premium itinerary guarantees an effortless family or group holiday filled with unmatched Himalayan memories.
shortDescription: The ultimate 9N/10D grand circuit: Holy ghats in Haridwar & Rishikesh, misty hills of Mussoorie, wild safaris in Jim Corbett, and romantic lakes in Nainital.
highlights: Witness the spectacular, soul-stirring evening Maha Ganga Aarti at the sacred ghats of Haridwar.
Explore the queen of hill stations, Mussoorie, including Kempty Falls and scenic cable car views.
Enjoy two action-packed days in Jim Corbett with an exciting open-jeep tiger safari into the wild.
Unwind with a romantic boat ride over Naini Lake and explore the beautiful lake districts of Kumaon.
Travel comfortably across hills and valleys in a dedicated, premium private AC vehicle.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi | Transfer to Haridwar | Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to Delhi! Start your journey by getting transferred from Delhi to Haridwar- ‘Gateway to Gods.’ Upon arrival, check in and prepare yourself for a spiritual journey ahead. You will be driven to Chanda Devi, Mansa Devi, and Daksheshwar Mahadev Temple, each offering unique insights into Hindu spirituality and architecture. Next, experience the Ganga Aarti at Har ki Pauri, and conclude with a visit to the Vaishno Devi Temple. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Riverdale

itinerary.title: Transfer to Rishikesh | Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Post check-out, you’ll get transferred from Haridwar to Rishikesh, enjoying scenic views along the way. Upon arrival in Rishikesh, check-in at the hotel and rest for a while. Later, get driven to visit the iconic landmarks like the picturesque Ram Jhula and tranquil Shivanand Ashram. Delve into serenity at Parmarth Niketan and Geeta Bhawan, where spirituality meets cultural richness amidst scenic beauty. Conclude your day with soulful Ganga Aarti and get driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: The Ekawa Ganga by Lawrence Group

itinerary.title: Transfer to Dehradun | Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, check-out of your hotel and drive from Rishikesh to Dehradun, known as the ‘Abode of Drona.’ Upon arrival, check-in and begin your exploration of the city. Start with the refreshing waters of Sahastradhara, followed by a visit to the Robbers Cave, nestled amidst hills. Then, pay homage at the sacred Tapkeshwar Mahadev Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, before admiring the architectural beauty of the Forest Research Institute. Later, get transferred back to your hotel for the overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Grand Legacy

itinerary.title: Transfer to Mussoorie | Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Post check-out from the hotel, get driven from Dehradun to Queen of the Hills, Mussoorie. Upon arrival, check-in and embark on a city sightseeing tour. Begin by visiting the refreshing Kempty Falls, where cascading water amidst lush greenery offers a serene experience. Next, ascend Gun Hill to behold stunning views of the Himalayan range and the Doon Valley. Finally, wander through Mall Road, Mussoorie's bustling hub, filled with vibrant shops. Later, get driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: HOTEL WILD WOOD

itinerary.title: Excursion to Dhanaulti
itinerary.description: Start your day with getting transferred to Dhanaulti, a small hill station nestled in the Garhwal range. Visit Eco Cave Park, where you'll explore natural caves and lush surroundings. Next, venture to Dhanaulti Adventure Park for thrilling activities set amidst picturesque landscapes. Conclude your exploration at Surkanda Devi Temple, and enjoy a scenic cable car ride amidst panoramic views of the Himalayas, offering a serene and spiritually enriching experience. Later, get driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: HOTEL WILD WOOD

itinerary.title: Transfer to Corbett | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Post check-out, you will be driven from Mussoorie to Corbett National Park, home to Bengal Tigers. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend your time at leisure. You can visit Kalagarh Dam, offering scenic views of the surrounding hills, forests, and the Ramganga River. Next, you can visit Sitabani Temple, dedicated to Sita and witness the temple's traditional Kumaoni style architecture. Later, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Corbett D Resort

itinerary.title: Safari at Corbett National Park | Corbett Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, embark on an exciting Corbett safari (safari included) and spot diverse wildlife such as Bengal tigers, leopards, elephants, deer, and numerous bird species in their natural habitats. Next, visit Corbett Museum, dedicated to the life and legacy of Jim Corbett, the renowned conservationist and hunter. Afterward, venture to the serene Corbett Waterfalls, a picturesque spot nestled amidst lush greenery and enjoy a small picnic there. Later, you’ll be driven back to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Jim Corbett Jeep Safari

itinerary.title: Transfer to Nainital | Trip to Naina Devi Temple and Naini Lake
itinerary.description: Post check-out, get driven from Corbett to Nainital, also known as the Lake District of India. Upon arrival, check-in at the hotel and embark on a day trip of the city. Start with a visit to the serene Naina Devi Temple, offering beautiful hill views. Next, enjoy a peaceful boat ride on Naini Lake (at an extra cost), surrounded by lush greenery or simply take a leisurely lakeside stroll. Later, you can shop and dine at Mall Road before getting driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Four Farms Resorts

itinerary.title: Nainital Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to experience the essence of Nainital. Start by exploring the Eco Cave Garden, where you can wander through interconnected caves and discover local wildlife. Next, ascend to Snow View Point for stunning vistas of the majestic Himalayas and visit Tiffin Top for scenic panoramic views of the lake. Finally, cherish a serene moment at Lovers Point, a romantic spot perfect for couples seeking tranquility amidst Nainital's natural beauty and later get driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Four Farms Resorts

itinerary.title: Transfer to Delhi | Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, check-out from your hotel and get transferred from Nainital to Delhi, marking an end to this adventurous journey.

name: Uttarakhand Romantic Odyssey | From Forest Trails to Snowy Tales
description:
Whisk your partner away on an unforgettable mountain escape with our 'Uttarakhand Romantic Odyssey'. Crafted perfectly across 7 Nights and 8 Days, this premium couple's itinerary is designed for partners seeking a beautiful mix of raw wilderness, tranquil lakes, and majestic high-altitude snow views.

Begin your journey in the dense, thrilling jungles of Jim Corbett National Park with a cozy resort stay and an open-jeep wildlife safari. Next, head into the Kumaon hills for two romantic days of lake boating and quiet strolls in Nainital, followed by a peaceful night in Kausani—often called the 'Switzerland of India'—famous for its uninterrupted, spectacular sunset views over the Trishul and Nanda Devi peaks. The romance heightens as you spend two days in the scenic, snow-touched gateway of Joshimath, exploring pristine meadows and taking in sweeping Himalayan vistas. Conclude your dream vacation winding down by the holy banks and vibrant cafes of Rishikesh before driving back. Private, deeply scenic, and perfectly paced, this tour guarantees memories that will last a lifetime.
shortDescription: A magical 7N/8D couple's escape blending dense jungle safaris, peaceful lake boating, and breathtaking snow-peaked Himalayan vistas.
highlights: Immerse yourselves in nature with a cozy resort stay and an exciting open-jeep wildlife safari in Jim Corbett National Park.
Enjoy a romantic, private row-boat ride across the deep emerald waters of Naini Lake in Nainital.
Ride the famous mountain cable car up to Auli from Joshimath to walk through pristine alpine snow trails.
Wind down your romantic journey exploring vibrant local cafes and serene river ghats along the holy Ganges in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Transfer from Delhi to Jim Corbett | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Board your transfer to Jim Corbett from your pickup point in Delhi. Begin your journey through the Himalayas, admiring the stunning views of diverse landscapes. Once you reach Jim Corbett, check in at the hotel and relax for the day. You can enjoy a nature walk to explore the rich flora and fauna of the park and engage in birdwatching to spot a variety of exotic and endemic bird species. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Click Resort, Corbett Tiger Den

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Nainital
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from the hotel and board the transfer for a sightseeing tour of Jim Corbett. Begin with a visit to the stunning Corbett Waterfall. Next, explore the Corbett Museum, dedicated to the life and legacy of Jim Corbett, where you’ll learn about his contributions to wildlife conservation. Afterward, visit the Garjiya Devi Temple, one of the holiest places in the Kumaon region. Later, continue your journey to Nainital and upon arrival, check in at the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Dynasty Resort

itinerary.title: Half-Day Nainital Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, get ready to explore Nainital on a sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to the stunning Naina Lake, surrounded by lush hills, where you can opt for a scenic boat ride. Next, visit the revered Naini Devi Temple, one of the 51 Shakti Peeths, & pay your respects. Then, soak in the beauty of the snow-capped Himalayas from Snow View Point & enjoy a scenic hike to Tiffin Top for magical views of Nainital. Conclude your day with a visit to the stunning Bhimtal Lake
itinerary.accommodation: Dynasty Resort

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kausani | Kausani Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and get driven to Kausani, the Switzerland of India. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax. Later, get driven for a Kausani sightseeing tour and visit to the Anasakti Ashram, where Mahatma Gandhi once stayed and wrote his commentary on the Anasakti Yog. Next, explore the stunning Rudradhari Falls, surrounded by lush greenery. Also, visit the stunning Kausani Tea Estate, where you'll learn about the tea-making process and explore the tea gardens.
itinerary.accommodation: Himalaya Mount View Resort

itinerary.title: Transfer to Joshimath
itinerary.description: Today, after checking out of your hotel in Kausani, embark on a scenic drive to Joshimath, a charming hill town surrounded by majestic mountains. As you journey through stunning landscapes, take in the views of lush valleys and rolling hills that define the beauty of this Himalayan region. Upon arrival in Joshimath, check in to your comfortable hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Uday Palace Joshimath

itinerary.title: Excursion to Auli
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a drive to the chairlift platform in Joshimath & embark on a thrilling chairlift ride to Auli (tickets not included). As you ascend, soak in the stunning views of the snow-capped peaks & valleys. Upon reaching the Joshimath-Auli Ropeway Upper Terminal, visit the stunning Auli Artificial Lake, one of the highest man-made lakes in the world, & stroll along its shores. Conclude your adventure with a chairlift ride back to Joshimath. From there, get driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Uday Palace Joshimath

itinerary.title: Transfer to Rishikesh | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: After check-out, get driven to the Yoga Capital of the World, Rishikesh! Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can visit the iconic Ram Jhula, an iron bridge offering stunning views of the Ganga. Also, you can head to the Beatles Ashram, where the famous band once found inspiration or witness a stunning Ganga Arti at Triveni Ghat, offering an unforgettable experience.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Antarman Ganges

itinerary.title: Transfer to Delhi | Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from the hotel and get transferred to Delhi. Upon arrival, board your transfer back home, marking the end to your amazing Uttarakhand trip!

name: Nanital Corbett Tour Package from Delhi
description:
Escape the hustle of the city with our classic 'Nainital Corbett Tour Package from Delhi'. Perfectly optimized as a seamless 4 Nights and 5 Days private road trip, this itinerary offers an ideal blend of tranquil mountain lakes and raw, untamed wilderness.

Your journey begins with a scenic drive up into the pristine Kumaon hills to spend two beautiful days in Nainital. Here, your guests can indulge in romantic boat rides across the emerald waters of Naini Lake, explore vibrant colonial Mall Roads, and take in panoramic mountain views from high-altitude peaks. The adventure takes an exciting turn as you descend into the dense forests of Jim Corbett National Park for a two-night stay at a premium nature resort. The absolute highlight features an early morning open-jeep safari, giving travelers a thrilling chance to spot majestic Bengal tigers, Asiatic elephants, and diverse bird species in their natural habitat. Returning directly back to Delhi, this completely hassle-free private tour is tailor-made for family vacations, friend groups, and refreshing weekend escapes.
shortDescription: A refreshing 4N/5D wilderness and hill getaway featuring emerald lake boating in Nainital and thrilling tiger safaris in Jim Corbett.
highlights: Enjoy a relaxing, private row-boat ride across the deep emerald waters of Naini Lake in Nainital.
Take in panoramic Himalayan vistas from breathtaking viewpoints like Snow View and Tiffin Top.
Spot majestic Bengal tigers, wild elephants, and exotic birds during an early morning open-jeep safari in Jim Corbett.
Unwind at a handpicked premium nature resort nestled right along the lush fringes of the Corbett wilderness.
Travel completely hassle-free with a dedicated private vehicle covering the entire route from Delhi back to Delhi.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi | Transfer to Nainital | Trip to Naina Devi and Naina Lake
itinerary.description: Welcome to Delhi! Upon arrival at Majnu ka Tilla, get driven to Nainital. Once there, check into your hotel and rest for some time. Later, get driven to experience the essence of Nainital with a visit to the sacred Naina Devi Temple. There, soak in the spiritual aura and panoramic hill views. Next, enjoy a tranquil boat ride on Naini Lake, surrounded by lush greenery and stunning reflections that offer a moment of peace. Afterward, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Naina Greens

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Ranikhet
itinerary.description: Today, board your transfer to Ranikhet. Upon arrival, discover the beauty of Chaubatia Garden, where vibrant blooms, expansive lawns, and majestic trees offer a serene escape into nature. Next, visit the Jhula Devi Temple, dedicated to Goddess Durga, creating a unique and spiritual ambiance. Relax by the peaceful waters of Rani Jheel, a serene lake nestled amidst verdant landscapes, perfect for picnics, and boating. Afterward, get driven back to your hotel in Nainital.
itinerary.accommodation: Naina Greens

itinerary.title: Nainital Highlights Tour | Transfer to Corbett
itinerary.description: Today, check out from your hotel and explore Nainital. Start by getting driven to the Eco Cave Garden, where you can wander through natural caves. Then, head to Snow View Point for stunning views of the snowy Himalayan mountains, perfect for taking memorable photos. Next, visit Tiffin Top, a favorite spot for picnics with panoramic views of Nainital, and relax at Lovers Point, known for its beautiful sunsets over the hills. Later, get driven to Corbett. Check in and rest for the night.
itinerary.accommodation: Maya The Forest Resort

itinerary.title: Jungle Safari | Corbett Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, embark on an exciting Jeep Safari in Jim Corbett National Park. Travel through dense forests and grasslands, keeping an eye out for the park's inhabitants like tigers, elephants, deer, and exotic bird species. Later, get driven back to your hotel and rest for some time. Afterward, board your transfer to Corbett Waterfalls, surrounded by lush greenery and explore the Corbett Museum, showcasing the life of Jim Corbett. Next, visit Garija Devi Temple, before getting driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Maya The Forest Resort

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from your hotel and board your transfer to Delhi. Upon arrival, continue your journey forward. This marks the end of your trip.

name: Best of Uttarakhand | A Journey Through Gods Land
description:
Experience the profound divine energy of Devbhoomi with our signature 'Spiritual Wellness' family pilgrimage. Meticulously paced over 4 Nights and 5 Days, this private tour provides a completely stress-free environment for families seeking inner peace and sacred blessings.

Your journey starts on the holy banks of Rishikesh, where your family will witness the timeless, soul-stirring evening Triveni Ghat Ganga Aarti. Transition from the flowing river to the timeless peaks as you journey up to Joshimath, an ancient spiritual hub established by Adi Shankaracharya. Explore historical temples, experience peaceful mountain meditation, and witness the serene lifestyle of remote Himalayan villages. Traveling in a comfortable, dedicated private vehicle with an experienced mountain chauffeur, this itinerary ensures a smooth, deeply fulfilling, and sacred family vacation.
shortDescription: A soul-stirring 4N/5D spiritual pilgrimage blending the sacred river energy of Rishikesh with the ancient, meditative mountain shrines of Joshimath.
highlights: Witness the powerful and mesmerizing evening Maha Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri in Haridwar.
Journey deep into the mountains to Joshimath, the historic spiritual gateway of the Himalayas.
Ride the spectacular ropeway to Auli to walk through pristine alpine meadows and take in epic snow views.
Explore the quiet, graffiti-covered ruins and meditation caves of the famous Beatles Ashram in Rishikesh.
Walk along the legendary suspension bridge of Ram Jhula and explore vibrant riverside spiritual markets.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi | Transfer to Haridwar | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Majnu-ka-Tila/Kashmere Gate, set off on a journey to Haridwar, a revered spiritual hub of India. Upon reaching Haridwar, check into your hotel and spend the day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can head out and explore Bara Bazar’s bustling lanes, filled with traditional handicrafts and spices. Also, you can witness the stunning Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri or stroll through the scenic gardens of Shanti Kunj.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Riverdale

itinerary.title: Transfer to Joshimath
itinerary.description: In the morning, check-out from your hotel in Haridwar and embark on a scenic drive to Joshimath, a hill town nestled amidst the Himalayas. As you travel, enjoy the breathtaking landscapes of lush valleys and towering mountains. Upon reaching Joshimath, check in to your hotel, where you can relax and prepare for the next leg of your adventure. Afterwards, enjoy your overnight stay amidst the stunning Himalayan views.
itinerary.accommodation: The Tattva - A Boutique Resort

itinerary.title: Excursion to Auli
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to the Joshimath-Auli Ropeway Lower Station and enjoy a stunning chairlift ride to Auli (tickets not included) soaking in the amazing views. Upon reaching the Joshimath-Auli Ropeway Upper Terminal, visit the serene Auli Artificial Lake, one of the highest man-made lakes in the world, and enjoy a peaceful stroll along its scenic shores. After an amazing time, descend by chairlift to Joshimath and from there, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: The Tattva - A Boutique Resort

itinerary.title: Transfer to Rishikesh | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Post check-out, embark on a scenic drive to Rishikesh, the Yoga Capital of the World. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax for a while. Later, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can explore Rishikesh Adventure Park for an adventure-filled time and indulge in a variety of thrilling activities, like experiencing the ultimate rush—zip-line over the holy Ganga. Also, you can watch an amazing Ganga Arti at Triveni ghat, soaking in the calming atmosphere.

Start with a visit to the iconic Ram Jhula, a suspension bridge that spans the sacred Ganges and soak in the amazing views of the surroundings. Next, visit the Beatles Ashram, where the famous band stayed in the 1960s, and marvel at its graffiti-covered walls. Then get driven Majnu-ka-tila/Kashmere Gate in Delhi for your journey back home, marking the end to your amazing trip!

name: Dehradun and Auli Tour | A Passage through Himalayan Peaks	4D/3N
description:
Embark on a breathtaking mountain getaway with our 'Dehradun and Auli Tour'. Masterfully designed across 3 Nights and 4 Days, this high-altitude itinerary is perfect for adventure enthusiasts, couples, and friends looking to explore the dual charms of the Garhwal Himalayas.

Your journey starts in the picturesque capital valley of Dehradun, exploring hidden natural wonders like the mysterious gorges of Robber's Cave and the cascading therapeutic waters of Sahastradhara. The adventure scales dramatic heights as you travel up to Auli, India's premier skiing destination. Spend your days riding thrilling open-air chairlifts, standing beside one of the highest man-made lakes in the world, and marveling at panoramic views of towering peaks like Nanda Devi. Traveling in a dedicated private vehicle with an experienced mountain chauffeur, this package delivers a seamless and unforgettable Himalayan experience.
shortDescription: An exhilarating 3N/4D escape from the therapeutic springs of Dehradun to the world-class skiing slopes and alpine lakes of Auli.
highlights: Explore Uttarakhand, where you’ll uncover the hidden wonders of Dehradun's mystical caves and dive into thrilling adventures in the snowy paradise of Auli.
Visit Sahastradhara in Dehradun, a magical spot known as the 'Thousand-fold Spring' because of the healing properties of its sulfur-rich waters.
Discover Auli Artificial Lake, one of the world's highest man-made lakes, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding Himalayan peaks.
Experience the thrill of the Auli Chairlift, which takes you from the lower Auli area to the upper slopes, providing panoramic views of the majestic Himalayas.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dehradun | Visit Robber's Cave & Sahastradhara | Transfer to Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Welcome to Dehradun! Once you arrive at the Dehradun Airport/Railway Station, board your private transfer vehicle. En route to your halt, make an exciting stop to visit Robber's Cave (Guchhupani), a stunning natural river cave formation where a cool stream flows mysteriously through a dark, narrow limestone gorge. Next, visit Sahastradhara, also known as the 'Thousand-fold Spring,' famous for its beautiful cascading waterfalls and therapeutic, sulfur-rich mineral springs. After exploring, continue your scenic journey towards the spiritual town of Rishikesh. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend a relaxing evening by the river.
itinerary.accommodation: Arctic Hills By Opulence Hotels - Rishikesh / Similer

itinerary.title: Scenic Mountain Transfer from Rishikesh to Auli
itinerary.description: In the morning, enjoy a hearty breakfast, check out from your hotel, and board your private vehicle for a spectacular drive to Auli. This stunning hill station is nestled high in the Garhwal Himalayas. The drive follows the path of the sacred Alaknanda River, offering numerous opportunities to stop and capture breathtaking photographs of deep river confluences (Prayags), cascading mountain waterfalls, and quaint hillside villages. Upon arriving in the alpine heights of Auli, check into your mountain hotel/resort and enjoy a cozy overnight stay surrounded by misty peaks.
itinerary.accommodation: Zero Degree Homestay / Similer

itinerary.title: Auli Sightseeing Tour | Alpine Lakes & High-Altitude Chairlift Ride
itinerary.description: Today, head out to explore the absolute best of Auli. First, visit the pristine Auli Artificial Lake, perched beautifully at an altitude of over 2,500 meters, making it one of the highest man-made lakes in the world. Next, experience a thrilling ride on the famous Auli Chairlift, taking you from the lower skiing base up to the upper alpine meadows. Once at the top, you can indulge in various activities such as trekking along the ridges or taking in panoramic views of the majestic Nanda Devi peak. Later in the evening, head back to your hotel for a warm dinner and overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Zero Degree Homestay / Similer

itinerary.title: Transfer to Rishikesh / Dehradun | Departure
itinerary.description: Wake up to a crisp mountain morning and enjoy your breakfast. Check out from the hotel and board your downhill private transfer heading back via Rishikesh. Take in the final views of the majestic Himalayan valleys during your return journey. Upon arrival at the Dehradun Airport, railway station, or your designated drop-off point, bid farewell to the mountains and board your transit back home with unforgettable memories of your alpine adventure.

name: The Charming Hill Stations With Beautiful Forest Experience
description:
Escape to the pristine hills and ancient woods of Devbhoomi with our signature 'Charming Hill Stations with Beautiful Forest Experience' vacation. Masterfully paced across 6 Nights and 7 Days, this comprehensive private road journey is perfectly optimized for families, couples, and leisure groups who want to experience the true essence of the Kumaon region.

Your journey starts in Nainital, the gem of Uttarakhand, where you will spend two glorious days enjoying row-boat rides across the pear-shaped Naini Lake, exploring the British-era Raj Bhawan, and walking the vibrant Mall Road. Next, travel to the peaceful cantonment town of Ranikhet to walk through the massive 600-acre Chaubatia Apple Orchards and enjoy high-altitude golfing spaces. The vacation finishes with an unmatched thrill in Jim Corbett National Park—India's oldest wildlife sanctuary. Here, your guests will enjoy a relaxing riverside resort stay along the Kosi River coupled with deep-jungle open-jeep safaris. Traveling completely by a dedicated private vehicle from Delhi and back, this tour delivers an authentic, comfortable, and memory-filled Himalayan holiday
shortDescription: An exquisite 6N/7D family retreat traversing the emerald lakes of Nainital, the serene orchards of Ranikhet, and the wild tiger territories of Jim Corbett.
highlights: Enjoy private, relaxing row-boating over the iconic, pear-shaped Naini Lake in Nainital.
Take a bird's-eye aerial cable car ride from Mallital up to the panoramic Snow View Point.
Walk through the historic, British-era 600-acre Chaubatia Orchards to view apple and peach trees.
Spot Royal Bengal Tigers and wild elephants during an early morning open-jeep safari inside Jim Corbett.
Unwind with a peaceful evening nature walk right along the banks of the scenic Kosi River.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Nainital/Bhimtal (297 Kms, 7 Hrs)
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Delhi Airport /Railway station, meet and greet by our assistance and drive to Nainital. 

Nainital: Nainital is the gem of Uttarakhand - One of the most popular and exquisite hill station on the Kumaon hills. It derives its name from Naini Lake. This lake with more other lakes makes it to earn the title of 'City of Lakes’. This quaint little town experiences a pleasant climate throughout the year. Nainital has everything for every tourist, you name it you’ll get it, like beautiful weather, lakes, adventure, food, shopping that too with quality. 

On arrival check into the hotel/Resort. Dinner & overnight stay at Nainital.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Aroma by Royal Collection Hotels or similar

itinerary.title: Nainital/Bhimtal
itinerary.description:
Today morning after breakfast enjoy resort. Later visit to Tiffin top: Catch a glimpse from Tiffin Top, a peak in Nainital and witness the most awe-inspiring sight. The place is only about 4 km from the heart of Nainital and makes for a wonderful trek. You can also enjoy a pony ride to go there.

Nainital Rope way: The rope way takes you to small peaks in Nainital and also gives you a bird’s eye view of the hill station. It should definitely be given a shot if you love high rise views. The cable car runs from Mallital to Snow View.

Naina Devi Temple: Spend some quiet time here; you will surely come back refreshed. The Naina Devi Temple is dedicated to goddess Naina Devi, who is believed to govern the Naini Lake. It is believed to be one of the 64 Shakti peeth’s in India.

Timings: 04:00 am – 10:00 pm.

Raj Bhawan: This Nainital Governor’s House gives a feel of Buckingham Palace London and is a treat to visit, mostly if you are a lover of museums. The two-storey mansion contains around 113 rooms, but visitors are only allowed in its vast lawns and within the 18-hole course within its premises. Constructed by the British in 1924, the golf course is around a scenic forest, and is home to many rare species of flora and fauna.

Naini Lake: This picture-perfect region of nature is dotted with many lakes, but the Naini Lake is the most popular gorgeous lake in Nainital. The lake is pear-shaped and it reflects the color of beautiful surrounding green hills. You can explore the lake from one end to another. Boating, yachting and paddling activities are available here. Watch the picture-perfect peaceful views of the sunset and enjoy the cool breeze from the lake.

Enjoy mall road: Nainital is famous for handmade candles. Collecting candles of varied forms, shapes and sizes is one among the best things to try and do in Nainital. The locals make amazing candles here – designs and patterns that you have never seen. Don’t forget to buy some and include them in your home décor.

Return to the hotel. Dinner & Overnight stay at Nainital.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Aroma by Royal Collection Hotels or similar

itinerary.title: Nainital/Bhimtal - Kausani/Ranikhet (58 Kms, 2 Hrs)
itinerary.description:
Today morning after breakfast check out and drive to Ranikhet. 

Ranikhet: Ranikhet is a stunning hill station and was developed by Britishers. It is located in Uttarakhand & there are various famous temples that are built with beautiful architecture and is a must to visit Places. Apart from beautiful lakes, there are several adventure activities to try in Ranikhet such as Golf and Trekking.

Enroute visit Ranikhet Golf Course 

Kalika Temple: Kalika is a small town in Uttarakhand that is surrounded by lush green dense forests and snow-covered mountains. The place is famous for the Kalika temple that is dedicated to Goddess Kali. In the temple, you can see a beautiful collection of flowers. Another thing that you can do in Kalika is playing golf on hills. During winter season tourists must avoid visiting this place. 

Chaubatia Orchards: The place is a perfect example of pure nature and people who like to take a walk in nature must visit here. The garden is spread over 600 acres and from the top of the garden one can have a majestic view of Himalayan peaks. Walking through the garden one can see fruit orchards like apple, plums, peaches as well as Cedar and pine trees. Near the garden, tourists can have Maggi with tea 

 On arrival check into the hotel/Resort. Freshen up & proceed for visiting local temples.  

Haidakhan Temple: The Haidakhan Temple is adorned at Chidianuala Ranikhet. This temple is made by Haidakhan who is believed to be the incarnation of Lord Shiva to whom this temple is dedicated. Haidakhan's birth has always been a mystery. He left his mortal remains in 1984, at an early age. 

Rani Jheel: This is an artificial lake built by the Cantonment board for rainwater harvesting. The lake is situated in natural woods and ridges at a height of 7500 feet. The place is a major attraction in Ranikhet among tourists and the best thing you can do here is boating. The place is perfect for silence seekers. 

Ashiyana Park: This is a must-visit if you are travelling with your kids because this is the only park in Ranikhet which is made for kid’s entertainment. At the park, children can enjoy various rides; walk-in lush green lawns also do some photography in Himalayan ranges. Fun fact about the park is that the park is built with a jungle theme  

Dinner & Overnight stay at Ranikhet.
itinerary.accommodation: Nature's Valley Resort, Kausani or similar

itinerary.description: Today morning after breakfast, you can opt for optional activities. Evening free for leisure. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Kausani/Ranikhet - Corbett (88 Kms, 3 hrs)
itinerary.description:
Today morning after breakfast check out and drive to Corbett. Located at the foothills of the Himalayas in Uttarakhand, Jim Corbett is the oldest National Park in India. 

Enroute visit Garjiya Devi temple which is one of the most Calm and holy place near Jim Corbett. One can instantly feel the inner peace as soon as they reach the temple premises. It is one of the most ancient temples, which is named after “Mata Garjiya Devi” and is situated beside River Kosi offering mesmerizing panoramic view of mountains, trees and a wonderful calmly flowing river. Visiting this temple on Kartik Poornima is considered as most auspicious. It is said that on this day, your wishes will get fulfilled if you offer true prayer and seek blessings.    

Jim Corbett National Park - is a part of the larger Corbett Tiger Reserve, a Project Tiger Reserve lies in the Nainital district of Uttarakhand. The magical landscape of Corbett is well known and fabled for its tiger richness. Established in the year 1936 as Hailey National Park, Corbett has the glory of being India's oldest and most prestigious National Park. Its whole area comprises of hills, marshy depressions, riverside belts, grasslands and large lake.

Zones: Essentially, there are 6 different zones in Jim Corbett National Park with a few premium zones that change the cost depending upon the zone. You can choose a particular zone as per your wish.
Jeep safari: Jeep is a four wheeler vehicle permitted to enter through all buffer zones of the park. It is the most popular way because Jeep is smaller in size when compared with canter that takes you easily some of the unexplored and hidden corners of the jungle. Jeep Safari are often done in tourism zones like Bijrani, Jhirna, Durgadevi, Dhela and Sitabani.
Canter safari: Canter safari is only available if one is staying in the Dhikala zone (booking to be done only through tourism website) to the most inhabited region by the Royal Bengal Tigers, canter safari is the only option. Canter is also conducted in two shifts by Corbett forest officials. 
On arrival check into the hotel. Freshen up & proceed for a nature walk along the Kosi River. This area is bird watcher’s paradise. Evening is free for leisure activities. Dinner &Overnight stay at Corbett.
activities: Jeep safari / Canter safari (There are 02 types of safaris done.)
itinerary.accommodation: Corbett Aroma Park Resort or similar

itinerary.title: Jimm Corbett National Park Safari
itinerary.description:
Those who are interested for safari can do a morning and afternoon safari.

Safari Details: Visitors can book online Jeep Safari or Canter Safari for five different zones of the park namely Bijrani, Jhirna, Dhikala, Dhela and Durgadevi. All the procedures of Safari Booking at Corbett are managed by the forest officials as per the guidelines of India's forest department. Please note that we cannot influence the safari zone, safari driver and the naturalist guide as it is not in our hand. It is solely decided by the forest officials. Though all the zones have healthy population of tigers and wildlife sightings are reported more or less same.

These all aspects are managed by the automated computerized system to ensure the equal distribution of safari vehicles in respective zones.

Return back to the Hotel/ Resort. Dinner & Overnight stay at Corbett.

name: Best of Kashmir | Excursion to Sonmarg
description:
Immerse yourself in absolute paradise with our flagship 'Best of Kashmir | Excursion to Sonmarg' vacation circuit. Meticulously organized across 6 Nights and 7 Days, this premium private tour brings you the ultimate showcase of the Kashmir Valley's legendary natural beauty and rich cultural heritage.

Your journey features a perfect balance of iconic valley stays: spend three magical nights in Srinagar—including a stay in a luxury wooden houseboat on Dal Lake paired with traditional Shikara rides. Travel down to the pristine riverside meadows of Pahalgam for an idyllic night surrounded by dense pine forests along the roaring Lidder River. Complete the loop with two unforgettable nights in the winter wonderland of Gulmarg, home to one of the world's highest cable car systems. With a dedicated day-long excursion to the 'Meadow of Gold' in Sonamarg to witness majestic glaciers, this itinerary delivers a seamless, safe, and deeply memorable holiday experience.
shortDescription: An enchanting 6N/7D premium journey featuring luxury houseboat stays in Srinagar, alpine meadow trails in Pahalgam, and high-altitude snow peaks in Gulmarg.
highlights: Experience a magical overnight stay in a handpicked, luxury wooden houseboat on Srinagar's iconic Dal Lake.
Enjoy a gentle, relaxing sunset Shikara boat ride past the vibrant, floating valley markets.
Take a breathtaking day excursion to Sonamarg to walk among the golden, glacier-fed alpine meadows.
Ride the famous high-altitude Gulmarg Gondola cable car to take in panoramic views of snow-crowned peaks.
Stroll through the deep pine forests and picturesque valleys along the Lidder River banks in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar | Srinagar Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to Srinagar! Upon arrival at the Airport, board your transfer to the hotel. Post check-in, relax for a while, & later, you'll be taken on a Srinagar sightseeing tour & marvel at the stunning Persian-style terraces of Shalimar Bagh. Then, visit Nishat Bagh and soak-in the amazing views of Dal Lake. Continue to the Tulip Garden, the largest in Asia, showcasing a vivid array of tulips in spring, and admire the historic terraced garden, the Pari Mahal. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel.
activities: Rafting at Lidder River in Pahalgam (optional)

itinerary.description: Post check-out, get driven to Pahalgam. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel & relax. Later, get transferred to the Union Cab Stand, from where you can hire a cab (at your own cost) & visit the famous valleys of Pahalgam. Explore the Aru Valley, known for its amazing landscapes, & stroll along the riverbanks of Betaab Valley, known for its Bollywood fame. Next, visit Chandanwari & soak-in the views of the Himalayan mountains before heading to the cab stand. From there, get driven to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Gulmarg | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: After check-out, get transferred to your hotel in Gulmarg. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel, and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can soak-in the charm of this beautiful town with a visit to Seven Springs, or you can pay your respects at the Baba Reshi Ziyarat, a revered shrine with a peaceful ambiance. Also, you can visit the Maharani Temple, an iconic landmark that blends history and spirituality, perched on a hill with panoramic views. Later, return to your hotel on your own.

itinerary.description: In the morning, get transferred to the Gulmarg Union Cab Stand, where you'll begin your adventure. Upon arrival, either walk or take a cab to the Gondola cable car station. As you ascend in the gondola (tickets not included), glide smoothly over lush meadows and soak-in the amazing views of the surrounding mountains. Also, you can visit the serene Drung Waterfall and the stunning Strawberry Valley before returning to the cab stand. From there, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.

Then, indulge in shopping traditional items at the Lal Chowk & explore Badam Wari Park, famous for the early bloom of almond flowers. Later, visit Dal Lake, where you can enjoy a Shikara boat ride while admiring the houseboats & mountains before getting driven to your hotel.

name: Jammu & Kashmir Spiritual Trip | Vaishno Devi Darshan & Beyond
description:
Embark on a deeply blessed and seamless family pilgrimage with our 'Jammu & Kashmir Spiritual Trip | Vaishno Devi Darshan & Beyond' package. Beautifully designed across 3 Nights and 4 Days, this private tour perfectly balances holy devotion with the unmatched natural beauty of the Kashmir Valley.

Your spiritual journey begins in Katra, the base camp for the holy cave shrine of Mata Vaishno Devi. We ensure a smooth yatra experience with well-timed logistics, allowing your family to seek blessings at the Bhawan with absolute peace of mind. After your sacred pilgrimage, your dedicated private vehicle climbs into the breathtaking landscapes of Kashmir. Experience the pure magic of Srinagar with a stay in a premium luxury wooden houseboat on Dal Lake, a relaxing sunset Shikara ride, and walks through historic Mughal Gardens. With expert mountain drivers and end-to-end coordination, this package delivers the perfect blend of divine grace, safety, and Himalayan luxury.
shortDescription: A soul-stirring 3N/4D private pilgrimage combining the sacred Vaishno Devi Yatra with a magical escape to the floating lakes of Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar | Transfer to Katra | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome! Upon arriving at the airport, get driven to Katra. Once you reach, check in at the hotel. Afterwards, you can spend your time at leisure. You can add some adventure to your trip with white-water rafting on the Chenab River, where rushing rapids & dramatic mountain views create an adrenaline-filled experience. Alternative, you can set out on a refreshing trek to Himkoti, a serene spot along the Vaishno Devi route, offering sweeping views of the valley & peaceful escape amidst nature.
activities: White Water Rafting at Chenab River (Optional)
itinerary.accommodation: Holiday Inn Katra Vaishno Devi by IHG / Similer

itinerary.title: Trek to Vaishno Devi Temple
itinerary.description: Today, get ready for a 14 km trek to the Mata Vaishno Devi Temple. While ascending, you can choose to trek on foot or hire ponies or palkis (at extra cost) & pass through scenic mountain paths, where the chants of “Jai Mata Di” echo in the air. Take your time to pause at rest points, enjoy snacks & stay hydrated along the way. As you arrive at the temple gates, head to cave shrine where the idol of Vaishno Mata sits. While there, you can also attending the divine aarti before descending back.
itinerary.accommodation: Holiday Inn Katra Vaishno Devi by IHG / Similer

itinerary.title: Transfer to Srinagar | Srinagar Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: After you get ready, check out from the hotel & enjoy a scenic drive to Srinagar. Once you reach, check in at the hotel. Afterwards, get driven for city's sightseeing tour. Explore Nishat Bagh, known for its twelve-terraced Mughal design & Shalimar Bagh, the largest Mughal garden in Kashmir. Also, explore Shankaracharya Temple, one of the oldest shrine in the city dedicated to Lord Shiva & Pari Mahal, famed for its detailed Islamic architecture. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Elaf Residency / Similer

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, get ready & check out from the hotel. You'll be driven to the airport. This is where your trip comes to an end.

name: Highlights of Kashmir | FREE Shikara Ride on Dal Lake
description:
Experience the definitive spirit of the valley with our premium 'Highlights of Kashmir | FREE Shikara Ride on Dal Lake' getaway. Seamlessly laid out across 5 Nights and 6 Days, this private, chauffeur-driven tour is beautifully curated for families and couples who want to explore Jammu & Kashmir's ultimate landmarks in complete comfort.

Your itinerary features 4 nights at a deluxe hotel in Srinagar, serving as your perfect base for incredible, private day excursions. Journey to the high-altitude meadows of Gulmarg and travel to the spectacular, snow-fed Thajiwas Glacier in Sonamarg. Back in the capital, you will discover historic heritage sites during a private Srinagar sightseeing tour, including panoramic views from the sacred Shankaracharya Temple, and enjoy a peaceful, complimentary private Shikara ride across the tranquil waters of Dal Lake. The tour also includes 1 night in the serene riverside valley of Pahalgam, allowing you to completely unwind among deep pine woods. Complete with private airport transfers and premium MAP meal plans, this holiday guarantees a hassle-free, magical Himalayan experience.

highlights: Enjoy 4 relaxing nights at a deluxe hotel in Srinagar and 1 night nestled in the pine valleys of Pahalgam.
Glide across the tranquil waters of Dal Lake during a complimentary, private 1-hour Shikara boat ride.
Ascend to the breathtaking, snow-clad mountain expanses of Gulmarg on a dedicated private day tour.
Explore Srinagar's heritage landmarks and capture panoramic valley views from the Shankaracharya Temple.
Take an incredible private day trip to Sonamarg to witness the majestic alpine terrains of Thajiwas Glacier.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Srinagar Airport, transfer to your hotel and spend the day at your leisure. You can visit the Srinagar Tulip Garden, a 30-acre floral paradise by Dal Lake and Nishat Bagh. It boasts over 1.5 million tulips, making it the largest in Asia. You can also visit Chashme Shahi, a Mughal garden built in 1632 by Emperor Shah Jahan, featuring a spring with cool, curative waters. Next, you can see the Botanical Garden, known for its 150,000 ornamental plants, before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Gulmarg
itinerary.description: In the morning, you'll be transferred to the Gulmarg Union Cab Stand, where you can arrange a cab for sightseeing in Gulmarg. You can experience the Gulmarg Gondola, one of the world’s highest cable cars, offering panoramic views of snow-covered mountains. Next, you can visit Drung Waterfall, a serene spot known for its gushing waters cascading down rocky cliffs. Return to the Union Cab Stand on your own. Then, board your transfer to the hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Gulmarg Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis
itinerary.accommodation: pice Hotel & Restaurant, Srinagar /The Stay Villa, Srinagar / similer

itinerary.title: Excursion to Sonmarg
itinerary.description: In the morning, you'll be transferred to Sonmarg Pony Ride Parking. From there, you can take a horseback ride to Thajiwas Glacier, known for its stunning views of the Himalayan peaks and pristine landscape creates a peaceful ambiance. You can also experience the thrill of whitewater rafting on the Sindh River, famous for its crystal-clear waters, where you can experience whitewater rafting. Later, head to Sonmarg Pony Ride Parking. From there, you'll be driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: pice Hotel & Restaurant, Srinagar /The Stay Villa, Srinagar / similer

You can hire a cab from there (at your own cost) and visit the famous Aru, Betaab, and Chandanwari Valleys. Afterward, you can also experience rafting at Lidder River (at an additional cost) before heading to the Union Cab Stand on your own. Later, you'll be transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

Next, visit Badam Wari Park, known for its almond blossoms in spring. Then, stroll through Nishat Bagh, offering views of Dal Lake and the Zabarwan Mountains. Also visit Shankaracharya Temple and Lal Chowk Market before enjoying a serene shikara ride on Dal Lake. Later, check into your houseboat for an overnight stay.

name: Captivating Kashmir | A Journey to the Heaven
description:
Surrender to the absolute magic of 'Paradise on Earth' with our beautifully curated 'Captivating Kashmir | A Journey to the Heaven' private travel package. Perfectly mapped out across 4 Nights and 5 Days, this chauffeur-driven holiday loop is engineered to showcase the absolute best highlights of the valley in total comfort and style.

Your journey starts with a seamless private transfer from Sheikh ul-Alam International Airport to your deluxe hotel in Srinagar, followed by an elegant sightseeing tour featuring the stunning terraced architecture of Pari Mahal. Next, your private vehicle winds into the postcard-perfect valley of Pahalgam for an incredible night surrounded by pristine pine forests and a private local sightseeing circuit. From there, head up to the winter wonderland of Gulmarg to witness towering snow peaks, enjoy private local exploration, and ride the famous high-altitude cable car. You will return to Srinagar to experience a spectacular stay alongside the water, fully complete with delicious breakfasts. With door-to-door private airport transit on your final day, this itinerary promises an unforgettable, stress-free Himalayan vacation.

Ascend to the breathtaking, high-altitude alpine meadows and snow peaks of Gulmarg on a private tour.
Relax deeply on your final night in Srinagar, treated to a full meal plan including breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

Continue your tour at the Mughal gardens—Shalimar Bagh, Nishat Bagh, and Chashme Shahi—where you can admire the vibrant flora. Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

You can discover the Maharani Temple, known for its beautiful carvings and peaceful atmosphere. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
