name: Escape to Himachal | Discover the trails of Shangarh & Jibhi
description:
Escape the crowded tourist commercial hubs and dive deep into the pristine, untouched landscapes of Tirthan and Sainj Valleys with our 'Escape to Himachal | Discover the trails of Shangarh & Jibhi' travel package. Perfectly mapped out across 5 Nights and 6 Days (fully optimized to include comfortable overnight highway transits), this specialized eco-adventure itinerary is tailor-made for nature lovers, avid trekkers, backpackers, and solo travelers wanting to experience true Himalayan serenity.

Your offbeat journey begins with two peaceful nights in the breathtaking village of Shangarh, home to legendary green meadows and ancient local folklore. Here, you will enjoy scenic village exploration loops and embark on an incredible, guided day trek to the mystical, grass-covered waters of Pundrik Rishi Lake. From Shangarh, cross over into the pine-fringed hamlet of Jibhi for a cozy one-night stay amidst wooden cottages and rushing streams. Your time in Jibhi features an iconic trek through dense oak and deodar forests to the beautiful, crystal-clear high-altitude Serolsar Lake. Complete with cozy handpicked stays, fresh daily breakfast spreads, dedicated mountain transits, and local trekking guidance, this loop offers the ultimate wilderness recharge.
shortDescription: An offbeat 5N/6D eco-adventure highlighting the pristine meadows of Shangarh, Jibhi Valley, and guided treks to hidden alpine lakes.
highlights: Walk across the wide, legendary green meadows of Shangarh, surrounded by towering pine trees.
Trek through rich local flora to see the unique, entirely weed-covered sacred waters of Pundrik Rishi Lake
Unwind by the wooden bridges, rushing waterfalls, and bohemian cafes hidden in the hamlet of Jibhi.
Hike through dense, snow-dusted oak and deodar forests up to the sacred, panoramic Serolsar Lake.
Ditch the commercial crowds to experience the deep, quiet cultural heritage of hidden Himachali villages.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Aut | Overnight Journey in Volvo Bus
itinerary.description: Welcome to Delhi! Upon your arrival at Majnu Ka Tilla or Kashmere Gate, board your comfortable bus for an overnight journey to Aut. Settle into your seat, relax, and enjoy the changing landscapes. The journey takes you through winding roads, offering glimpses of villages and starry skies. Whether you choose to rest or take in the scenic beauty along the way, this overnight ride sets the perfect tone for an exciting trip ahead.

itinerary.title: Aut to Shangarh | Sightseeing Tour of Shangarh
itinerary.description: After an overnight journey, arrive at Aut Tunnel & continue through the scenic roads of Sainj Valley, surrounded by dense pine forests & rolling meadows. Upon arrival in Shangarh, check into your hotel and rest. Next, get driven for the sightseeing. Visit the Shangchul Mahadev Temple, believed to be a divine sanctuary where no battles were ever fought. Later, explore the villages of Goshati and Darari, where traditional Kath Kuni wooden houses & apple orchards offer a glimpse into local life.
itinerary.accommodation: The Great Himalayan Hikes Homestay / Mountain River View /

itinerary.title: Trek to Pundrik Rishi Lake
itinerary.description: Today, get transferred to Jhilli Neahi village and start your trek to Pundrik Rishi Lake, surrounded by lush greenery. Trek through picturesque landscapes and reach the Sarahan village and take in the panoramic views of the surroundings and mountains. Walk the trail passing by cedar trees and maize farms and reach the beautiful Pundrik Rishi Lake. Afterward, trek back to Jhili Neahi and get transferred back to your hotel in Shangarh for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: The Great Himalayan Hikes Homestay / Mountain River View /

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jibhi | Leisure Time
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out and get driven to Jibhi. Upon arrival, check in and spend your time at leisure. You can visit Jibhi Waterfall, hidden within dense forests, where crystal-clear water cascades over rocky terrain, creating a peaceful retreat. You can also explore Mini Thailand, a stunning spot with turquoise waters, smooth rock formations, and lush greenery, resembling Thailand’s landscapes. Afterward, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: No Society Cafe And Homestay / Lato The Hut / Similar

itinerary.title: Jibhi to Jalori Pass | Trek to Serolsar Lake | Overnight Journey to Delhi
itinerary.description: After checking out, get driven to Jalori Pass. Once there, begin your scenic trek through dense forests of oak and pine, leading to the pristine Serolsar Lake, known for its crystal-clear waters and deep spiritual significance. Enjoy the peaceful surroundings and the know about the story of Budhi Nagin, the sacred guardian of the lake. After exploring, trek back to Jalori Pass and get driven to Aut Tunnel. From there, board your bus for an overnight journey to Delhi.

Explore the architectural marvels along the pedestrian Ridge, walk down the bustling Mall Road, and take in panoramic mountain views among the dense pine woods of Kufri. From Shimla, enjoy a breathtaking drive alongside the rushing Beas River through the picturesque Kullu Valley before arriving in Manali for a three-night stay. In Manali, dive into rich local mountain culture with a custom city sightseeing tour, experience high-octane mountain sports at Solang Valley, and enjoy an exclusive, high-value complimentary day excursion to the legendary, snow-capped landscapes of Rohtang Pass. Complete with handpicked premium accommodations, private car transits, and flexible MAP meal plans, this package delivers a flawless and refreshing mountain escape.

Elegantly mapped across 7 Nights and 8 Days, this highly comprehensive itinerary is designed to give families, couples, and group travelers a profound look into the diverse cultures, colonial pasts, and raw alpine heights of the Western Himalayas.

Your odyssey opens with two nights in the historic summer capital of Shimla, where you will wander through colonial architecture along the Ridge and see the panoramic, pine-draped landscapes of Kufri. Next, trace the path of the rushing Beas River past the traditional shawl weavers of Kullu to arrive in Manali for a spectacular three-night resort stay. Your time in Manali is packed with iconic experiences: a custom heritage city tour, thrilling mountain sports in Solang Valley, and an unforgettable day trip up to the high-altitude glaciers of Rohtang Pass. Finally, journey deep into the spiritual Kangra Valley for two peaceful nights in Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj, exploring serene Buddhist monasteries and the home of the Dalai Lama. Complete with handpicked properties, dedicated point-to-point transits, this is the definitive mountain escape.

highlights: Stroll down Shimla’s pedestrian Ridge and Mall Road to admire timeless British-era colonial architecture.
Take in panoramic mountain vistas, dense pine forests, and fun outdoor activities in the hills of Kufri.
Climb to the staggering heights of Rohtang Pass to witness breathtaking glaciers and infinite snow views.
Visit the legendary Solang Valley, an absolute paradise for paragliding, zorbing, and mountain sports.
Discover rich local history with visits to Manali’s ancient wooden Hidimba Devi Temple and local markets.

As you leave the bustling city behind, watch as the landscape transforms into lush greenery greeting you along the way. After reaching, check in at the hotel and explore the city at your leisure. You can visit places such as Viceregal Lodge, and Shimla State Museum, among others. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Sunrise, Shimla / Katson Blue Mashobra, Shimla / Similar

itinerary.title: Sightseeing Tour of Shimla and Kufri
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll be driven for a sightseeing tour, starting with the Himalayan Nature Park, home to a variety of flora and fauna, including rare and endangered species like the Himalayan Monal. Continue to other sites including Indira Tourist Park, Christ Church and Mall Road. Also, explore the Kufri Fun World, an amusement park set against the stunning backdrop of the Himalayas. Conclude your day by admiring the breathtaking views of Hassan Valley before being driven back to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Sunrise, Shimla / Katson Blue Mashobra, Shimla / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Manali I En route Kullu Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of the hotel and board the transfer to Manali. As you journey through the picturesque landscapes, make a stop at Kullu, where you'll visit the Great Himalayan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its diverse wildlife, dense forests and stunning alpine meadows. Next, visit the Manikaran Hot Springs, whose warm waters are believed to have healing properties. Continue your journey to Manali, and upon arrival, check in at your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel The Conifer, Manali / Katson Blue, Manali / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Solang Valley | Manali Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll be driven to the Solang Valley, known for its stunning views of snow-capped peaks and lush green meadows. Here, you can indulge in various thrilling activities such as paragliding, quad biking and Solang Ropeway (at an extra costs). Later, get transferred for Manali sightseeing tour. Visit sites like the Hidimba Devi Temple, Van Vihar National Park and many more. Lastly, enjoy a leisurely stroll along the vibrant mall road before being driven back to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel The Conifer, Manali / Katson Blue, Manali / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Rohtang Pass
itinerary.description: On this day, you’ll be driven for a day trip to Rohtang Pass, one of the most popular and scenic locations in Himachal Pradesh. As you ascend towards the pass, marvel at the dramatic change in landscape, from lush green valleys to rugged, snow-capped mountains. En route, you can admire the scenic Rahala Waterfalls and small villages like Kothi, Gulaba and Marhi. After a day of exploration and adventure, you'll be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel The Conifer, Manali / Katson Blue, Manali / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Dharmashala I Enroute Visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Dharamshala. Along the way, make a stop at the revered Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara, a sacred site nestled in the Parvati Valley. After spending some peaceful moments at the Gurudwara, continue your scenic drive. Upon reaching Dharamshala, check in at your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Divyansh by VRB HOTELS, Dharmshala / Sky Heaven Resort, Dharamshala / Similar

itinerary.title: Dharamshala Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Board the transfer for your Dharamshala sightseeing tour. Start by visiting the Dharamshala War Memorial, a tribute to the soldiers who sacrificed their lives in various wars. Next, explore the Dharamshala Cricket Stadium, renowned for its stunning backdrop of the Himalayas and considered one of the most picturesque cricket grounds in the world. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Divyansh by VRB HOTELS, Dharmshala / Sky Heaven Resort, Dharamshala / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: After checking out of the hotel in Dharamshala, board your transfer to Delhi. Upon arrival in Delhi, you’ll be dropped off at Majnu ka Tilla. This is where your trip ends. Have a safe journey ahead.

name: Weekend Getaway to Manali
description:
Trade the busy city streets for fresh mountain air with our signature 'Weekend Getaway to Manali' holiday package. Masterfully condensed into 2 Nights and 3 Days on a private basis, this high-energy itinerary is designed for corporate professionals, friend groups, and quick-break travelers wanting to experience the absolute highlights of the Western Himalayas over a single short trip.

Your weekend retreat centers around a comfortable two-night stay in the alpine resort hub of Manali, serving as your perfect base for local sightseeing. Explore the city's unique mountain heritage with a dedicated tour of the ancient wooden Hidimba Devi Temple and local markets. The true highlight of your weekend is a spectacular full-day excursion winding up to the breathtaking high-altitude glaciers of Rohtang Pass and the adventure playgrounds of Solang Valley. Complete with handpicked premium accommodations, daily hot breakfasts, delicious dinners, and dedicated point-to-point private transits, this smart loop cuts out the travel hassle to deliver a flawless mountain recharge.
shortDescription: A refreshing 2N/3D weekend escape to the alpine valleys of Manali, featuring local cultural tours and a day trip to Solang Valley and Rohtang Pass.
highlights: Maximize your short break with a professionally managed, time-efficient mountain loop.
Climb to the spectacular high-altitude slopes of Rohtang Pass for breathtaking panoramic snow views.
Visit the famous Solang Valley, an absolute paradise for paragliding, zorbing, and outdoor sports.
Discover rich local history with visits to Manali’s ancient wooden Hidimba Devi Temple and local bazaars.
Savor freshly prepared, hot multi-cuisine buffet breakfasts and dinners directly at your property.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali | Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to Manali! Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check in and relax for a while. Start your day with a visit to Hidimba Devi Temple, known for its unique three-tiered pagoda and cedar forest setting. Explore the Tibetan Monastery and take a stroll through Van Vihar National Park. You can then head to Vashist Temple, famous for its hot springs. Finish your day at Mall Road, the vibrant shopping area. Later, you'll be transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Katson Blue, Manali /Hotel The Conifer, Manali / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Rohtang Pass and Solang Valley
itinerary.description: Begin your day with an exciting excursion to Solang Valley, where you can experience adrenaline-pumping activities such as paragliding, skiing, and snowmobile rides (at an extra cost). The valley, nestled between snowy mountains, offers spectacular views of the surrounding peaks. Then, continue to Rohtang Pass, a high-altitude pass at 13,058 feet. You can enjoy the snowy landscape and dramatic views. Later, get transferred to your hotel in Manali for an overnight stay.

This bustling marketplace is perfect for buying unique souvenirs, handicrafts, and woolen clothes. Later, you can visit nearby cafés to enjoy local delicacies. In the afternoon, return to the hotel to retrieve your luggage and prepare for departure. You will be transferred to the Manali Bus Stand for your onward journey, bringing your memorable trip to a close.

name: Best of Kerala | Vacation in Romantic Paradise
description:
Experience the definitive spirit, timeless charm, and soothing rhythms of South India with our 'Best of Kerala | Vacation in Romantic Paradise' holiday package. Beautifully orchestrated across 4 Nights and 5 Days on a completely private basis, this premium getaway guides you effortlessly from the mist-covered hills of the Western Ghats down to the tranquil, palm-lined backwaters of the Malabar Coast.

Your tropical holiday opens with two nights among the sprawling emerald tea estates and crashing waterfalls of Munnar, featuring a comprehensive private city and plantation tour. From the mountains, descend into Kumarakom for a peaceful overnight stay highlighted by a private, scenic backwater boat cruise. The grand finale of your journey takes you into Alleppey, where you will check into a traditional luxury houseboat for an unforgettable cruise through narrow canal networks, complete with full board on-board meals (Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner) prepared fresh by a personal chef. Seamlessly mapped with private vehicle transits and handpicked properties, this itinerary is an absolute masterpiece for couples, families, and leisure travelers alike.
shortDescription: An enchanting 4N/5D private tropical escape sweeping through the misty tea gardens of Munnar, serene Kumarakom, and a luxury Alleppey houseboat.
highlights: Wander through the vast, mist-draped tea gardens and roaring mountain waterfalls of Munnar.
Glide through the serene, palm-fringed lake waters of Kumarakom on a dedicated private boat cruise.
Stay overnight on a traditional luxury houseboat drifting down the famous backwaters of Alleppey.
Savor authentic local Keralan delicacies prepared fresh on-board by your private houseboat chef.
Enjoy completely seamless, private vehicle transits between the mountains and coastal backwaters.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi | Kerala Waterfall Tour | Transfer to Munnar
itinerary.description: Welcome to Kerala! Upon arrival in Kochi, get transferred to Munnar. En route, witness the Valara Waterfalls, a natural wonder nestled in the lush greenery of the Western Ghats. Also, marvel at the cascading waters plunging down rocky cliffs & take in the fresh mountain air. Next, visit the Cheeyappara Waterfalls, known for its seven-step cascades that flow through a verdant landscape. After an amazing waterfall tour, continue your journey, & upon arrival, check-in for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Ayur Green Resort and Spa / Princes De Munnar / Similar

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, explore Munnar on a sightseeing tour & visit the Echo Point, renowned for its natural acoustics, where voices echo amidst the stunning surroundings. Next, visit the Mattupetty Dam & soak-in the beauty of the Western Ghats. Continue to Kundala Lake, where you can indulge in a boat ride on the calming lake & visit the Eravikulam National Park, home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr. Also, learn about the tea-making process at Sevenmallay Tea Estate before getting driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Ayur Green Resort and Spa / Princes De Munnar / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kumarakom | Kumarakom Boat Cruise Experience
itinerary.description: Post check-out, get transferred to Kumarakom. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax for a while. Later, get ready and board your transfer to the Kumarakom boat jetty for an unforgettable cruise experience through the calming backwaters. As you sail along the waters, soak-in the stunning views of lush green shores & amazing landscapes while observing the local village life unfolding along the banks. Also, get a chance to spot a variety of bird species before getting driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Lake Palace Family Resort, Kumarakom / Royal Riviera Hotels and Resorts, Kumarakom  / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Alleppey | Overnight Houseboat Stay Experience
itinerary.description: After check-out, get driven to Alleppey, known as the "Venice of India." Along the way, soak-in the amazing landscapes of Kerala's lush greenery & vibrant scenery. Upon arrival, step aboard your houseboat and glide through the enchanting backwaters, where gently swaying palm trees, lush paddy fields, and quaint villages paint a picturesque backdrop. Also, take in the sights of daily life along the banks & enjoy your delicious meal onboard. Later, enjoy a stunning overnight houseboat stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Standard Houseboat / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kochi | Departure Day
itinerary.description: Today, after disembarking from the houseboat, board your transfer to Kochi Airport/Railway Station/Bus Station, where your memorable trip comes to an end!

name: Tales of Kerala | Coconut Groves and Hill Stations
description:
Immerse yourself in the ultimate south Indian escape with our 'Kerala Scenic Trio | Munnar, Thekkady, and Kumarakom' vacation package. Beautifully designed across 4 Nights and 5 Days on a completely private basis, this high-converting itinerary is tailor-made for families, couples, and premium group tours seeking a perfect balance of high-altitude nature, rich cultural heritage, and deep coastal relaxation.

Your journey begins with a scenic drive from Cochin, leading up to the cool, emerald tea gardens of Munnar for a two-night stay. Here, you'll experience custom plantation trails alongside options to witness vibrant Kathakali dance routines and ancient Kalaripayattu martial arts shows. Next, journey deep into the wildlife-rich hills of Thekkady for an overnight stay, featuring a guided walk through aromatic spice plantations and local culinary paths. Conclude your spectacular circuit along the calm, palm-fringed lake banks of Kumarakom with a tranquil waterfront stay, wrapping up with a heritage loop through old Fort Kochi. Complete with handpicked accommodations, private car transits, and daily fresh breakfasts, this loop offers a flawless tropical recharge.
shortDescription: An exquisite 4N/5D private tour charting the misty hills of Munnar, wild spice valleys of Thekkady, and the serene lake waters of Kumarakom.

name: Best of Kerala | From Houseboat Stays to Hilltop Views
description:
Discover the perfect introduction to 'God's Own Country' with our thoughtfully curated 'Best of Kerala | From Houseboat Stays to Hilltop Views' travel package. Masterfully arranged across 3 Nights and 4 Days on a completely private basis, this high-converting itinerary is specifically engineered for travelers looking to experience Kerala's most iconic landscapes—rolling green hills and tranquil coastal backwaters—within a time-efficient, action-packed short holiday.

Your private retreat starts with a scenic mountain transit from Kochi, taking you past roaring roadside waterfalls directly into the cool air of Munnar for a two-night stay. Immerse yourself in the mountains with a full-day Munnar highlights tour, featuring an exclusive complimentary Shikara boat ride on the serene lake waters. From the hills, descend to the historic coast of Alleppey for a one-night stay. Here, you will step aboard a traditional Keralan houseboat for an immersive backwater day cruise complete with a freshly prepared local lunch, followed by a heritage tour covering Alleppey Beach, the historic Lighthouse, and the sacred Mullakkal Temple. Complete with handpicked accommodations, private car transits, and flexible breakfast plans, this package delivers a seamless tropical refresh.

name: Romantic Escape to Kerala | From Tea Estates to Golden Sands
description:
Celebrate your new beginning with our crown-jewel honeymoon itinerary, the 'Romantic Escape to Kerala | From Tea Estates to Golden Sands'. Artfully orchestrated across 6 Nights and 7 Days on a completely private, premium basis, this sweeping couple's circuit is meticulously designed to showcase the full geographical romance of South India—guiding you smoothly from misty high-altitude cloud forests down to tranquil hidden backwaters and dramatic cliffside ocean sands.

Your private love story unfolds with two nights in the cool, emerald tea gardens of Munnar, featuring a dedicated couple's sightseeing loop, an exclusive couple's photoshoot against panoramic backdrops, and flexible evening slots to witness ancient Kathakali arts. Next, venture deep into the wild spice valleys of Thekkady for an aromatic plantation walk and a cozy overnight stay. From the hills, transition to the timeless backwaters of Alleppey to embark on a romantic houseboat day cruise complete with a traditional lunch prepared fresh on deck, followed by a cozy coastal overnight stay. Your grand finale brings you south, pausing to marvel at the colossal rock sculpture of the Jatayu Earth Center, before checking in for two ultra-luxurious nights in Kovalam. Complete with a magical candlelit dinner under the stars, a private boat safari through the mangrove forests of Poovar Island, and a spiritual heritage visit to Trivandrum’s Padmanabhaswamy Temple, this package is a masterfully crafted blueprint for a lifetime of memories.

name: Kerala Scenic Trio | Munnar, Thekkady, and Kumarakom
description:
Immerse yourself in the ultimate South Indian getaway with our expertly designed 'Kerala Scenic Trio | Munnar, Thekkady, and Kumarakom' holiday package. Tailor-made across 4 Nights and 5 Days on a completely private basis, this highly attractive itinerary is engineered to deliver a seamless balance of high-altitude nature, rich cultural arts, and soothing lakeside relaxation.

Your tropical journey starts with a scenic drive from Kochi past cascading waterfalls, bringing you directly into the emerald, cloud-kissed tea estates of Munnar for a two-night resort stay. Here, enjoy a comprehensive highlights tour alongside options to witness stunning evening Kathakali dances and historic martial arts performances. Next, venture deep into the wildlife-rich hills of Thekkady for an overnight stay, featuring a fascinating guided walk through aromatic spice plantations. Conclude your spectacular holiday along the peaceful, palm-fringed lake banks of Kumarakom with a serene waterfront stay, wrapping up with a heritage sightseeing tour through historic Fort Kochi. Complete with handpicked properties, dedicated private transits, and an included MAP meal plan covering your daily breakfasts and warm dinners, this package ensures an unforgettable, stress-free escape.

name: Getaway to Kerala | Unveiling the Green Tapestry & Scenic
description:
Unveil the pristine natural beauty, tropical rhythms, and diverse landscapes of South India with our comprehensive 'Getaway to Kerala | Unveiling the Green Tapestry & Scenic Waterways' travel package. Masterfully woven across 5 Nights and 6 Days on a completely private basis, this highly engaging itinerary is specifically engineered for active families, couples, and fast-paced explorers wanting to capture the complete cross-section of Kerala's famous hill stations, wildlife trails, historic backwaters, and pristine southern beaches.

Your private expedition launches with a scenic transfer from Kochi past cascading mountain waterfalls into the emerald, cloud-kissed tea estates of Munnar for a two-night stay, highlighted by a custom city tour and a complimentary, romantic Shikara lake boat ride. Next, venture deep into the wild spice valleys of Thekkady for a fascinating guided plantation walk and local food trails. Descend from the hills to the historic canals of Alleppey to experience a traditional backwater houseboat day cruise with a freshly prepared lunch, followed by a cozy coastal overnight stay. Conclude your grand loop along the iconic crescent shores of Kovalam for a relaxing beachside getaway, wrapping up with a cultural heritage tour through majestic Trivandrum. Complete with selected accommodations, dedicated private transits, and daily fresh breakfast spreads, this package serves as the ultimate tropical circuit.

highlights: Enjoy a scenic mountain drive from Kochi to Munnar, pausing to admire beautiful en-route waterfalls.
Wander through Munnar's sprawling, emerald tea estates and enjoy a peaceful, complimentary Shikara lake boat ride.
Take a fascinating guided walk past cardamom, pepper, and vanilla vines in a premium Thekkady spice plantation.
Glide past tranquil canal villages on a traditional backwater houseboat day cruise in Alleppey.
Savor an authentic, freshly prepared Keralan traditional lunch served right on board the day cruise boat.
Unwind along the sunny crescent beaches of Kovalam and explore the historic heritage of Trivandrum city.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi | Transfer to Munnar | En Route Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Kochi, you will be driven to Munnar. En route, cross the Neriamangalam Bridge, the historic gateway to Idukki. Also, make a stop at the Cheeyappara Waterfalls, known for its striking seven-tiered cascade & Valara Waterfalls, set amidst dense forests where a rich diversity of birdlife exist. Don't miss visiting Pottas Fun Farm, where outdoor activities, where you can try activities giant swing & ziplining. Later, continue towards Munnar. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Bamboo Dale Resort, Munnar / Similar

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, explore Munnar on a sightseeing tour. Begin at Carmelagiri Elephant Park, where close encounters with elephants make for a memorable experience. Also, visit Mattupetty Dam, admired for its serene reservoir. Also, visit Pullu Medu Elephant Viewpoint, offering views of misty landscapes & occasional elephant sightings & Yellapatty Grasslands, known for their wild blooms. End with a scenic shikara ride at Kundala Lake, where you can relax while admiring the surrounding landscapes.
itinerary.accommodation: Bamboo Dale Resort, Munnar / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Thekkady | Thekkady Sightseeing Tour | Spice Plantation & Food Tour
itinerary.description: Check out & get transferred to Thekkady. On arrival, explore through Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary & witness diverse fauna like elephants, deer & colorful birdlife in their natural surroundings. Continue to Elephant Junction & try riding, feeding, or bathing these gentle animals. Then, enjoy a guided walk through a spice plantation, learning the origins of Kerala’s renowned spices, before joining a local food tour to savor the flavors of Kerala. After that, get driven to the hotel & check in.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Sandra Palace / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Alleppey | Alleppey Houseboat Day Cruise | Alleppey Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Check out & get transferred to Alleppey. Once you reach, step aboard a traditional houseboat & cruise through backwaters lined with swaying palms & paddy fields. Also, relish a freshly prepared Kerala lunch on board as you drift past village life along these calm waterways. Later, continue on an Alleppey sightseeing tour, strolling along Alleppey Beach, known for its sunset views & visiting the Mullakkal Rajarajeswari Temple, dedicated to Goddess Durga. Later, get driven to the hotel & check in.
itinerary.accommodation: Alleppey Haven Beach Villa / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Varkala | En route visit to to Jatayu Earth Center | Varkala Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, check out & get driven Jatayu Earth’s Centre, home to world’s largest bird sculpture, where you can enjoy cable car ride (extra cost) offering views of surrounding hills & monument. Then, continue to Varkala & upon arriving, visit Varkala Beach, famed for its red cliffs. Also, explore Kappil Beach, where the backwaters meet the Arabian Sea. Don't miss Janardhana Swami Temple, a shrine dedicated to Lord Vishnu. Later, get driven to the hotel. Once you reach, check in for overnight stay.
activities: Trip to Jatayu Earth Center, Kerala Ticket Not Included
itinerary.accommodation: Utopia Varkala / Similare

itinerary.title: Transfer to Trivandrum | Trivandrum Sightseeing Tour | Departure Day
itinerary.description: Check out & you'll be driven to Trivandrum. Once you reach, explore the city on a sightseeing tour. Visit sacred Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, known for its magnificent Dravidian architecture & Napier Museum, where rare artifacts, ancient ornaments & bronze idols highlight Kerala’s artistic traditions. Conclude at Kuthiramalika Palace Museum, famous for its intricate horse carvings. Afterwards, you will be transferred to Trivandrum Airport/Railway Station, where your trip ends.

name: Kerala Family Delight
description:
Treat your loved ones to the perfect tropical holiday with our thoughtfully curated 'Kerala Family Delight with FREE Tickets to Napier Museum' vacation package. Artfully paced across 4 Nights and 5 Days on a completely private basis, this high-converting itinerary is specifically engineered for multi-generational families looking to experience the absolute highlights of South India's pristine southern coastline and winding backwater networks without any rush.

Your private family escape features a relaxing overnight stay along the famous crescent beaches of Kovalam, paired with a fascinating heritage excursion to Trivandrum highlighted by exclusive complimentary entry tickets to the historic Napier Museum—a magnificent 19th-century architectural marvel packing rare bronze idols and ancient artifacts. From the coast, venture into the peaceful backwater networks for an overnight stay in Kumarakom, featuring an exclusive private boat cruise across Vembanad Lake. Continue the magic into Alleppey, checking into a traditional luxury houseboat or backwater resort where your family will enjoy . Complete with seamless private car transits, flexible child-friendly setups, and dedicated sightseeing loops up to Kochi, this package promises an unforgettable family bonding experience.. Complete with seamless private car transits, flexible child-friendly setups, and dedicated sightseeing loops up to Kochi, this package promises an unforgettable family bonding experience.
shortDescription: A beautiful 4N/5D private family vacation capturing the beaches of Kovalam, heritage museum lanes, a private Kumarakom boat cruise, and an Alleppey houseboat.
highlights: Relax and watch your kids play along the sunny, iconic crescent shores of Kovalam Beach.
Explore beautiful Indo-Saracenic history with free entry to Trivandrum's historic Napier Museum.
Glide past tranquil canal villages together on an exclusive private boat cruise in Kumarakom.
Discover the colonial heritage of Kochi and old Fort town networks on a private family sightseeing loop.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Trivandrum | Transfer to Kovalam
itinerary.description: Welcome to Kerala. Upon arrival in Trivandrum, you will get transferred to Kovalam. Check in at the hotel & relax. You will spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can relax at Samudra Beach, known for its scenic sunsets, and visit the Kovalam Art Gallery, home to various paintings and artefacts. You can also visit Kumari Amman Temple, dedicated to the goddess Parvathi. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Swagath Holiday Resort /  Hotel Port Palace / Similar

itinerary.title: Kovalam Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, explore Kovalam on a sightseeing tour. Start at Kovalam Beach & enjoy a leisurely stroll along the golden sands. Next, visit the stunning Hawa Beach and Lighthouse Beach, both offering amazing coastal views. Then, climp up the Kovalam Lighthouse (extra cost) & soak-in the views of the Arabian Sea. Later, marvel at the towering 58-foot Gangadhareshwara Shiva Statue at the Azhimala Shiva Temple & soak in the peaceful ambiance of this cliffside temple before getting driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Swagath Holiday Resort /  Hotel Port Palace / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Alleppey | Houseboat Stay Experience
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel in Trivandrum and get transferred to Alleppey. Upon arrival, check in at your houseboat and relax. Enjoy the views of the surroundings as you sail past various paddy fields and coconut trees. Moreover, witness a beautiful sunset against the scenic backdrop as you enjoy a hearty meal on the houseboat freshly prepared for you. Enjoy your overnight stay on the houseboat.
itinerary.accommodation: Standard Houseboat

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kumarakom | Kumarakom Boat Cruise Experience
itinerary.description: Disembark from the houseboat in Alleppey and get transferred to Kumarakom. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and relax. Later, you will get dirven to Kumarakom Boat Jetty and hop on a boat for your sightseeing tour. You will sail along the shores of Vembanad Lake, admiring the lush green surroundings and beautiful neighbourhoods from the boat. Following the boat tour, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Lake Palace Family Resort, Kumarakom / Royal Riviera Hotels and Resorts, Kumarakom / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get transferred to the Kochi airport/ railway station for your onward journey. This marks the end of your trip.

name: Spiritual Trails of South India | Flight Inclusive Deal
description:
Embark on a grand spiritual and scenic pilgrimage through the heart of the southern peninsula with our flagship 'Spiritual Trails of South India | Flight Inclusive Deal' premium tour. Seamlessly planned across 7 Nights and 8 Days, this highly comprehensive, multi-destination package takes care of every single travel detail—including round-trip flight transits from Delhi, private deluxe hotel overnights, and completely private sightseeing loops.

Your sacred journey launches with an inclusive flight from Delhi to the ancient heritage city of Madurai, where you will immediately check into a deluxe property and embark on a private tour of the architectural marvel that is the Meenakshi Amman Temple. From the vibrant plains, ascend into the cool, cloud-kissed hills of Kodaikanal for two refreshing nights of lakeside relaxation and panoramic forest sightseeing. Next, descend back to the coast to spend two deeply moving nights in the holy island town of Rameswaram, exploring its historic temple corridors and sacred bathing teerthams. Continue your trail to the absolute southernmost tip of mainland India at Kanyakumari to witness unforgettable multi-ocean sunsets, before winding down with a pristine beach stay in Kovalam. Conclude your lifetime voyage with a private spiritual heritage loop through Trivandrum's majestic Padmanabhaswamy Temple before your seamless return flight home.
shortDescription: An extraordinary 7N/8D flight-inclusive private circuit blending the sacred temple trails of Madurai, Rameswaram, and Kanyakumari with the misty hills of Kodaikanal and coastal Kovalam.
highlights: Marvel at the colossal, intricate sculpted gopurams of Madurai's historic Meenakshi Amman Temple.
Walk through the legendary, infinite pillared corridors of the sacred Ramanathaswamy Temple in Rameswaram.
Stand at the geographic tip of India in Kanyakumari to watch spectacular, multi-ocean sunsets.
Unwind along the peaceful, palm-fringed golden sands and crescent coastlines of Kovalam Beach.
Experience the majestic architectural beauty and profound serenity of Trivandrum’s Padmanabhaswamy Temple.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Madurai | Meenakshi Amman Temple Tour
itinerary.description: Board your flight from Delhi to Madurai. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check-in and rest for a while. Later, get driven to visit the iconic Meenakshi Amman Temple, a marvel of Dravidian architecture with its towering gopurams and intricate carvings. This temple, dedicated to Goddess Meenakshi and Lord Shiva, is one of the oldest and most revered sites for Hindus, known for its 33,000 sculptures. Afterward, you'll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel President, Madurai / JC Residency, Madurai / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kodaikanal | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Today, check out from the hotel and get driven to Kodaikanal. Upon arrival, check in and enjoy your day at leisure. You may choose to explore Kodaikanal Lake, a serene man-made lake ideal for boating and leisurely walks. Additionally, you can visit the Solar Observatory, one of India’s oldest observatories or explore the Guna Caves, surrounded by dense forests and dramatic rock formations. After your explorations, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Recommended Enrich your day with experiences Fill up your day with some of the highly recommended experiences.
itinerary.accommodation: SaffronStays Nandanvan Estate, Kodaikanal / Apple Valley High, Kodaikanal / Similar

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, get driven for a sightseeing tour. Begin with a visit to the Pillar Rocks, a stunning set of three giant rock formations offering panoramic views of the surrounding valleys. Next, visit Bear Shola Falls, nestled amidst lush greenery. Continue to Bryant Park, a beautifully landscaped garden known for its vibrant flowers. Also, enjoy a stroll along Coaker’s Walk, a cliffside pathway offering breathtaking views of the hills and valleys. Afterward, get driven back to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: SaffronStays Nandanvan Estate, Kodaikanal / Apple Valley High, Kodaikanal / Similar

itinerary.title: Arrival in Rameswaram| Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Today, check out and get driven to Rameswaram, a city deeply rooted in Hindu mythology. After checking in at the hotel, spend the rest of the day at your leisure. You can explore sites like Agniteertham, a sacred bathing spot, and Villoondi Tirtham, known for its spiritual significance and serene waters. Additionally, you can visit the iconic Annai Indira Gandhi Road Bridge and the stunning Pamban Bridge, before returning to the hotel.
activities: Annai Indira Gandhi Road Bridge Pamban Bridge
Recommended Enrich your day with experiences Fill up your day with some of the highly recommended experiences.

itinerary.title: Rameswaram Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with by getting transferred for a sightseeing tour of Rameswaram. Explore the magnificent Ramanathaswamy Temple, renowned for its stunning Dravidian architecture and sacred bathing tanks, making it one of India's most revered pilgrimage sites. Next, visit Gandhamadhana Parvatham, a spiritual spot believed to bear the footprint of Lord Rama, offering panoramic views of the island. After your tour, get driven back to the hotel for a restful overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Vel Residency Rameswaram / Hotel Ashoka, Rameshwaram / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kanyakumari | Lesirure Day
itinerary.description: Today, check out and get driven to Kanyakumari. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and enjoy the day at leisure. You can explore the city on your own, visiting attractions like the Thanumalayan Swamy Temple & Padmanabhapuram Palace. In the evening, you can unwind at Kanyakumari Beach, where the view of the sunset over the confluence of the three seas is simply breathtaking. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Recommended Enrich your day with experiences Fill up your day with some of the highly recommended experiences.

itinerary.title: Kanyakumari Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Kovalam | Kovalam Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Check out and get driven for a city tour. Begin with a visit to the Vivekananda Rock Memorial, offering breathtaking ocean views. Next, admire the impressive Thiruvalluvar Statue, and later, explore the Kumari Amman Temple, dedicated to Goddess Kanyakumari. Afterward, you'll be driven to Kovalam. Upon arrival, enjoy a sightseeing tour and visit the city's famous beaches, like Hawa Beach and Lighthouse Beach. Conclude with a visit to the Azhimala Shiva Temple before checking in to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Sagara Beach Resort, Kovalam / Hotel Opalo Kailas, Kovalam / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Trivandrum | Visit to Padmanabhaswamy Temple | Departure
itinerary.description: oday, check out from your hotel and get driven to Trivandrum. Upon arrival, visit the iconic Padmanabhaswamy Temple, a stunning example of Dravidian architecture, dedicated to Lord Vishnu, and famous for its intricate carvings and vast inner sanctum. Spend some time admiring the temple’s majestic structure and the sacred atmosphere. Afterward, you’ll be driven to the Trivandrum airport for your flight back home.

name: Hidden Gems of Kerala | A Passage Through Peaks and Shores
description:
Uncover the ultimate multi-terrain tropical journey with our masterfully curated 'Hidden Gems of Kerala | A Passage Through Peaks and Shores' vacation package. Spanning across 6 Nights and 7 Days on a completely private basis, this high-converting itinerary is specifically engineered for travelers, couples, and families seeking an upscale, comprehensive exploration of South India—seamlessly charting everything from emerald mountain plantations and raw jungle tracks to pristine backwaters and dramatic, world-famous coastal cliffs.

Your private passage opens with a scenic drive from Kochi past cascading waterfalls into the cool highlands of Munnar for a two-night resort stay, featuring a custom city tour and a complimentary, romantic Shikara lake boat ride. Next, journey deep into the wild valleys of Thekkady for an overnight stay, highlighted by a guided walk through aromatic spice plantations and immersive local culinary paths. Descend into the historic backwaters of Alleppey to enjoy an incredible houseboat day cruise with a fresh lunch, followed by a full-board overnight stay. From there, venture further south to witness the dramatic, sweeping seaside cliffs of Varkala, pause to marvel at the colossal rock sculpture of the Jatayu Earth Center, and unwind along the golden crescent beaches of Kovalam. Conclude your epic journey with a deep-dive spiritual heritage tour of Trivandrum's majestic Padmanabhaswamy Temple. Complete with premium handpicked properties, dedicated private transits, and flexible meal plans, this package stands as the definitive Kerala road trip.`
shortDescription: An extraordinary 6N/7D private expedition linking Munnar's mist-kissed peaks, wild spice trails, a traditional backwater cruise, and the breathtaking cliffs of Varkala and Kovalam.
highlights: Enjoy a scenic mountain drive from Kochi to Munnar, pausing to admire beautiful en-route waterfalls.
Take a fascinating guided walk past cardamom, pepper, and vanilla vines in a premium Thekkady spice plantation.
Glide past tranquil canal villages on a traditional backwater houseboat day cruise in Alleppey while savoring a fresh local lunch.
Watch an unforgettable sunset from the dramatic, world-famous red cliffs overlooking Varkala Beach.
Visit the historic colossal Jatayu Earth Center and explore the majestic architecture of Padmanabhaswamy Temple.

Continue to Hawa Beach & Lighthouse Beach, offering panoramic sea views, and climb the Kovalam Lighthouse (extra cost)—offering stunning views of the Arabian Sea. Conclude your day at the Azhimala Shiva Temple, home to the majestic 58-ft Gangadhareshwara Shiva Statue.

Continue to the Napier Museum, where rare artifacts and traditional ornaments highlight the region’s artistic heritage. Conclude with a visit to the Kuthiramalika Palace Museum, admired for its intricate wooden horse carvings. Later, get driven to Trivandrum Airport/Railway Station for your journey back home.

name: Splendid North Kerala Tour
description:
Discover the untouched beauty, hidden historic trails, and lush green highlands of the Malabar region with our 'Splendid North Kerala Tour' travel package. Thoughtfully arranged across 3 Nights and 4 Days on a completely private basis, this high-converting itinerary is specifically engineered for travelers, short-break holiday seekers, and families wanting to experience an authentic, crowd-free alternative to Southern Kerala by exploring pristine spice hills and historic coastal ports.

Your private Malabar expedition begins in the historic coastal city of Calicut (Kozhikode), famed for its culinary heritage and timeless spice ports, where you will enjoy a comfortable overnight stay. From the coast, experience a spectacular, scenic private road transit winding up through the legendary Thamarassery Thoppil Ghat mountain passes into the cloud-kissed hills of Wayanad for a two-night resort stay. Your time in the highlands features a comprehensive private Wayanad city tour tracking lush tea estates, followed by an exclusive private excursion to the magnificent Banasura Sagar Dam—the largest earthen dam in India and the second largest in all of Asia. Complete with handpicked accommodations, dedicated private vehicle transits, and fresh daily breakfasts, this package delivers a flawless northern escape.
shortDescription: A captivating 3N/4D private exploration showcasing the historic coastal charm of Calicut and the mist-shrouded peaks, waterfalls, and earthen dams of Wayanad.
highlights: Explore the historic coastal streets, culinary heritage, and beach culture of Calicut (Kozhikode).
Drive up the breathtaking mountain curves of the Thamarassery Ghat road into the clouds.
Wander through Wayanad’s pristine, mist-shrouded spice valleys and emerald tea plantations.
Marvel at the spectacular island vistas surrounding the massive Banasura Sagar Earthen Dam.
Enjoy a completely flexible, fully private sightseeing circuit tailored perfectly to your pace.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kozhikode[Calicut] Gateway to Enchantment
itinerary.description: Namaskaram, welcome to the City of Spices - Calicut! Upon your arrival at the Kozhikode[Calicut] railway station/airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Once you check-in, the rest of the day is yours to rest and rejuvenate. You can spend time at Kozhikode Beach, explore SM street to try the local delicacies or shop for souvenirs. Afterwards, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Wayanad | En route Lakkidi View Point & Pookode Lake

On the way, take a stop at Lakkidi View Point aka Gateway of Wayanad, and take in the picturesque views of lush green valleys. Then, head towards Pookode Lake and take a walk through the lakeside pathway or you can enjoy some water sports like boating and kayaking [at an extra cost]. Post the sightseeing, reach Wayanad - the Ooty of Kerala and check in to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Wayanad Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you'll be taken for a sightseeing tour of Wayanad. During the tour, you'll visit the famous Edakkal Caves, situated about 1200 ft above sea level. Then, head to Soochipara Falls, also known as Sentinel Rock Waterfalls via a thrilling jungle trek of about 1 km. Once you reach the falls, soak in the beautiful views of nature and enjoy swimming or rock climbing. Later, trek down and get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

Then, continue to Kozhikode[Calicut] railway station/airport where you'll catch your transfer back home.

name: Glimpse of Kerala | Waterfalls, Wildlife and Winding Roads
description:
Capture the absolute essence of South India's pristine mountain country with our beautifully paced 'Glimpse of Kerala | Waterfalls, Wildlife and Winding Roads' travel package. Masterfully scaled across 3 Nights and 4 Days on a completely private basis, this high-energy holiday loop is tailor-made for corporate professionals, weekenders, and families craving a crisp mountain reset without extended travel timelines.

Your private expedition kicks off with a scenic drive up from Kochi, winding past roaring roadside waterfalls directly into the cool air of Munnar for a two-night stay. Immerse yourself in the hills with a full-day Munnar highlights tour, featuring an exclusive complimentary Shikara boat ride on the serene lake waters. From the tea estates, head further into the Western Ghats to spend an overnight stay in the wild valley of Thekkady. Here, you will experience an incredible guided walk through aromatic spice plantations and enjoy local street food trails, before a smooth, scenic return drive back to Kochi. Complete with handpicked properties, dedicated private vehicle transits, and fresh daily breakfasts, this smart loop strips away travel hassle to deliver a flawless mountain escape.
shortDescription: A refreshing 3N/4D private mountain breakout blending Munnar's mist-covered tea gardens and a complimentary Shikara ride with the wild spice paths of Thekkady.
highlights: Enjoy a scenic mountain drive from Kochi to Munnar, pausing to admire beautiful en-route waterfalls.
Wander through Munnar's sprawling, emerald tea estates and enjoy a peaceful, complimentary Shikara lake boat ride.
Take a fascinating guided walk past cardamom, pepper, and vanilla vines in a premium spice plantation.
Dive into local food culture with an optional immersive culinary trail through Thekkady's markets.
Maximize your short break with a professionally managed, completely private mountain loop.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi | Transfer to Munnar | En Route Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Welcome! Upon arrival in Kochi, get driven to Munnar. Enroute, admire the beauty of various gems of Kerala. Cross the iconic Neriamangalam Bridge, often called Gateway to Idukki. Then, make a stop at the cascading Cheeyappara Waterfalls & the nearby Valara Waterfalls, both set amidst lush greenery & misty hills. Add a touch of adventure at Pottas Fun Farm, where you can enjoy fun activities like giant swing & ziplining. Afterwards, continue towards Munnar. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, explore Munnar on a sightseeing tour. Explore, Carmelagiri Elephant Park, where you can enjoy an elephant ride & have close interactions with them. Next, visit Pullu Medu Elephant Viewpoint, where, if you're lucky enough, you might spot a herd of elephants grazing around. Also, stroll at Yellapatty Grasslands, known for offering panoramic views of Munnar’s greenery. Don't miss visiting Kundala Lake, where you can relax in the peaceful ambience of the place while enjoying a shikara ride.

Also, spend time at Elephant Junction & interact with elephants by riding or feeding them. Then, stroll through the spice garden, discovering its secrets. While there, you can also visit honey bee farm. Post that, get driven for a food tour, savoring authentic flavors of Kerala. Afterwards, get driven to the hotel & check in for an overnight stay.

name: Munnar Weekend Getaway from Chennai | Lush Hills & Tea Gardens
description:
Trade the humid coastal heat of Chennai for the crisp, cloud-kissed heights of the Western Ghats with our premium 'Munnar Weekend Getaway from Chennai | Lush Hills & Tea Gardens' vacation bundle. Artfully structured across 3 Nights and 4 Days, this flight-inclusive private tour takes care of every single transit detail—including your round-trip economy flights between Chennai and Kochi, select resort accommodations, and dedicated private vehicle sightseeing.

Your refreshing mountain break launches with a quick flight from Chennai to Kochi, where a private vehicle meets you for a spectacular drive winding past cascading roadside waterfalls directly into the emerald valley of Munnar. Enjoy a luxurious three-night stay dedicated completely to relaxation and exploration. Your time in the hills features two full days of intensive private sightseeing covering sprawling tea estates, panoramic viewpoints, and aromatic spice trails, alongside flexible evening options to experience traditional Kathakali dance and Kalaripayattu martial arts shows. Conclude your weekend recharge with a heritage loop through historic Fort Kochi before your smooth flight back home. This smart, high-converting loop strips away all booking hassle to deliver the ultimate luxury long-weekend escape.

name: Offshore Romance | Couple Tour Package of Andaman
description:
Celebrate love amidst the turquoise waters of the Bay of Bengal with our 'Offshore Romance | Couple Tour Package of Andaman' vacation loop. Beautifully orchestrated across 4 Nights and 5 Days on a private basis, this high-converting couple's itinerary is specifically engineered for newlyweds and romantic holiday seekers looking to experience the perfect mix of colonial island history, vibrant coral reefs, and legendary tropical beaches.

Your private romantic journey begins with a warm welcome at Port Blair's Veer Savarkar International Airport, transferring you directly to a comfortable standard property. Spend your time in the capital exploring the coconut-fringed shores of Corbyn's Cove Beach, witnessing the moving light and sound history of the historic Cellular Jail, and sailing to the beautiful coral-rich bays of North Bay and Ross Island. Next, cross the azure sea to the iconic Havelock Island for a magical overnight stay. Here, you and your partner will experience dedicated private transits to the world-famous, crescent-shaped Radhanagar Beach—famed for its breathtaking sunsets—and the quiet, turquoise waters of Kalapathar Beach. Complete with handpicked double-sharing accommodations, seamless airport transits, and fresh daily breakfasts, this package stands as the ultimate blueprint for a lifetime of tropical memories.
shortDescription: An enchanting 4N/5D romantic island escape blending the historic lanes of Port Blair with the pristine, world-famous white sands of Havelock Island.
highlights: Stroll hand-in-hand along the serene, palm-fringed sands of Corbyn's Cove Beach.
Witness the powerful, historic Light and Sound Show at the iconic Cellular Jail.
Explore the colonial ruins of Ross Island and discover vibrant marine life at North Bay.
Watch an unforgettable tropical sunset together on the world-renowned Radhanagar Beach.
Unwind along the quiet, striking turquoise waters and white sands of Kalapathar Beach.

Next, visit the Cellular Jail and experience a poignant light and sound show that vividly recounts the struggles of India's freedom fighters. Later, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.

Afterwards, get driven to one of Asia's most beautiful beaches, the Radhanagar Beach, known for its stunning sunsets and crystal-clear waters. name: Andaman Family Escape | From Nature Trails to Seaside Shores
description:
Gather your loved ones for the definitive tropical holiday with our flagship 'Andaman Family Escape | From Nature Trails to Seaside Shores' vacation package. Thoughtfully arranged across 7 Nights and 8 Days on a completely private basis, this high-converting premium itinerary is specifically engineered for multi-generational families. It bridges the deep colonial history of Port Blair, the raw jungle nature trails of Baratang, and the stunning seaside shores of Havelock and Neil Islands into a seamless, hassle-free escape.

Your private family adventure kicks off at Port Blair with a warm welcome and check-in at the comfortable SR Castle hotel. Over four comprehensive nights in the capital, your family will explore the historic walls of the Cellular Jail for its moving Light and Sound show, walk the coconut-lined shores of Corbyn's Cove Beach, and cruise out to the coral-rich waters of North Bay and historic Ross Island. The ultimate nature highlight features a thrilling day trip to Baratang Island, slicing through dense mangrove forests to witness ancient limestone caves. Next, sail away to the world-famous Havelock Island for two luxurious nights to experience the mesmerizing sands of Radhanagar Beach and an adventure-filled trip to Elephant Beach with included water sports. Wrap up your island-hopping voyage with a relaxing night on Neil Island, marveling at the natural rock formation of the Howrah Bridge, the sunset at Laxmanpur Beach, and a thrilling glass-bottom boat ride over Bharatpur's reefs. Complete with handpicked accommodations, dedicated private transits, and daily fresh breakfasts, this package promises a beautiful family bonding experience.
shortDescription: Short Description An ultimate 7N/8D private family island expedition threading through Port Blair's historic trails, Baratang's limestone caves, Havelock's white sands, and Neil's coral beaches.
highlights: Enjoy comfortable, family-friendly hotel check-ins at pre-vetted properties like SR Castle.
Witness the moving, historic Light and Sound Show at the iconic Cellular Jail.
Journey through the heart of the island's tribal reserves and mangrove creeks to Baratang's caves.
Walk along the soft white sands of Radhanagar Beach, voted among the best in Asia.
Spot beautiful marine life without swimming during a family-friendly glass-bottom boat ride.
Capture unique family photos by the breathtaking natural rock formations of Neil's Howrah Bridge.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair | Visit to Cellular Jail & Light & Sound Show
itinerary.description: Welcome to Andaman! Upon arrival at Port Blair airport, get transferred to your hotel for check-in. Later, get driven to the iconic Cellular Jail to explore its historic cell blocks and gallows. In the evening, experience the Light & Sound Show that brings India’s freedom struggle to life. Post that, get transferred to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
activities: Visit Cellular Jail and Watch the Light and Sound Show
itinerary.accommodation: SR Castle Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Trip to Ross Island & North Bay
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to Aberdeen Jetty & take the boat to North Bay Island. On arrival, enjoy a glass-bottom boat ride for a glimpse of colorful corals & marine life beneath the clear waters. For a closer experience, you can also try snorkeling or other exciting water activities (at extra cost). Afterwards, continue to Ross Island. Explore the historic ruins now full of greenery & spot free-roaming deer & peacocks as you stroll around the island. Later, get transferred back to the hotel.
activities: Ross Bay And North Bay Tour
itinerary.accommodation: SR Castle Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Bartang Island
itinerary.description: Today, drive along the Andaman Trunk Road, passing through the dense Jarawa Reserve Forest on the way to Middle Strait Jetty. From the jetty point, take the ferry to Baratang Island. On arrival, take a boat ride through winding mangrove creeks, where arching roots create fascinating natural tunnels over the water. Disembark & follow a short jungle trail to Limestone Caves, where centuries-old formations showcase nature’s artistry. After exploring, you'll be transferred back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: SR Castle Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Corbyn Beach & Chidiya Tapu Beach
itinerary.description: Today, begin your day with a visit to Corbyn’s Cove Beach, a palm-lined shoreline close to Port Blair where you can relax by the waves, enjoy a swim, or try water activities (at extra cost). Later, get driven Chidiya Tapu Beach, also called the Sunset Point of the Andamans & marvel at its mangrove forests & beautiful coral-fringed coastline. Stay back & watch the sun painting the sky in shades of orange & pink. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: SR Castle Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Havelock Island | Visit to Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: Post check-out, get driven to Phoenix Bay Harbor & take the ferry to Havelock Island, enjoying scenic views of the sea along the way. On arrival, get driven to the hotel & check-in. Later, visit the world-famous Radhanagar Beach. Spend time strolling barefoot along the shoreline, swimming in the calm lagoon, or relaxing under the shade of tropical trees. You can also taste a few local snacks from small stalls near the entrance (cost not included). Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Haywizz Havelock Island Resort / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Elephant Beach
itinerary.description: In the morning, get driven to Havelock Jetty & board a speedboat sailing across the sparkling blue waters to reach Elephant Beach, one of island’s most popular spots. On arrival, enjoy various activities like snorkelling over the shallow reef, experiencing the unique sea walk, riding a banana boat with friends & feeling the thrill of a jet ski. Between adventures, you can relax on the soft sandy shore or capture stunning photos of the turquoise lagoon. Later, get transferred back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Haywizz Havelock Island Resort / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Neil Island | Visit to Bharatpur & Laxmanpur Beach
itinerary.description: Post check-out, get driven to Havelock Harbor & take the ferry to Neil Island. On arrival, you'll be driven to the hotel & check-in. Later, visit Bharatpur Beach, known for its shallow lagoon & vibrant marine life to enjoy a glass-bottom boat ride to spot colourful corals & tropical fish beneath the clear waters. Continue to Laxmanpur Beach & stay back to watch the sky transform into shades of orange & gold during one of the island’s most beautiful sunsets. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
activities: Neil Island Tour - Glass-Bottom Boat Ride at Bharatpur Beach + Sunset at Laxmanpur Beach
itinerary.accommodation: Pearl Park Beach Resort / Similar

itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from the hotel & get driven to Neil Island Port to baord the ferry to Port Blair. Upon arrival, get transferred to the airport to board the flight back home. This is where your trip ends.

name: Luxury Underwater Romance in Andaman | 5-Star Beachfront Escape
description:
Indulge in the pinnacle of island opulence with our 'Luxury Underwater Romance in Andaman' flagship package. Exclusively curated for those who demand the finest, this 5 Night / 6 Day private retreat pairs the architectural grandeur of Symphony Samudra in Port Blair with the intimate, rustic-luxe charm of private Chalets at Sea Shell Havelock.

Your journey begins with a private luxury escort from the airport to the stunning Symphony Samudra, nestled beside a tropical reserve and the ocean. Over three nights, you will explore the historic Cellular Jail and Corbyn’s Cove Beach via a dedicated executive vehicle, followed by a high-adventure private Jalki Jeep Safari to the rare mud volcanoes of Baratang Island. The romance heightens as you sail to Havelock Island to check into your premium 5-star Chalet at Sea Shell. Experience the world-renowned Radhanagar Beach, the tranquil turquoise tides of Kalapathar, and the vibrant coral reefs of Elephant Beach—all with the seamless service and privacy that only a top-tier luxury package can provide. With daily gourmet breakfast spreads and elite beachfront properties, this is more than a holiday; it is a masterclass in tropical romance.
shortDescription: An elite 5N/6D romantic odyssey featuring 5-star beachfront luxury at Symphony Samudra and private beach chalets at Sea Shell Havelock.
highlights: Elite Private Sightseeing Across Radhanagar, Kalapathar, and Elephant Beach
Experience the breathtaking sunset views and jungle-meets-ocean luxury of Symphony Samudra.
Stay in an intimate, 5-star wooden Chalet at Sea Shell Havelock, steps away from the shoreline.
Witness the moving Light & Sound Show at Cellular Jail with premium private transits.

Stroll along Radhanagar Beach, Asia's finest, during the golden sunset hour.
Explore vibrant underwater ecosystems at Elephant Beach via private boat transfers.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Andaman! Upon arrival at the airport, you will be transferred to your hotel for check-in. Spend the day unwinding at the resort, enjoying its amenities, taking in the tropical surroundings, and exploring beaches like Wandoor Beach and Munda Pahad Beach, on your own. This day allows you to settle in, acclimatise, and prepare for the adventures ahead, followed by a peaceful overnight stay at your Port Blair hotel.
activities: Enrich your day with experiences Fill up your day with some of the highly recommended experiences.
itinerary.accommodation: Symphony Samudra, Port Blair / Similar

itinerary.title: Explore Corbyn’s Cove Beach | Visit to Cellular Jail | Light & Sound Show
itinerary.description: In the morning, get transferred to Corbyn’s Cove Beach for a relaxing stroll. Then, head to the historic Cellular Jail, exploring its remaining cell blocks, gallows area, and informative galleries. In the evening, witness the dramatic Light & Sound Show at Cellular Jail, bringing India’s struggle for independence vividly to life, then get driven to the hotel for overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Symphony Samudra, Port Blair / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Baratang Island
itinerary.description: On this day, enjoy a drive along the Andaman Trunk Road & pass through the dense Jarawa Reserve Forest. Continue to Middle Strait Jetty & board the ferry across the narrow channel to Baratang Island. Upon reaching, take a boat ride through the mangrove creeks and later, trek a short jungle trail to reach Limestone Caves. Post that, get transferred back to your hotel in Port Blair for a comfortable overnight stay, reflecting on a day full of adventure and exploration.
itinerary.accommodation: Symphony Samudra, Port Blair / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Havelock Island | Visit to Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get driven to Phoenix Bay Harbour to board your ferry to Havelock Island. Upon arrival at Havelock Island, get transferred to your hotel, check in and rest for some time. Later, visit the famous Radhanagar Beach, one of Asia’s most beautiful beaches. Walk along the golden sands, swim in turquoise waters, and capture stunning sunset moments. Post that, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Sea Shell Havelock (Chalet) / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Elephant Beach
itinerary.description: Today, get transferred from the hotel to the Havelock Jetty and board a speedboat from there to sail across the clear blue waters to reach Elephant Beach. Upon reaching, enjoy thrilling water sports, such as snorkelling, sea walking, banana boat rides, and jet skiing. Admire the vibrant coral reefs and marine life before taking a speed boat ride back to Havelock Jetty. From them, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Sea Shell Havelock (Chalet) / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Port Blair | Departure Day
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and get driven to Havelock Island Harbor to board a morning ferry to Phoenix Bay Harbor. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to Veer Savarkar International Airport for your onward flight, completing your memorable family holiday.

name: Lavish Tropical Retreat in the Andamans
description:
Indulge in the pinnacle of island luxury with our masterfully curated 'Lavish Tropical Retreat in the Andamans' flagship vacation package. Artfully orchestrated across 6 Nights and 7 Days, this premium itinerary blends high-end 3 to 4-star resort hospitality with an incredible balance of exclusive privacy and vibrant social cruises—making it a top-tier choice for couples, luxury seekers, and discerning families alike.

Your tropical escape opens with an elite private escort from Veer Savarkar International Airport to your luxury property in Port Blair. Spend your time in the capital exploring the historic Cellular Jail, relaxing along Corbyn's Cove Beach, and sailing out to the picturesque coral ecosystems of Ross and North Bay. The ultimate nature highlight features a completely private, ruggedly refined day expedition to Baratang Island, where you will board an exclusive Jalki Jeep Safari to witness rare mud volcanoes. Next, cross the azure sea to Havelock Island to check into a breathtaking beachfront resort for two nights of pure bliss. Sink your toes into the world-renowned sands of Radhanagar Beach, view the turquoise waters of Kalapathar, and discover the vibrant coral beds of Elephant Beach via curated shared cruises. Returning to the capital for a final night of premium relaxation, this package promises a seamless, deeply rejuvenating island getaway.
shortDescription: An elite 6N/7D oceanfront odyssey pairing opulent 3 to 4 -star resort stays, a private Baratang Jeep Safari, and shared cruises to Havelock’s iconic white sands.
highlights: Experience the breathtaking ocean vistas and world-class hospitality of handpicked 5-star resorts.
Witness the powerful history and moving architecture of the historic Cellular Jail.
Journey deep into Baratang's dense reserves via an exclusive private Jalki Jeep Safari.
Savor a golden sunset over the soft, world-renowned white sands of Radhanagar Beach.
Cruise out to Elephant Beach and the pristine coral reefs of North Bay to see vibrant marine life.
Enjoy completely seamless interisland ferry tracking and point-to-point private airport transfers.

name: Honeymoon Escape to Andaman | Romantic Beaches & Island Adventures
description:
Celebrate your new journey together with our 'Honeymoon Escape to Andaman' package, designed to offer a perfect balance of relaxation and island exploration. Over 5 Nights and 6 Days, you will experience the best of the Andaman archipelago on a private basis.

Your trip begins in Port Blair, where you will stay for three nights and explore the coconut-fringed Corbyn’s Cove Beach and the historic Cellular Jail. You will also enjoy a scenic boat trip to Ross Island and North Bay to witness the region's vibrant coral life. The adventure continues with a two-night stay at Havelock Island, home to the legendary Radhanagar Beach—voted one of Asia’s finest. From the quiet turquoise waters of Kalapathar Beach to the adventurous shores of Elephant Beach, this itinerary captures the romantic essence of the islands. Complete with standard hotel accommodations, daily breakfast, and seamless transfers, this is an ideal choice for a memorable tropical honeymoon.
shortDescription: A beautiful 5N/6D island getaway for couples, featuring the historic landmarks of Port Blair and the pristine, world-famous beaches of Havelock Island.
highlights: Stroll along the palm-fringed sands of Corbyn’s Cove Beach in Port Blair.
Experience the moving history of the Cellular Jail with a private day visit.
Watch a spectacular tropical sunset at the world-renowned Radhanagar Beach.
Discover vibrant marine life and coral reefs at North Bay and Elephant Beach.
Relax by the tranquil, turquoise waters of the secluded Kalapathar Beach.

After checking in, you'll be driven to explore Corbyn’s Cove Beach, known for its serene coastline and swaying coconut palms. Later, visit the historic Cellular Jail, where you'll learn about its rich history. In the evening, experience the captivating light and sound show that brings to life the struggles of India’s freedom fighters. Afterward, you will be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

Soak in the serene ambiance of one of Asia’s most beautiful beaches, known for its clear blue waters and soft white sands. Afterward, you will be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

You can indulge in various thrilling water activities, including scuba diving, snorkeling, and swimming (at an extra cost), providing a closer view of the diverse marine ecosystem. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel.

name: Andaman Vacation for Family | Sunsets and Scenic Shores
description:
Embark on a memorable tropical journey with our specially curated Andaman Vacation for Family package. Designed to offer an exceptional balance of deep heritage trails and breathtaking coastlines, this comprehensive itinerary is perfectly built for multi-generational travelers looking for an organized island-hopping experience across the Bay of Bengal.
Your island retreat starts directly with a smooth transfer to your pre-arranged hotel in the capital city of Port Blair. Over your stay, your family will explore the historic cells of the Cellular Jail, witness its emotional Light & Sound show, and visit the historical ruins of Ross Island and the vibrant underwater reefs of North Bay Beach. The adventure seamlessly expands as you board premium inter-island ferry cruises toward the world-famous Havelock Island, home to the pristine sands of Radhanagar Beach and high-speed boat loops to Elephant Beach for optional marine sports. Conclude your grand loop amidst the tranquil ecosystems of Neil Island, exploring the iconic natural rock bridge of Laxmanpur and glass-bottom boat excursions at Bharatpur Beach. Complete with handpicked deluxe accommodations, daily breakfast, and fully structured point-to-point transits, this package is the ultimate blueprint for a flawless family vacation.

name: Couple Trip to the Jewels of Andaman | Romantic Island Getaway

Cross the deep blue waters on a comfortable cruise ferry to reach the paradise of Havelock Island for two nights of absolute coastal bliss. Walk hand-in-hand along the powdery sands of the world-famous Radhanagar Beach, watch spectacular sunsets, and discover the tranquil, turquoise waters of Kalapathar Beach. With a thrilling shared boat excursion to Elephant Beach for optional marine adventures and daily warm breakfasts included, this itinerary is the ultimate romantic formula for couples seeking a memorable island retreat.

name: Dreamy Escapade to the Islands of Andaman
description: Escape into a tropical paradise with our thoughtfully organized 'Dreamy Escapade to the Islands of Andaman' vacation package, meticulously spaced over 6 Nights and 7 Days. This all-inclusive itinerary smoothly connects the historic capital of Port Blair with the tranquil, sun-kissed shores of Havelock and Neil Islands. Your journey begins with a private escort to your hotel in Port Blair, where you will dive into history at the Cellular Jail, relax along Corbyn’s Cove Beach, and take a private boat excursion to the captivating coral havens of Ross and North Bay. Board luxury ferries to explore the iconic sands of Radhanagar Beach and enjoy shared speedboat thrill-rides to Elephant Beach for water sports. Conclude your perfect island loop exploring Neil Island’s pristine natural rock configurations and quiet coastal retreats on a completely private basis. Featuring handpicked standard accommodations, daily hot breakfasts, and a flawless blend of private and shared transits, this is the ultimate package to experience the complete magic of the Andaman archipelago.

name: Andaman Luxury Island Bliss | Coral Reefs and Golden Shores
