highlights: Savor world-class 5-star hospitality at Symphony Samudra in Port Blair, beautifully situated where a lush green tropical forest reserve meets the dramatic open vistas of the ocean.
Celebrate your love with an unforgettable, deeply romantic private beachside Candlelight Dinner arranged under the stars against the soothing wave backdrops of Chidiya Tapu Beach.
Explore the historical monument of the Cellular Jail during an informative day visit before witnessing the emotionally moving and highly spectacular Light and Sound Show in the evening.
Journey deep into the wilderness of Baratang Island to explore ancient limestone cave structures and rare geological mud volcanoes via an exclusive, fully managed private transit.
Walk along the world-renowned white sands of Radhanagar Beach on Havelock Island and take a thrilling speedboat ride to Elephant Beach to witness spectacular coral reef ecosystems.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair | Candlelight Dinner at Chidiya Tapu
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands! Upon your arrival at Port Blair airport, you will get transferred to your hotel. Spend the day relaxing on the hotel’s private beach, soaking up the island’s laid-back vibe. In the evening, walk to the nearby Chidiya Tapu for sunset views and later, savour a candlelight dinner there. Following that, enjoy a relaxing overnight stay at your hotel in Port Blair.
activities: Candlelight Dinner at Chidiya Tapu Beach
itinerary.accommodation: Symphony Samudra, Port Blair ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Bartang Island
itinerary.description: In the morning, get transferred from the hotel to Middle Strait Jetty. From there, take a boat ride to Baratang Island for a scenic drive through the dense Jarawa forest, a protected reserve home to unique flora and fauna. Continue with a ride through mangroves before trekking to the mystical limestone caves, where striking formations create a natural wonder. Later, return to Middle Strait Jetty via a boat ride and from there, get transferred to the hotel in Port Blair for a night stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Symphony Samudra, Port Blair ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

itinerary.title: Cellular Jail Guided Tour & Light & Sound Show | Visit Corbyn’s Cove Beach
itinerary.description: Today, get transferred to Corbyn’s Cove Beach for a scenic walk along palm-fringed shores and sunset views. Then, get driven to the iconic Cellular Jail, exploring its cell blocks, gallows, and historic galleries while listening to stories of freedom fighters like Veer Savarkar. In the evening, enjoy an amazing Light & Sound Show there, narrating the freedom struggle. Conclude the day by getting transferred to the Port Blair hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Day Trip to Corbyn Cove Beach and Cellular Jail - Corbyn Beach + Cellular Jail Visit with Light & Sound Show
itinerary.accommodation: Symphony Samudra, Port Blair ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

itinerary.title: Transfer to Havelock Island | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: In the morning, cheeck out of the hotel and get transferred to the Phoenix Bay Harbor and from there, take a ferry ride to Havelock Island Harbor. Then, get driven to the hotel and check in. The rest of the day is yours to relax, so you can unwind by the pool, relax with a complimentary spa session, or stroll along the private beach at leisure.
itinerary.accommodation: Sea Shell Havelock (Chalet) ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

itinerary.title: Excursion to Elephant Beach with Water Sports | Visit Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: In the morning, get transferred to Havelock Jetty and from there, enjoy a speed boat ride to Elephant Beach, famed for its pristine waters and adventure activities. Experience water sports like snorkelling, sea walking, banana boat ride, and jet skiing, with glass-bottom boat ride offering glimpses of colourful reefs. Later, get driven to Radhanagar Beach for a relaxed evening before returning to Havelock Jetty via a speed boat. From there, get transferred to the hotel a night stay in Havelock.
activities: Trip to Elephant Beach with Water Sports
itinerary.accommodation: Sea Shell Havelock (Chalet) ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

itinerary.title: Transfer to Neil Island | Visit to Bharatpur & Laxmanpur Beach
itinerary.description: On this day, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Havelock Island Harbor. From there, get a ferry ride to Neil Island Port. Then, get driven to the hotel in Neil Island to check in. Later, set out for a scenic island excursion that includes a glass-bottom boat ride at Bharatpur Beach to spot marine life and corals. Get a chance to visit the Howrah Bridge before heading to Laxmanpur Beach to watch a beautiful sunset. Later, get driven to your hotel for a night stay in Neil Island.
activities: Howrah Bridge with Glass-Bottom Boat Ride at Bharatpur Beach
itinerary.accommodation: Symphony Summer Sands ⭐⭐⭐⭐

itinerary.title: Transfer to Port Blair | Departure Day
itinerary.description: Today, check out from your Neil Island hotel, and get transferred to Neil Island Jetty. Then, enjoy a morning ferry back to Phoenix Bay Harbor and from there, continue with your transfer to Veer Savarkar International Airport for your departure flight.

knowBeforeYouGo: A valid Government-issued photo ID card (such as an Aadhar Card or Passport) is strictly compulsory for all traveling guests to ensure smooth airport check-ins, resort check-ins, and ferry boardings.
All inter-island luxury cruise transits, speed boat operations, and beach sightseeing tours are entirely subject to daily sea weather conditions and sudden port authority clearances.
The day trip excursion to Baratang Island involves traveling through a restricted forest reserve zone where strict convoy rules, timing windows, and speed limits are enforced by authorities.
Mobile network signals and high-speed data connectivity can be highly limited, unstable, or completely unavailable on Havelock and Neil Islands, so plan your professional communications in advance.
Standard check-in time across high-end luxury Andaman resorts is typically between 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM, while check-out is early around 8:00 AM to 9:00 AM to perfectly align with cruise schedules.
thingsToCarry: Elegant resort wear, smart casual clothing lines, and premium swimwear layers for beach lounging, private candlelight dining, and pool activities.
Comfortable slip-on beach sandals, open flip-flops, and durable walking shoes for exploring the rugged nature trails and caves of Baratang Island.
High-SPF protective sunscreen creams, UV-protection sunglasses, wide-brimmed sun hats, and a compact umbrella to protect against unexpected tropical rain showers.
A personal medical first-aid kit containing routine prescription medications, standard motion-sickness tablets for sea ferry journeys, and a reliable power bank.
A high-quality waterproof mobile phone pouch or a reliable dry sack bag to keep your electronic devices, cameras, and important travel documents completely safe during boat transits.
keyPoints: 6 Nights Elite Luxury Resort Stays featuring 3 premium nights at the gorgeous 5-star Symphony Samudra in Port Blair, 2 nights in Havelock Island, and 1 night in Neil Island.
Exclusive Romantic Experiences including a breathtaking tropical sunset viewing followed by a private, chef-curated premium Candlelight Dinner directly on the shoreline of Chidiya Tapu Beach.
Private High-Adventure Day Expeditions to the exotic mud volcanoes and dense mangrove canopies of Baratang Island alongside complete heritage city tours of the historic Cellular Jail.
Premium Inter-Island Cruise Marine Transits featuring pre-booked premium class ferry tickets alongside high-speed private boat rides to the vibrant coral reefs of Elephant Beach.
Daily Gourmet Chef-Prepared Morning Breakfast Spreads served warm at your luxury resort restaurants alongside elite private executive vehicle transits for all ground movements.

name: Andaman Coastal Retreat | Tropical Treasures and Island Delights
description: Discover the unmatched charm of the tropics with our 'Andaman Coastal Retreat' package, perfectly organized across 5 Nights and 6 Days. Your journey begins with a comfortable transfer to your standard hotel in Port Blair, where you will experience the serene Corbyn's Cove Beach and the evening Light and Sound Show at the historic Cellular Jail. Sail across the azure waters to Havelock Island for a two-night stay, exploring the sunset beauty of Radhanagar Beach, the quiet shores of Kalapathar, and a thrilling shared speedboat trip to Elephant Beach for optional marine adventures. Continue your island-hopping to the beautiful Neil Island for a dedicated island tour and a peaceful overnight stay. With daily breakfasts, carefully balanced hotel stays, and planned airport transits, this standard retreat is crafted to offer an affordable, breezy, and memorable beach vacation.
shortDescription: A refreshing 5N/6D tropical getaway exploring the pristine shorelines of Port Blair, Havelock, and Neil Islands.
highlights: Bask in the golden sunset hours at Asia's famous white-sand stretch—Radhanagar Beach.
Photograph the breathtaking turquoise tides contrasting against the rocks at Kalapathar Beach.
Ride a thrilling shared speedboat to explore shallow coral reefs at Elephant Beach.
See the famous natural coral limestone rock bridge structure located on Neil Island.
Watch the spectacular and patriotic Light and Sound Show at the historic Cellular Jail.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair & Cellular Jail Visit
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the airport in Port Blair, meet our local representative for a comfortable transfer to your hotel. In the afternoon, head out to enjoy the serene coastal views of Corbyn's Cove Beach. Later, visit the historic Cellular Jail to witness the evening Light and Sound Show that vividly depicts India's freedom struggle before returning to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Guru International, Port Blair / Hotel Mainak, Port Blair / Similare

itinerary.description: Post check out, get transferred to Phoenix Bay Harbour. Next, board your ferry to the picturesque Havelock Island. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and take some time to settle in. Later, get driven to the renowned Radhanagar Beach, famous for its pristine white sands and turquoise waters. Spend the afternoon basking in the sun and enjoying the serene beach environment. Afterward, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Radhakrishna Resort, Havelock / All Season Residency, Havelock / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Elephant Beach
itinerary.description: In the morning, get transferred for a captivating day trip to the Elephant Beach. Upon arrival, take your time to explore the vibrant underwater world at Neemo Reef with a range of water sports available (additional cost). Enjoy the stunning coastal views and the crystal-clear waters that make this beach a tropical paradise. After a day filled with adventure and relaxation, get driven to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Radhakrishna Resort, Havelock / All Season Residency, Havelock / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Kalapathar Beach | Transfer to Neil Island
itinerary.description: Today, check out from your hotel and get transferred to the serene Kalapathar Beach. There, you can enjoy a leisurely stroll along the pristine shoreline and take in the breathtaking natural beauty. After soaking in the serene atmosphere, get driven to the Havelock Island Harbour for your ferry ride to Neil Island. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check in and rest for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: CS Empire, Neil Island / Neha Palace Hotel, Neil Island / Similar

itinerary.title: Neil Island Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Port Blair
itinerary.description: Post check out, you’ll get transferred to explore Neil Island. Visit the picturesque Laxmanpur Beach, the serene Sitapur Beach, and the vibrant Bharatpur Beach. There, you can also indulge in various water sports and activities. Following your island exploration, get driven to Neil Island Jetty and board your ferry to Port Blair. Upon arrival, get transferred to your hotel. Check in and rest for an overnight stay.

name: Highlights of Andaman Islands | A Peaceful Getaway to Scenic Beaches
description: Embark on the ultimate tropical adventure with our 'Highlights of Andaman Islands' package, beautifully spread across 10 Nights and 11 Days. This comprehensive itinerary takes you far beyond the usual routes, starting with the historical landmarks of Port Blair like the Cellular Jail, Corbyn's Cove, and a dual-island cruise to Ross and North Bay. Experience absolute coastal charm with two nights each on Havelock and Neil Islands, exploring Radhanagar Beach, Kalapathar Beach, Elephant Beach, and the quiet scenic stretches of Amkunj and Moricedera. Travel north into the untouched wilderness to stay in Rangat and Diglipur, where you will walk the famous Dhaninallah Mangrove nature trail, visit Kalipur Beach, and cross Baratang Island with an exciting Jalki Jeep Safari. Complete with standard accommodations, daily breakfast spreads, and a balanced mix of private and shared transits, this grand getaway is perfect for travelers looking for a peaceful and complete exploration of the Andaman archipelago.
shortDescription: An extensive 10N/11D island journey covering the historic sites of Port Blair, pristine beaches of Havelock, Neil Island, and the untouched landscapes of Rangat and Diglipur.
highlights: Visit the historic Cellular Jail in Port Blair and witness the iconic dual-island ruins of Ross and North Bay.
Unwind on the world-famous white sands of Radhanagar Beach and enjoy sunset views at Kalapathar Beach.
Explore the rare eco-trails of Dhaninallah Mangrove and relax at the offbeat Kalipur Beach in Diglipur.
Ride a thrilling shared speedboat to Elephant Beach for optional shallow-reef water sports activities.
Experience an off-road Jalki Jeep Safari and cruise past the dense mangrove channels of Baratang Island.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair | Visit to Corbyns Cove Beach & Cellular Jail
itinerary.description: Welcome to Port Blair! Upon your arrival, get driven to the hotel. After checking in, take some time to unwind. Later, embark on a captivating sightseeing tour of Port Blair. First, visit the iconic Cellular Jail, where you'll delve into the rich history of India's freedom struggle. Next, head to Corbyn’s Cove Beach to soak in the scenic beauty and enjoy a stroll along the sandy shores. As the day winds down, you'll be driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: AR Pride Residency, Port Blair / Hotel Blu Horizon, Port Blair / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Havelock Island | Visit to Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: After checking out from your hotel, you'll be driven to Phoenix Bay Harbour to board a ferry for Havelock Island. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to the hotel, where you can check in and unwind for a while. Later, get transferred to the stunning Radhanagar Beach, renowned for its views and serene ambience. Here, you can swim in the crystal-clear waters or simply relax and sunbathe on the pristine shores. As the day concludes, you'll be driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Radhakrishna Resort, Havelock / All Season Residency, Havelock / Similar

itinerary.title: Day trip to Elephant Beach
itinerary.description: In the morning, prepare for an exciting day as you board the transfer to Elephant Beach, famed for its vibrant marine life and wonderful coral reefs. Upon arrival, walk along the coastline where crystal-clear waters blend beautifully with soft sandy shores. Dive into the underwater world with a range of activities such as scuba diving and snorkelling (at extra cost). After a day of adventure and relaxation, you’ll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Radhakrishna Resort, Havelock / All Season Residency, Havelock / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Kala Pathar Beach | Transfer to Neil Island
itinerary.description: Begin your morning with a transfer from your hotel to the picturesque Kalapathar Beach, renowned for its striking black rocks. Marvel at the dramatic contrast between the dark rocks and the turquoise waters as you explore this unique coastline. After your visit, return to your hotel for check-out. Next, you'll be driven to Havelock Jetty to board the ferry back to Neil Island. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to your hotel, where you can check in and enjoy your overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: CS Empire, Neil Island / Neha Palace Hotel, Neil Island / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit the Bharatpur Beach | Arrival in Port Blair
itinerary.description: In the morning, get ready and board the transfer from the hotel to Bharatpur Beach. Upon arrival, you can try various activities at the beach like snorkelling and scuba diving to explore the marine life or try jet skiing to enjoy the views of coastal surroundings (at extra cost). After that, you'll be driven back to the hotel. Post check out, get driven to Neil Island Port and take the ferry to Port Blair. Upon arrival, get transferred to the hotel. After you check in, enjoy your overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Guru International, Port Blair / Hotel Mainak, Port Blair / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Amkunj & Moricedera Beach | Transfer to Diglipur
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from your hotel and embark on a journey to Diglipur. Along the way, visit the beautiful Amkunj and Moricedera Beaches. At Amkunj Beach, soak in the peaceful environment and scenic views as you stroll along the shore. Next, get driven to Moricedera Beach, known for its serene ambience and crystal-clear waters. Spend some time appreciating the beauty of these coastal treasures. Continue your journey to Diglipur. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Pristine Beach Resort, Diglipur / Hotel Adhi, Diglipur / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Dhaninallah Mangrove Nature Walkway | Transfer to Rangat
itinerary.description: In the morning, prepare to check out from your hotel and board the transfer to Rangat. Along the way, visit the enchanting Dhaninallah Mangrove Nature Walkway. Upon your arrival, discover the lush mangrove forests and observe a diverse array of flora and fauna in their natural habitat. Walk along the elevated pathways and enjoy panoramic views of the scenic landscape. Continue your journey to Rangat. Upon your arrival, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bliss Holiday Resorts, Rangat / Ross & Smith Hotel, Rangat / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Baratang Island | Transfer to Port Blair
itinerary.description: After checking out, board the transfer to Nilambur Jetty and take the ferry to Baratang Island. Upon arrival, embark on the Jalki Jeep Safari. Pass through the mangrove creeks and marvel at the unique mud volcanoes, known locally as Jalki, which are formed from mud and gas eruptions. Following this, you’ll be driven to Baratang Island Port to board the ferry back to Port Blair. Upon reaching, you'll be transferred to your hotel where you can check in and enjoy your overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Guru International, Port Blair / Hotel Mainak, Port Blair / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Ross Bay & North Bay
itinerary.description: Get ready and board the transfer from your hotel to Phoenix Bay Harbour for your ferry to ride to Ross and the North Bay Islands. During this journey, explore North Bay, where you can indulge in activities like snorkelling (at an additional cost). Next, explore Ross Island and uncover the historical ruins of the old Penal Colony, offering a glimpse into the island's colonial past. Post sightseeing, take the ferry back to Port Blair. Upon arrival, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Guru International, Port Blair / Hotel Mainak, Port Blair / Similar

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Take this day to explore the city at your own pace. You can visit the beautiful Chidhiya Tapu, famed for its stunning sunrise and sunset views. Alternatively, you can visit Mount Harriet National Park, known for its diverse flora and fauna. Moreover, you can visit the Anthropological Museum, showcasing interesting artefacts and the Samudrika Marine Museum, which highlights marine exhibits, among other famous places. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

name: Getaway to Bhutan | FREE Hike to Taktsang Monastery
description: Experience the serene magic of the Last Shangri-La with our 'Getaway to Bhutan' tour package, perfectly structured across 5 Nights and 6 Days. Your Himalayan adventure begins at the bustling border town of Phuntsholing, transitioning smoothly into the cultural capital of Thimphu to explore historical landmarks like the majestic Simtokha Dzong and the towering Buddha Dordenma statue. The journey then takes you into the scenic valley of Paro, where you will experience traditional Bhutanese hospitality, explore ancient fortresses, and embark on a thrilling, spiritual hike to the world-famous Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery perched dramatically on a cliffside. Complete with standard accommodations, hassle-free visa assistance, dedicated local guiding services, and a flexible meal plan (Daily Breakfast + Dinner), this curated holiday loop is designed to provide an authentic, affordable, and deeply memorable Bhutanese experience.
shortDescription: A beautiful 5N/6D Himalayan journey exploring the cultural heritage of Thimphu, the borders of Phuntsholing, and an iconic hike to Paro's Tiger's Nest.
highlights: Marvel at the magnificent Buddha Dordenma statue built to overlook the valley and promote world peace.
Hike up to the legendary Tiger’s Nest Monastery where Guru Rinpoche is said to have meditated.
Explore the ancient architectures of Simtokha Dzong, one of Bhutan's oldest fortress-monasteries.
Stroll through the vibrant markets of Thimphu and Paro to experience authentic Bhutanese lifestyle.
Cross the beautiful Himalayan valleys and mountain passes in a comfortable private ground vehicle.

description: Discover the majestic beauty of the Thunder Dragon kingdom with our beautifully curated 'Vacation in Bhutan' package, systematically spaced over 4 Nights and 5 Days. Skipping the long border road drives, your journey begins with a smooth pickup right from Paro International Airport, heading into the scenic capital city of Thimphu for a two-night stay. Enjoy completely private sightseeing tours covering the ancient Simtokha Dzong and the vibrant city highlights before returning to Paro Valley. In Paro, immerse yourself in history at Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong, visit the sacred Kichu Lhakhang temple, and experience a breathtaking, private guided trek to the iconic cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery. Complete with deluxe accommodations, a rich half-board meal plan (Daily Breakfast and Dinner), and dedicated local guiding, this package offers a seamless, highly attractive Himalayan holiday loop.

highlights: Explore the monumental fortress architecture of Simtokha Dzong, one of the oldest in Bhutan.
Enjoy a completely private guided hike up to the spectacular cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery.
Visit the historic Ta Dzong National Museum and walk across the traditional cantilever bridge at Rinpung Dzong.
Discover spiritual serenity at Kichu Lhakhang, one of Bhutan’s oldest and most sacred Buddhist shrines.
Savor the majestic panoramic views of the Paro and Thimphu river valleys from premium vantage points.

Experience Bhutanese culture at Simply Bhutan & witness live demonstrations of traditional crafts. You can also relax in Deer Park, modeled after India’s Deer Park. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

name: Gems of Bhutan | Thimphu Punakha & Paro
description: Explore the absolute best highlights of the Thunder Dragon Kingdom with our 'Gems of Bhutan' holiday package, beautifully arranged across 5 Nights and 6 Days. This comprehensive itinerary covers the iconic golden triangle loop of Bhutan, starting with the cultural capital of Thimphu to see traditional landmarks and grand fortresses. Journey across the scenic Dochula Pass into the warm, subtropical valley of Punakha to stand before its famous majestic Dzong at the river confluence. Conclude your mountain vacation in the gorgeous Paro Valley, where you will dive into local heritage and embark on the world-famous, spiritually rewarding trek to the cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery. Featuring comfortable standard accommodations, daily breakfast spreads, local guiding, and all route permits, this package is designed for a completely smooth and authentic Himalayan getaway.

highlights: Cross the stunning Dochula Pass to admire its 108 memorial chortens and panoramic mountain views.
Hike up to the legendary Tiger’s Nest Monastery perched dramatically on a high, vertical cliffside.
Visit the breathtaking Punakha Dzong, globally celebrated as one of Bhutan's most beautiful fortresses.
Explore the traditional heritage sites, handicraft markets, and giant Buddha statues of Thimphu.
Travel comfortably between the valleys in a well-maintained vehicle with an expert local guide.

description: Embark on a beautifully managed road adventure into the land of happiness with our 'Bhutan Tour Package From Siliguri', perfectly organized across 5 Nights and 6 Days. Your tour begins with a convenient pickup from Siliguri (NJP Station or Bagdogra Airport), driving through rolling tea gardens straight to the Bhutanese border town of Phuntsholing. Journey up into the mountains to stay in the capital city of Thimphu, exploring incredible cultural landmarks like the ancient Simtokha Dzong and stunning valley viewpoints. Continue into the picturesque Paro Valley for a two-night stay, where you will experience traditional local architecture and set off on a memorable, guided trek to the spectacular cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery. Featuring comfortable standard properties, a comprehensive half-board meal plan (Daily Breakfast and Dinner), a dedicated local guide, and pre-arranged route permissions, this overland holiday loop is designed to give you a highly affordable and authentic Bhutanese

name: Explore Bhutan with FREE Taktsang Monastery Tour
description: Immerse yourself completely in the serene mountain landscapes of the Thunder Dragon Kingdom with our 'Explore Bhutan' tour package, perfectly scheduled across 7 Nights and 8 Days. This extended itinerary takes you smoothly from the border entry town of Phuntsholing up into the majestic capital city of Thimphu for a two-night stay to enjoy private sightseeing of traditional cultural points. Cross the scenic mountain passes into the warm, subtropical Punakha Valley for a dedicated night stay to witness its legendary riverside fortress. Conclude your grand holiday loop in the breathtaking Paro Valley, where you will experience deep local heritage and set off on the world-famous, spiritually rewarding guided trek up to the cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery. Complete with handpicked standard accommodations, a solid half-board meal plan (Daily Breakfast and Dinner), and private valley transits, this tour is designed for an authentic and worry-free Himalayan vacation.

highlights: Hike up to the world-famous Tiger’s Nest Monastery perched dramatically on a vertical mountain cliffside.
Explore the stunning Punakha Dzong, globally celebrated as one of the most beautiful fortresses in Bhutan.
Cross the majestic Dochula Pass to admire its 108 memorial chortens and open Himalayan mountain views.
Discover the giant Buddha Dordenma statue and rich traditional handicraft arts inside Thimphu valley.
Travel comfortably across multiple mountain districts in a well-maintained private vehicle with an expert guide.

name: Bhutan Bike Expedition | Ride the Land of the Thunder
description: Gear up for the ultimate riding adventure with our 'Bhutan Bike Expedition', an incredible journey mapped across 6 Nights and 7 Days. Starting with a comfortable transfer from Bagdogra Airport to the border town of Phuntsholing, this tour invites riders to cruise through dramatic mountain curves and lush valleys. Ride up into the capital city of Thimphu for a two-night stay, exploring local heritage sites before taking on the scenic mountain roads toward the beautiful Punakha Valley. Cross majestic passes to reach Paro for another two nights, where you will trade your motorcycle gear for hiking shoes to conquer the legendary cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery trek. Featuring deluxe hotel stays, a solid half-board meal plan (Daily Breakfast and Dinner), an experienced mechanic support team, backup logistics, and included fuel, this bike trip is crafted to deliver a safe, thrilling, and bucket-list-worthy Himalayan expedition.

highlights: Ride your motorcycle across the breathtaking winding roads and dramatic curves of the Himalayas.
Conquer the legendary mountain passes while cruising from the border towns deep into the valleys.
Hike up to the world-famous Tiger’s Nest Monastery perched dramatically on a vertical mountain cliffside.
Explore the beautiful riverside landscapes of Punakha and the traditional cultural landmarks of Thimphu.
Enjoy a stress-free ride with a professional support convoy, backup vehicle, and expert mechanic guide.

After you relax for some time, visit Zangto Pelri Lhakhang or stroll through colorful local markets. If you wish, you can simply enjoy a hearty dinner as you gear up for the biking adventure that lies ahead in the Land of the Thunder Dragon.

Once you reach Thimphu, check in at the hotel. Later, you can explore Clock Tower Square or stroll through buzzing markets, trying Bhutanese specialties like Ema Datshi or butter tea.
itinerary.accommodation: Forest Boutique / Hotel Cholay khangzang / Similar

itinerary.title: Excursion to Punakha via Dochula Pass
itinerary.description: Today, begin your ride to Dochula Pass, one of Bhutan’s most scenic points. Continue to Lamperi Botanical Garden, located within Jigme Dorji National Park, where flora like blue poppy & rhododendrons offer scenic views. Then, descend to Punakha Valley to visit Punakha Dzong, a fortress at the confluence of Pho Chhu & Mo Chhu rivers. Park your bikes & walk across Bhutan’s longest suspension bridge & visit Chimi Lhakhang, the Temple of Fertility. Later, ride back to Thimphu for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Forest Boutique / Hotel Cholay khangzang / Similar

itinerary.title: Exploring Thimphu City | Ride to Paro
itinerary.description: Check out & begin the day by exploring Thimphu’s attractions with a bike ride. Visit Big Buddha, followed by National Memorial Chorten, where locals gather for daily prayers. Continue to Tashichho Dzong, housing Bhutan’s royal offices & see the Takin Reserve, home to Bhutan’s national animal. Also, stop at Sangaygang Viewpoint for city views & Changangkha Monastery, a 12th-century temple. Afterwards, ride towards Paro, passing scenic valleys. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Ananda Resort / Gonju Boutique / Similar

itinerary.title: Trek to Tiger’s Nest Monastery
itinerary.description: Start the day with a short ride from Paro to Satsam Chorten, the base for the Tiger’s Nest trek. Park your bike & hike through pine forests, prayer flag-lined paths & small waterfalls to reach Taktsang Monastery, perched dramatically on a cliff. Explore the monastery & return by the same trail. Later, ride back to Paro in the afternoon. If you wish, you can also try traditional hot stone bath to relax muscles or visit Kyichu Lhakhang, one of Bhutan’s oldest temples before unwinding for the day.
itinerary.accommodation: Ananda Resort / Gonju Boutique / Similar

itinerary.title: Ride from Paro to Phuentsholing via Chelela Pass
itinerary.description: Today, embark on the final ride of the tour. Begin by ascending to Chelela Pass, Bhutan’s highest motorable pass, lined with prayer flags. From the summit, enjoy views of Paro Valley on one side & Haa Valley on the other. Then, descenddown on riverside roads & misty mountain stretches, with multiple photo halts along the way. Continue on wide, open roads before reaching Chuzom, the confluence of two rivers before heading to Phuentsholing. Upon arrival, return your bikes & check in at the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Gadhen Hotel, Bhutan / Alem Hotel & Resort / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Bagdogra | Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from the hotel & get driven to Bagdogra Airport to board your flight back home. This is where your trip comes to an end.

description: Celebrate your togetherness in the blissful kingdom of happiness with our 'Instagrammable Bhutan | Couple Special' package, perfectly spaced over 6 Nights and 7 Days. Tailor-made for couples who want to capture beautiful memories against breathtaking mountain backdrops, this tour begins at the border gateway of Phuntsholing. Move up into the misty valleys of Thimphu to explore the ancient Simtokha Dzong and romantic city viewpoints before heading to the gorgeous Paro Valley. In Paro, enjoy shared moments exploring the grand architecture of Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong, and embark on the legendary, spiritually rewarding hike together up to the iconic cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery. Complete with cozy standard-deluxe properties, a rich half-board meal plan (Daily Breakfast and Dinner), and seamless transits, this romantic loop promises an absolute dream vacation for couples.

name: Escape to Bhutan | From Sacred Trails to Highland Tales
description: Immerse yourself in the blissful valleys of the Thunder Dragon Kingdom with our premium 'Escape to Bhutan' package, systematically spaced over 5 Nights and 6 Days. Skipping the long border road drives, your journey begins with a smooth premium transfer right from Paro International Airport, taking you into the capital city of Thimphu for a two-night stay. Enjoy private sightseeing tours covering the historic Simtokha Dzong and major city cultural points before moving to the subtropical valley of Punakha for another two nights. In Punakha, stand before the majestic riverside fortress and walk across its iconic suspension bridge. Conclude your high-altitude vacation in Paro, where you will visit the sacred Kyichu Lhakhang temple and embark on the legendary, spiritually rewarding guided trek up to the cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery. Complete with premium accommodations, a rich half-board meal plan (Daily Breakfast and Dinner), and dedicated transits, this tour delivers an absolute dream mountain holiday.

Discover spiritual serenity at Kyichu Lhakhang, one of Bhutan’s oldest and most sacred Buddhist shrines.
Cross majestic mountain passes to admire the breathtaking panoramic views of open Himalayan peaks.

name: Holidays in Bhutan | FREE Dochu La Pass
description: Discover the magic of the Thunder Dragon Kingdom with our 'Holidays in Bhutan' tour package, perfectly organized across 6 Nights and 7 Days. Skipping the long border drives, your journey begins with a smooth transfer right from Paro International Airport, heading into the capital city of Thimphu for a two-night stay to see the ancient Simtokha Dzong. Travel across the majestic Dochula Pass to enjoy a dedicated night stay in the serene valleys of Nubding and explore the beautiful black-necked crane habitat during your Gangtey sightseeing tour. Continue into the historic Punakha Valley for a night stay to witness its legendary riverside fortress before heading to the gorgeous Paro Valley. In Paro, visit the sacred Kyichu Lhakhang temple, explore the historic Ta Dzong, and embark on the world-famous, spiritually rewarding guided trek up to the cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery. Complete with standard accommodations, daily breakfast spreads, and private valley transits, this tour is crafted for an authentic and seamless mountain vacation.

Cross the stunning Dochula Pass to admire its 108 memorial chortens and open Himalayan mountain views.
Explore the beautiful high-altitude valleys of Gangtey and the pristine landscapes around Nubding town.
Visit the breathtaking Punakha Dzong, globally celebrated as one of the most beautiful fortresses in Bhutan.
Discover spiritual serenity at Kyichu Lhakhang, one of Bhutan’s oldest and most sacred Buddhist shrines.

Conquer the steep mountain trails up to the iconic Tiger’s Nest Monastery perched on a high vertical cliff.

itinerary.description: Post check-out, enjoy a sightseeing tour of Punakha. Begin by visiting the Chimi Lhakhang Temple, a sacred site known as the "Fertility Temple." Continue to the Punakha Dzong, a stunning fortress nestled between two rivers (Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu), offering a glimpse into Bhutanese history. Also, walk through the famous Punkha Suspension Bridge & get a chance to opt for a thrilling river rafting at the Pho Chu Mo Chu River. Later, get driven to Paro & check in to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Ananda Resort / HOTEL KHAMSUM INN / Similar

itinerary.title: Hike to Tiger's Nest Monastery
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a scenic drive to Satsam Chencho Tshongkhang, the starting point of the Tiger’s Nest Trek. Once there, trek along pine-fringed trails adorned with fluttering prayer flags, with views of the cliff-hugging monastery. Upon reaching the top, discover its sacred chambers, vibrant murals, and meditation caves honoring Guru Rinpoche. Later, descend back and get driven to your hotel. Later, you can indulge in a soothing Hot Stone bath or enjoy a hearty meal at Park 76 Cafe & Pub.
itinerary.accommodation: Ananda Resort / HOTEL KHAMSUM INN / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Haa Valley
itinerary.description: Today, board your transfer from the hotel for a scenic excursion to Haa Valley. En route, cross the breathtaking 13,083 ft Chele La Pass, where you can take a stop to admire panoramic views of the towering Himalayas. As you continue your journey through the forested hills and alpine meadows, soak in the beauty of the Haa Valley. Once there, visit the sacred Lhakhang Karpo, known as the “White Temple,” symbolizing purity and the Lhakhang Nagpo, or the “Black Temple,” believed to rest on a lake.
itinerary.accommodation: Ananda Resort / HOTEL KHAMSUM INN / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Phuntsholing | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get driven to Phuntsholing. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can visit the Karbandi Monastery, perched above Phuentsholing, housing statues of Guru Rinpoche and Shakyamuni Buddha. Also, you can visit Zangto Pelri Lhakhang, a temple said to represent Guru Rinpoche’s celestial paradise, or enjoy a brewery tour, where you can enjoy craft beer tasting while learning about unique brewing traditions.

name: Experiential Bhutan | Free Gangtey Gompa Monastery
description: Delve deep into the spiritual heart of the Thunder Dragon Kingdom with our 'Experiential Bhutan' package, beautifully organized across 7 Nights and 8 Days. This uniquely structured itinerary begins at the border town of Phuntsholing and moves up into the capital city of Thimphu for a two-night stay to enjoy traditional valley sightseeing. Journey into the warm valleys of Punakha for two nights to stand before its iconic riverside fortress, and enjoy an unforgettable free day excursion to the high-altitude Gangtey Gompa Monastery. Conclude your mountain holiday in the stunning Paro Valley with a private visit to the ancient Kyichu Lhakhang and the legendary guided hike up to the spectacular cliffside Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery. Complete with comfortable standard accommodations, a balanced half-board meal plan (Daily Breakfast and Dinner), and managed valley drops, this package guarantees a completely smooth and authentic Himalayan retreat.
shortDescription: An immersive 7N/8D Himalayan journey exploring Phuntsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, and a scenic day trip to Gangtey Gompa.
highlights: Uncover the rich spiritual history inside the pristine, valley-facing Gangtey Gompa Monastery.
Trek up to the legendary cliffside Tiger’s Nest Monastery perched dramatically on a vertical mountain wall.
Walk across the long, prayer-flag-draped Punakha Suspension Bridge for spectacular landscape photos.
Discover absolute peace at Kyichu Lhakhang, one of Bhutan's oldest and most revered Buddhist shrines.
Explore the giant Buddha Dordenma statue overlooking panoramic green vistas of the Thimphu valley.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Siliguri | Transfer to Phuntsholing | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Siliguri! Upon arrival at the Bagdogra Airport/New Jalpaiguri Railway Station, board your transfer to the beautiful Phuntsholing Border Town. After checking in to your hotel, spend the rest of the day at leisure, where you can visit the Amo Chhu Crocodile Breeding Centre and witness the rare and endangered crocodiles up close. Also, you can stroll along the serene Torsa Riverside and soak-in its amazing atmosphere. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can head out and explore the Dechen Phodrang Monastery or admire traditional arts at the National Institute for Zorig Chusum. Also, you can wander through the lush Royal Botanical Garden, or soak in the cozy vibe of the Ambient Café, savoring local food.

itinerary.title: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, delve into Thimphu’s cultural charm on a sightseeing tour, beginning with the National Memorial Chorten—a revered monument. Next, encounter the unique takin, Bhutan’s national animal, at the Motithang Takin Preserve, nestled amid pine forests. Also, discover intricate local artistry at the Handicrafts Emporium, where every piece reflects Bhutan’s deep-rooted heritage. After the sightseeing tour, you can visit the Bhutan Postal Museum and marvel at the stunning talking stamps.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Taktsang  /  Forest Boutique / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Punakha via Dochula Pass | Punakha Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Check out & get driven to Punakha. En route, pause at the iconic Dochula Pass—known for its 108 memorial chortens. Upon arrival in Punakha, visit Chimi Lhakhang, known as the "Fertility Temple," & continue to the Punakha Dzong, one of Bhutan’s most beautiful fortresses & stroll across the iconic Punakha Suspension Bridge, known for its scenic river views. Also, you can opt for a thrilling river rafting experience on the Pho Chhu Mo Chhu river before getting driven to your hotel for check-in.
itinerary.accommodation: White Dragon Hotel Punakha / Punakha Dragon Nest Resort /  Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Gangtey
itinerary.description: Today, enjoy a scenic drive to Gangtey, known for its natural beauty. Start with a visit to the Phobjikha Valley, a stunning glacial valley, home to the rare Tibetan black-necked cranes. Next, visit the iconic Gangtey Gompa Monastery and soak-in the views of the Phobjikha Valley. Continue to Wangdiphodrang Dzong, a fortress that stands at the confluence of the Mo Chhu and Tang Chhu rivers. Also, admire its stunning Bhutanese architecture before getting transferred to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: White Dragon Hotel Punakha / Punakha Dragon Nest Resort /  Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Paro | Paro Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out and get transferred to Paro, passing through charming Bhutanese villages. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and later, enjoy a sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to the Drukgyel Dzong, an iconic fortress offering a glimpse into Bhutan's military past. Next, pay your respects at the Kyichu Lhakhang, one of Bhutan's oldest temples, dating back to the 7th century. After an amazing day, get transferred to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

name: Bali Couple Special | From Sacred Temples to Serene Shores
description: Ignite your romance in the world's most enchanting island paradise with our 'Bali Couple Special' holiday package, flawlessly curated across 4 Nights and 5 Days. Your romantic journey begins with a smooth pickup that takes you deep into the cultural heart of Ubud for a two-night stay. Enjoy a completely private central valley sightseeing tour highlighted by the sacred purifications at Tirta Empul Temple. Transition smoothly to the sunny coasts of Kuta for another two nights to mix thrill and absolute relaxation. Experience an exhilarating combo of private watersports at Tanjung Benoa Beach and soothe your senses with an authentic, couples-special Balinese spa massage. Conclude your dream getaway with an unforgettable private speedboat excursion to West Nusa Penida to photograph its four globally famous paradise beaches, ensuring a vacation filled with timeless memories.
shortDescription: A romantic 4N/5D tropical getaway for couples split beautifully between the lush greens of Ubud and the vibrant golden shores of Kuta.
highlights: Seek holy blessings and witness traditional spiritual cleansing rituals inside the historic Tirta Empul Temple.
Soothe your mind and body together with an authentic, aromatic traditional Balinese couples massage.
Conquer the waves with an adrenaline-pumping private water sports combo at the sun-kissed Tanjung Benoa Beach.
Capture iconic couple portraits against the dramatic cliff walls and turquoise waves of Kelingking Beach.
Stroll hand-in-hand through the vibrant local handicraft boutiques and cozy beachside cafes of Kuta.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ubud | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Ubud! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Check in and relax for a while. You can explore Ubud Monkey Forest, where monkeys roam freely in a tropical setting. Next, discover Goa Gajah, an ancient cave with detailed carvings. Continue to the Ubud Water Palace, known for its beautiful gardens. You can also experience the Hanging Gardens for incredible vistas. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bakung Ubud Resort & Villa / Asri Sari Villa, Ubud / Similar

itinerary.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, board your transfer to explore Central Bali. Visit Tegenungan Waterfalls and marvel at the cascading waters surrounded by lush greenery. You can explore the Ubud Royal Palace, known for its traditional Balinese architecture. Next, visit Tirta Empul Temple, a 10th-century water temple where locals engage in purification rituals. Experience the thrill of the Bali Swing, offering stunning views over the tropical landscape. Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bakung Ubud Resort & Villa / Asri Sari Villa, Ubud / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kuta | Water Sports and Balinese Spa Experience
itinerary.description: After checking out of your Ubud hotel, you will be driven to Kuta. Check in and relax for a while. Start your tour with a visit to Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can enjoy water sports like parasailing and jet skiing, perfect for thrill-seekers. The beach is a hotspot for marine activities and offers stunning coastal views. Afterward, enjoy a rejuvenating traditional Balinese spa, renowned for its calming effects. Later, you'll be transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

name: Bali Couple Highlights with Flights | Nusa Penida, Ubud & Kuta
description: Celebrate your love with the ultimate tropical journey with our 'Bali Couple Highlights with Flights' package, seamlessly scheduled over 6 Nights and 7 Days. This premium itinerary includes your round-trip flights from Delhi and hassle-free visa processing to keep your arrival completely stress-free. Your romantic vacation kicks off in Kuta with a two-night stay at Ramada by Wyndham, featuring a thrilling private water sports combo at Tanjung Benoa and a dramatic Uluwatu sunset sunset tour with a traditional Kecak fire dance. Cruise over to the iconic island of Nusa Penida for a dedicated beachside night stay to photograph the stunning Kelingking Beach and enjoy complimentary snorkeling. Conclude your dream getaway with three nights in the lush heart of Ubud at FuramaXclusive Resort, enjoying a 90-minute double-sharing ATV adventure at Cretya Ubud, a giant jungle swing, and private highland tours. Complete with top-tier accommodations, daily breakfasts, select local lunches, and private transfers, this is the definitive island escape for couples.

Unwind completely with a restorative 1-hour authentic Balinese couple's massage session inside Kuta.

name: Getaway to Bali | Couple Special
description: Escape into the magical vibes of the tropical paradise with our 'Getaway to Bali | Couple Special' package, perfectly divided across 4 Nights and 5 Days. Designed especially for couples seeking a mix of cultural heritage and coastal fun, this tour begins with a seamless transit leading into the lush greens of Ubud for a two-night stay. Enjoy a completely private full-day sightseeing tour highlighted by the majestic Kintamani Volcano views, traditional coffee plantations, and the famous Bali Jungle Swing. Shift your stay to Kuta for another two nights to enjoy the vibrant beach lifestyle, thrilling water sports, and a private excursion to Padang Padang Beach. Conclude your dream island vacation with a spectacular sunset view at the cliffside Uluwatu Temple, making it a completely smooth and unforgettable romantic retreat.
shortDescription: A beautiful 4N/5D romantic holiday for couples covering the scenic landscapes of Ubud and the popular beach zones of Kuta.
highlights: Capture romantic couple portraits on the iconic Bali Jungle Swing overlooking lush tree canopies.
Admire the stunning panoramic views of Mount Batur during your Kintamani highland loop.
Enjoy a thrilling water sports session together on the golden shores of the Kuta beach belt.
Watch a magical tropical sunset from the ancient cliffside ruins of the Uluwatu Temple.
Stroll along the pristine sands and crystal clear waters of the famous Padang Padang Beach.

For some fun and adventure, you can head to Waterbom Waterpark, a tropical water paradise with thrilling rides. You can also explore other sites like Ubud Water Palace and Neka Art Museum. Continue to the iconic Tegallalang rice terraces, where the lush, layered fields create a stunning landscape. See the Tegenungan Waterfall and experience the Bali Swing, soaring through the jungle with panoramic views. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

Immerse yourselves in the ancient heritage of Penglipuran Traditional Village and capture stunning couple photographs at the scenic Kanto Lampo Waterfall. name: Family Holiday in Bali | Free upgrade to Vintage Car Tour
description: Treat your family to the ultimate tropical adventure with our 'Family Holiday in Bali' tour package, exceptionally organized across 5 Nights and 6 Days. Your premium family vacation begins in the cultural heart of Ubud for a two-night stay, highlighted by a unique open-top Vintage Volkswagen Car Tour through Kintamani, cascading waterfalls, and the famous Bali Swing. Transition smoothly to coastal Kuta for a four-night stay, starting with an exciting wildlife encounter at Bali Safari Marine Park and a sunset view at Tanah Lot Temple. Pack your days with absolute fun at Waterbom Bali waterpark, explore the towering structures of GWK Cultural Park, and enjoy an adrenaline-pumping water sports combo at Tanjung Benoa Beach alongside a traditional Kecak fire dance at Uluwatu. Complete with handpicked properties, fresh daily breakfasts, a special local lunch, and fully private transits, this detailed loop is crafted for an unforgettable family bonding experience.
shortDescription: A massive 5N/6D premium family loop covering Ubud jungles via a vintage Volkswagen car, wildlife safaris, waterparks, and coastal Kuta.
highlights: Cruise through traditional Balinese rice terraces in an open-top vintage Volkswagen classic car.
Encounter exotic global wildlife up close during an immersive jungle safari ride at Bali Safari Park.
Enjoy an adrenaline-fueled family day out on the extreme slides of Asia's top waterpark, Waterbom Bali.
Conquer the tides together with thrilling private parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides at Benoa.
Watch a dramatic sunset over the ocean at Uluwatu Temple followed by a traditional Kecak Fire Dance.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to the hotel. After check in, be welcomed by a decorated room. Later, take the rest of the day at your leisure. You may choose to step back in time at Goa Gajah, adorned with intricate stone carvings or colorful Bali Bird Park, home to hundreds of exotic bird species. You can also head to Waterbom Bali, Southeast Asia’s top-rated waterpark, where thrilling slides, refreshing pools, and exciting rides promise endless entertainment.
activities: Recommended Enrich your day with experiences Fill up your day with some of the highly recommended experiences.

itinerary.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Explore Bali's iconic experiences with a vintage Volkswagen car tour. Begin with Bali Swing & take in panoramic views of terraced landscapes. Continue to Tegenungan Waterfall, which offers the perfect spot to capture stunning photos. Also, explore Tirta Empul Temple, famed for its holy spring pools. Moreover, add a special touch to your day with a 1-hour professional photoshoot at Sari Timbul. Finally, wander through the breathtaking Tegallalang Rice Terrace. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
activities: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul Temple - Bali Swing + Tegenungan Waterfall + Tirta Empul + Sari Timbul + Tegallang Rice Terrace Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen Ticket Included

itinerary.title: Visit to Safari World & Tanah Lot Temple | Transfer to Kuta
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel & get driven to Bali Safari & Marine Park, where you can encounter exotic wildlife up close through interactive shows, safaris & unique experiences that bring nature to life. Then, visit the legendary Tanah Lot Temple, dramatically set on an offshore rock formation & famed for its stunning oceanfront sunsets. After sightseeing, get transferred to Kuta. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Taman Safari Bali - Bali Safari Jungle Hopper Package + Tanah Lot Sunset Tour Ticket Included
itinerary.accommodation: Cross Vibe Paasha Atelier Bali Kuta / Swiss-Belhotel Rainforest / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to GWK Park & Waterbom Bali
itinerary.description: Today, begin your exploration with GWK Cultural Park, home to the iconic Garuda Wisnu Kencana statue, one of the tallest monuments in the world. Stroll through the grounds to admire Balinese art & vibrant cultural displays, along with various cultural performances. Then, visit Waterbom Bali, Asia’s top-rated waterpark, where adrenaline-pumping slides & family-friendly play zones combine to create fun & excitement. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel.
activities: GWK Cultural Park Tour - GWK Park Admission Tickets Ticket Included
itinerary.accommodation: Cross Vibe Paasha Atelier Bali Kuta / Swiss-Belhotel Rainforest / Similar

itinerary.title: Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach | Uluwatu Sunset Tour with Kecak Fire Show | Visit to Kuta Market
itinerary.description: Today, start at Tanjung Benoa Beach, where thrilling water sports like jet skiing, parasailing & banana boat rides deliver the perfect adrenaline kick. After that, unwind at the serene Melasti Beach, framed by towering limestone cliffs. Continue to Uluwatu Temple, dramatically perched atop a cliff & immerse yourself in the captivating Kecak Dance. Conclude the evening at Kuta Market, where lively stalls make it an ideal spot for shopping souvenirs. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

name: Romantic Bali Honeymoon | Free 5 Star Rooftop Candlelight Dinner
description: Celebrate your love with the ultimate tropical luxury through our 'Romantic Bali Honeymoon' package, beautifully organized across 6 Nights and 7 Days. Carefully curated for couples, your romantic vacation begins with a three-night stay in the cultural heart of Ubud, highlighted by a classic open-top Vintage Volkswagen Car Tour and an extensive Bedugul mountain scenic loop. Shift your base to the vibrant beaches of Kuta for another three nights to enjoy sun-kissed coasts and an unforgettable private speedboat cruise to West Nusa Penida to photograph Kelingking Beach. Indulge in an adrenaline-pumping water sports combo at Tanjung Benoa Beach and a magical sunset view at Uluwatu Temple with a traditional Kecak fire dance. Complete with handpicked properties, fresh daily breakfast and dinner spreads, an authentic Balinese couple's spa, and a free premium rooftop candlelight dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo, this is the definitive island escape for honeymooners.
shortDescription: A premium 6N/7D romantic honeymoon loop covering Ubud's green valleys, West Nusa Penida shores, and an exclusive rooftop candlelight dinner.
highlights: Enjoy a private, highly romantic candlelight dinner on a premium starlit rooftop overlooking the ocean.
Cruise through emerald valley steps and historical temple grounds inside an open-top vintage Volkswagen car.
Photograph the globally iconic stone layouts of Handara Gate and the floating temple of Ulun Danu Beratan.
Conquer the tides together with thrilling private watersports and parasailing on the shores of Tanjung Benoa.
Soothe your mind and body together with an authentic, aromatic traditional Balinese couples spa massage.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, get transferred to your hotel in Ubud. Once at the hotel, check in to your specially decorated room and spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can head out and visit Goa Gajah, the ancient ‘Elephant Cave,’ rich with sacred carvings. Also, you can explore Bali Bird Park, where a variety of exotic birds await, or cool off at Waterbom Bali, a famous waterpark known for its exciting rides.
itinerary.accommodation: Ubud Heaven Sayan / Ubud Raya Villa / Similar

itinerary.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a complimentary floating breakfast. Later, set off on a Central Bali Volkswagen vintage car tour, combining timeless charm with scenic landscapes. Enjoy unlimited rides on the iconic Bali Swing, soaring above emerald valleys, before visiting the refreshing Tegenungan Waterfall. Continue to Tirta Empul Temple, famed for its sacred spring pools, and capture memories with a photoshoot at Sari Timbul. Conclude your tour at the stunning Tegallalang Rice Terrace, a UNESCO gem.
itinerary.accommodation: Ubud Heaven Sayan / Ubud Raya Villa / Similar

itinerary.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, explore the scenic highlands of Bedugul. Start with a visit to the iconic Handara Gate, famous for its striking Balinese architecture and the stunning mountain backdrop. Also, strike an amazing pose in front of the gate before visiting Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a floating temple set on Lake Beratan, known for its unique lakeside charm and spiritual ambience. Later, enjoy a short trek to the hidden Leke Leke Waterfalls, where crystal-clear cascades tumble amidst lush tropical greenery.
itinerary.accommodation: Ubud Heaven Sayan / Ubud Raya Villa / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kuta | Visit to Melasti Beach Tour | Watersports at Tenjung Benoa | Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire & Dance Show | Kuta Market Visit
itinerary.description: After check-out, get driven to Kuta with an exciting stop at Tanjung Benoa, Bali’s adventure hub, where thrilling watersports like jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides await. Also, enjoy a delicious lunch before continuing to Melasti Beach, famed for its dramatic limestone cliffs. Next, visit the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched high above the ocean, and witness the famous Kecak Fire Dance at sunset. Also, explore the vibrant stalls of Kuta Market before checking in at your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Desamuda Village / Fairfield by Marriott Bali Legian  / Similar

itinerary.title: Full Day Nusa Penida West Tour with Paluang Cliff
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a drive to Sanur Port and board a speedboat to Nusa Penida for a tour of its west coast. Next, visit Kelingking Beach, famed for its T-Rex–shaped cliff and breathtaking ocean views. Continue to Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool of crystal-clear waters, before admiring the dramatic arch at Broken Bay. Next, head to Paluang Cliff, offering panoramic views of Kelingking from a different angle. Conclude your day at Crystal Bay, known for its laid-back charm.
itinerary.accommodation: Desamuda Village / Fairfield by Marriott Bali Legian  / Similar

itinerary.title: Leisure Time in Kuta | Balinese Massage in Kuta | Candle Light Dinner at 5 Star Mamaka by Ovolo
itinerary.description: Today, enjoy a leisurely day in Kuta, where you can head out and explore the Kuta Art Market, a vibrant spot for souvenirs, or witness baby turtles at the Kuta Beach Sea Turtle Conservation Center. Later, indulge in a traditional Balinese massage in Kuta, known for its healing techniques and rejuvenating touch. In the evening, get driven to savor a romantic candlelight dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo’s rooftop, where sweeping ocean views and exquisite cuisine set the stage for an unforgettable night.

meals: Candle Light Dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo

name: Eternal Bali | Discovering Seashore Temples & Island Wonders
description: Immerse yourselves in the absolute grandeur of the tropical paradise with our 'Eternal Bali' vacation package, masterfully mapped across 7 Nights and 8 Days. Your exotic journey kicks off with three nights in the cultural valley of Ubud, highlighted by a private Kintamani Highland loop, unlimited Bali Jungle Swings, and visits to the iconic Handara Gate and floating Ulun Danu Beratan Temple. Transition smoothly to coastal Kuta for another four nights to explore the legendary Tanah Lot offshore temple at sunset. Pack your family days with a thrilling wildlife safari adventure at Bali Safari Marine Park via the Jungle Hopper package, an adrenaline-pumping water sports combo at Tanjung Benoa Beach, and an island cruise to Serangan Island. Conclude your dream holiday with a beautiful sunset at Uluwatu Temple and a relaxing stroll on Padang Padang Beach, creating an end-to-end seamless and highly magical Balinese retreat.
shortDescription: An extensive 7N/8D premium island getaway featuring iconic seashore temples, active wildlife safaris, jungle swings, and scenic highland trails.
highlights: Watch a magical tropical sunset over the ocean at the iconic cliffside Uluwatu and offshore Tanah Lot temples.
Encounter exotic global wildlife up close during an immersive jungle safari tram ride at Bali Safari Park.
Capture iconic couple portraits on the famous Bali Jungle Swing overlooking lush Tegalalang Rice Terraces.
Conquer the tides together with thrilling private parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides at Benoa beach.
Photograph the globally celebrated stone gates of Handara and the cascading waters of Tegenungan Waterfall.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ubud | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Bali's airport, you'll be greeted and transferred to your hotel for check-in. After settling in, you have the option to either relax and unwind or embark on a captivating exploration of Ubud. Discover the enchanting Ubud Monkey Forest, delve into the historical intrigue of Goa Gajah, wander through the serene Ubud Water Palace, or catch a show at Paradiso. After a day of adventure, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bakung Ubud Resort & Villa / Asri Sari Villa, Ubud / Similar

itinerary.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you'll embark on a sightseeing tour of Central Bali, with a convenient transfer from your hotel. Your journey will take you to the stunning Tegenungan Waterfall, the Kintamani Highlands, and Tegallalang Rice Terraces. Take the opportunity to savour the unique Luwak coffee (at an additional cost) and experience the thrill of a ride on the renowned Bali Swing. After a day filled with exploration and adventure, you'll be transferred back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bakung Ubud Resort & Villa / Asri Sari Villa, Ubud / Similar

itinerary.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, board your transfer from the hotel for an assisted sightseeing tour of some of Bali's iconic attractions. Capture amazing photos at the Handara Gate with the views of Mt. Batur. Visit Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a temple dedicated to the goddess of the lake, Dewi Danu. Later, witness the sunset at Tanah Lot temple, located amidst the Indian Ocean. After that, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bakung Ubud Resort & Villa / Asri Sari Villa, Ubud / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kuta | Visit to Bali Safari & Marine Park
itinerary.description: Check out from your Ubud hotel and transfer to Kuta, where you'll check in at your new hotel. Later, embark on a pre-booked transfer to the Bali Safari and Marine Park. Enjoy an exciting safari adventure and encounter over 100 wildlife species, including hippos, rhinos, binturongs, Komodo dragons, and tigers. After a day of wildlife exploration, you'll be transferred back to your hotel in Kuta for an overnight stay.
activities: Bali Safari And Marine Park (Ticket Included)
itinerary.accommodation: Bliss Surfer Hotel, Kuta / Diamond Hotel Kuta, Bali / Similar

itinerary.title: Excursion to Serangan Island
itinerary.description: Embark on a thrilling adventure as you get transferred to Tanjung Benoa Beach and board a glass-bottom boat for a scenic ride to Serangan Island. Spot colourful fish and even sea turtles through the clear floor. Soak up the sun and explore the island's charm at your own pace. Head to the Turtle Conservation and Education Center for an informative session. Also, enjoy water sports like jet skiing (at your own cost) at the beach. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bliss Surfer Hotel, Kuta / Diamond Hotel Kuta, Bali / Similar

itinerary.title: South Bali Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: On this day, board your transfer from the hotel for a sightseeing tour of South Bali. Enjoy an assisted drive to the beautiful Padang Padang Beach and take a stroll along the shoreline upon reaching there. Explore the majestic Uluwatu Temple, a cliffside Hindu temple known for its captivating architecture and traditional Kecak dance performances held at sunset (at an extra cost). Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bliss Surfer Hotel, Kuta / Diamond Hotel Kuta, Bali / Similar

itinerary.title: Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Spend this day by exploring Kuta at your own pace. You can visit attractions like Kuta Square, New Kuta Green Park, Pura Petitenget Temple, etc. In the evening, you may head to the Kuta Night Market, Kuta Art Market, Mal Bali Galeria, and more. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the Bali Airport. This is where your trip ends. Have a safe journey ahead!

name: Bali Beyond Ordinary | A Romantic Getaway
description: Ignite your romance with a massive adrenaline rush through our 'Bali Beyond Ordinary | Ultimate Adventure Couple' package, powerfully structured across 6 Nights and 7 Days. Engineered perfectly for dynamic couples who prefer mud trails over lazy beaches, this loop begins with three nights in a deluxe villa amidst the rugged valleys of Sidemen. Conquer technical off-road jungle terrains on a powerful private ATV quad bike ride and swing high over deep canyon cliffs together. Shift your base to Seminyak for three nights to face the open ocean on a high-speed craft to Nusa Penida for extreme reef edge snorkeling. Unwind your tired muscles with an authentic Balinese couple's massage, and celebrate your bond with a premium beachfront candlelight dinner at Sadara Resort. Conclude with a dramatic cliff sunset at Uluwatu Temple, creating the perfect balance of thrill and romance.
shortDescription: A high-octane 6N/7D getaway for thriller couples combining off-road mud tracks with dreamy oceanfront candlelight dining.
highlights: Tear through muddy jungle trails, river streams, and rural plantations on a heavy-duty ATV quad bike.
Plunge into the crystal clear marine currents of Nusa Penida to snorkel with exotic oceanic wildlife.
Scale the rugged, vertical cliff edges of Kelingking Beach and Paluang Cliff for jaw-dropping views.
Hike deep into the hidden valley chasms to locate the roaring, rocky cascades of Kanto Lampo Waterfall.
Witness a dramatic ocean-cliff sunset at Uluwatu Temple followed by a high-energy traditional Kecak Fire Dance.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Sidemen | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome! Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to your hotel in Sideman. Post check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can take a scenic walk to Gembleng Waterfall, a hidden gem with tiered rock pools offering natural infinity-style dips and jungle views. Also, you can visit Pande Silver Sidemen, where skilled artisans guide you through a hands-on silver jewelry-making workshop, or indulge in traditional therapies at Ananda Spa and Bathhouse.
itinerary.accommodation: Astana swaha Villa / Arta Nadi Villa / Similar

itinerary.title: East Bali Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to explore the scenic highlights of East Bali. Explore Tirta Gangga, a former royal water palace featuring elegant fountains, koi-filled pools, and intricate sculptures. Visit the stunning Lempuyang Temple, home to the famed “Gates of Heaven”, where you can capture amazing views of Mount Agung. Also, enjoy spending time at the serene Bukit Cinta Viewpoint, a hidden gem where sweeping rice terraces and volcanic backdrops create the perfect photo stop.
itinerary.accommodation: Astana swaha Villa / Arta Nadi Villa / Similar

itinerary.title: ATV Ride & Bali Swing Experience
itinerary.description: Set out for an adventurous day amidst Bali’s lush landscapes. Kick off the excitement with a thrilling Jungle ATV ride, as you navigate muddy trails, rocky paths, and lush forest tracks, an exhilarating way to experience Bali’s untamed beauty. Next, get driven to experience the iconic Bali Swing, where you can soar high above jungle canopies and rice fields, capturing stunning views and unforgettable photo moments. After an amazing day, get driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.description: Post checkout, get driven to Seminyak, Bali’s coastal town. En route, explore the Sidemen Rice Terrace, offering a glimpse into Bali’s timeless agricultural traditions. Also, visit the Kanto Lampo Waterfall, a hidden gem perfect for capturing that Instagram-worthy shot & marvel at the mythical figures carved at Goa Gajah, the ancient ‘Elephant Cave’ temple. Upon arrival in Seminyak, check into your hotel & relax. Later, get driven to Sadara restaurant & indulge in a romantic candlelight dinner.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida West Tour with Snorkeling Experience

Visit Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool carved into the rocky coastline, & marvel at the dramatic natural arch of Broken Bay. Don't forget Crystal Bay, known for its clear waters and vibrant marine life. Also try snorkeling among colorful coral reefs & tropical fish & savor a local lunch before getting driven back.

Then, enjoy stunning views of the Indian Ocean from Uluwatu Temple, perched on a cliff edge. As the sun sets, witness the captivating Kecak Dance performance, where rhythmic chants and fire-lit storytelling unfold against a dramatic sunset backdrop.

name: Treasures of Bali | From Sacred Sites to Beach Side
description: Discover the rich heritage and scenic coastal beauty of the island with our 'Treasures of Bali' vacation package, perfectly structured across 5 Nights and 6 Days. Your journey begins with a smooth pickup taking you to Ubud Green for a two-night stay, featuring private highland sightseeing tours, a local lunch, and the iconic Bali Jungle Swing. Explore iconic cultural monuments including Handara Gate, Ulun Danu Temple, and Git Git Waterfall. Shift your base to Ramada by Wyndham Bali Sunset Road Kuta for three nights to enjoy sun-kissed beaches and an exciting private day trip to West Nusa Penida for snorkeling. Conclude your tour with extensive visits to GWK Cultural Park, Uluwatu Temple, and Padang Padang Beach, ensuring a completely managed and traditional Balinese holiday experience.
shortDescription: A comprehensive 5N/6D multi-destination island tour exploring the cultural landmarks of Ubud and the popular beach fronts of Kuta.
highlights: Photograph the globally celebrated stone structures of Handara Gate and floating Ulun Danu Temple.
Capture spectacular landscape photos on the famous Bali Jungle Swing overlooking emerald rice terraces.
Cruise across the blue ocean to snorkel among vibrant coral fields and marine life around Nusa Penida.
Explore the giant monumental statues and scenic exhibition zones inside GWK Cultural Park.
Watch a magical tropical sunset from the ancient ocean-cliff ruins of the iconic Uluwatu Temple.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, get driven to your hotel in Ubud. Post check-in, spend the day at leisure, where you can head out & visit Celuk Village, famed for its exquisite silver artistry, and watch master craftsmen at work. Also, you can explore the sacred springs of Tirta Empul Temple or visit the Bali Bird Park, home to hundreds of exotic species amidst lush tropical gardens, offering an immersive encounter with vibrant wildlife.
itinerary.accommodation: Ubud Green ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ / Similar

itinerary.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a scenic sightseeing tour of Bali. Start with a visit to Kintamani Highlands, offering panoramic views of Mount Batur and its volcanic landscape. Continue to a local coffee plantation, discovering traditional brewing methods and savoring fresh flavors over a delightful packed lunch. Next, visit Tegenungan Waterfall & cool off in its natural pool, then admire the lush Tegalalang Rice Terraces. Conclude your day with an adrenaline rush on the iconic Bali Jungle Swing.
itinerary.accommodation: Ubud Green ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kuta | Handara Gate & Ulun Danu with Git Git Waterfall Tour
itinerary.description: Post checkout, board your transfer & get driven to Kuta. En route, embark on a scenic tour that begins at the iconic Handara Gate, a picture-perfect spot framed by lush mountains and traditional Balinese architecture. Continue to the Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, beautifully set on the shores of Lake Beratan. Later, visit the stunning Gitgit Waterfall, cascading amidst tropical greenery, before proceeding to your hotel in Kuta. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Ramada by Wyndham Bali Sunset Road Kuta ⭐⭐⭐⭐ / Similar

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida West Tour
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to Sanur Harbor and board a speedboat to the iconic island of Nusa Penida, famed for its rugged beauty and romantic charm. Begin with Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool where emerald waters glisten against rocky cliffs. Next, witness the dramatic seascape of Broken Bay with its striking rock arch. Continue to Crystal Bay, perfect for a shoreline stroll or snorkeling among vibrant marine life. After an amazing time, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Ramada by Wyndham Bali Sunset Road Kuta ⭐⭐⭐⭐ / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to GWK Park | Uluwatu Temple Tour | Trip to Padang Padang Beach
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to visit the GWK Cultural Park, where towering statues, cultural performances, and panoramic views showcase Bali’s rich heritage. Continue to the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on a cliff overlooking the Indian Ocean, and admire its sunset views paired with the famed Kecak dance performance. Later, relax at Padang Padang Beach, a hidden gem with soft sands, turquoise waters, and dramatic rock formations. After an amazing time, get driven to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Ramada by Wyndham Bali Sunset Road Kuta ⭐⭐⭐⭐ / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get driven to the Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight back home. This marks the end of your trip.
