name: The Bali Group Tour Adventure
description: Explore the very best of the island with our 'The Bali Group Tour Adventure' vacation package, perfectly structured across 6 Nights and 7 Days. Your journey begins with an arrival transfer leading to a Super Deluxe Hotel in Ubud for a three-night stay, featuring a Mount Batur sunrise trek with hot springs and a private Handara Gate sightseeing loop. Shift your base to Kuta for another three nights to enjoy sun-kissed coasts, a premium day out at Finns Beach Club, and a private day cruise to West Nusa Penida for snorkeling. Conclude your itinerary with surfing activities at Tanjung Benoa Beach and an evening tour of the iconic Uluwatu Temple, ensuring a completely managed and traditional Balinese group holiday experience.
shortDescription: A complete 6N/7D multi-destination group circle covering Ubud highlands, Mount Batur treks, and coastal sightseeing in Kuta.
highlights: Trek up to the summit of Mount Batur at sunrise and relax inside natural geothermal hot springs.
Photograph the globally celebrated stone structures of Handara Gate and floating Ulun Danu Temple.
Spend a relaxing beachside evening amidst the premium music and ocean views of Finns Beach Club.
Cruise across the blue ocean to snorkel among vibrant coral fields and marine life around Nusa Penida.
Learn to ride the ocean waves with an exciting surfing session on the shores of Tanjung Benoa Beach.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ubud | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Arrive in Bali and kickstart your island adventure with your group! Upon arrival at Bali Airport, get driven to the hotel in Ubud and check in. Spend the day relaxing or step out to explore nearby attractions on your own. You can visit the Ubud Monkey Forest, where playful macaques wander among ancient temples, or explore Goa Gajah, known for its beautifully carved entrance. In the evening, you can relax at a cozy café and bond with your fellow travellers.
itinerary.accommodation: Bhanuswari Resort and Spa Ubud / Tejaprana Resort & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Trek to Mount Batur
itinerary.description: Wake up early and set out with your group for a sunrise trek to Mount Batur. As you hike up the volcanic slopes, feel the excitement build before witnessing the first rays of sunlight spreading over Lake Batur and the surrounding highlands. After the trek, relax your tired muscles in a natural hot spring, where the warm, mineral-rich waters offer the perfect refresh. Later, get driven to the hotel, unwind, and share stories of your morning adventure with your fellow travellers.
itinerary.accommodation: Bhanuswari Resort and Spa Ubud / Tejaprana Resort & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Full Day Ubud Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Hop in with your group for a scenic drive through Bali’s lush northern highlands. Pass rolling hills and misty jungles as you explore some of the island’s most stunning landmarks, from the serene Ulun Danu Beratan Temple floating over calm waters to the stunning Handara Gate framed by green peaks. Also, feel the cool spray at Gitgit Waterfall and capture the beauty of Bali’s countryside with the group. After a full day of exploring and laughter, get driven back to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Bhanuswari Resort and Spa Ubud / Tejaprana Resort & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kuta | Visit to Finns Beach Club
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from your hotel in Ubud and set off with your travel companions on a scenic drive to Kuta. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. As evening sets in, get driven to the lively Finns Beach Club, a beachfront hub known for its infinity pools, sunset views, and upbeat tropical music. Also, soak in the lively atmosphere, share laughter over refreshing cocktails, and dance by the waves as the night unfolds. After an amazing day, get driven to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida West Tour with Snorkelling
itinerary.description: Embark with your travel crew on an exciting Nusa Penida West adventure! Get driven to Sanur Harbour and hop on a speedboat to the island. Once there, explore the iconic Kelingking Beach with its T-Rex-shaped cliff, marvel at the shimmering blues of Angel’s Billabong, and capture stunning views at Broken Bay. Later, spend some time relaxing at Bubu Beach, where clear waters and coral reefs await. Also, you can opt for snorkeling before getting driven back to your hotel.

name: Romantic Singapore Vacation | Free Adventure Cove Waterpark Tickets
description: Experience the absolute best of the futuristic city-state with our 'Romantic Singapore Vacation' holiday package, completely arranged across 5 Nights and 6 Days. Base your stay in a comfortable deluxe property for five nights with round-trip flights from Delhi to Singapore included. Explore iconic urban wonders like the Marina Bay Sands Skypark Observation Deck, Gardens by the Bay, and the immersive River Wonders wildlife park. Enjoy thrilling day-long excursions to Universal Studios Singapore and ride the scenic Singapore Cable Car. This extensive loop also packs in an evening at the Night Safari with a tram ride, free entry tokens to Adventure Cove Waterpark, and the dramatic Wings of Time laser show, creating a completely seamless and well-managed modern vacation.
shortDescription: A premium 5N/6D flight-inclusive Singapore getaway combining city landmarks, top theme parks, and stunning waterfront attractions.
highlights: Admire the stunning panoramic views of the city skyline from the high Marina Bay Sands Skypark deck.
Explore the giant glass domes of Cloud Forest and walk the high aerial paths of the OCBC Skyway.
Enjoy an action-packed day trying thrilling movie-themed rides and movie sets inside Universal Studios.
Watch an incredible evening laser and water display sitting by the open coastline during the Wings of Time show.
Encounter exotic nocturnal wildlife up close during an immersive guided evening tram ride at the Night Safari.

You can visit iFly Singapore for an exciting indoor skydiving experience or stroll through the National Orchid Garden to admire its stunning collection of orchids. You can also spend time at the Singapore Zoo, renowned for its diverse wildlife and immersive habitats. Afterwards, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

Stroll across the Helix Bridge, and explore the vibrant streets of Chinatown. Next, head to Marina Bay Sands SkyPark to take-in panoramic views of Singapore’s skyline from its observation deck. Continue to Gardens by the Bay and wander through the Cloud Forest and the Flower Dome. Afterward, get transferred to your hotel.

There, you’ll enjoy a tram ride through different zones to see nocturnal animals like tigers, lions, giraffes, and elephants. End the day with getting driven to your hotel.

After an action-packed day, you'll be transferred back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

shortDescription: A comprehensive 6N/7D multi-country group circle combining central city sightseeing loops across both Singapore and Kuala Lumpur.
highlights: Admire the stunning panoramic views of the city skyline from the high Marina Bay Sands Skypark deck.
Enjoy an action-packed day trying thrilling movie-themed rides and movie sets inside Universal Studios.
Scale the iconic rainbow steps leading up to the sacred limestone chambers of the historic Batu Caves.
Ride a scenic high-speed cable car up to the premium entertainment resorts of Genting Highlands.
Pose beside realistic wax twins of global icons and celebrities inside Madame Tussauds Museum.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Singapore | Visit Marina Bay Sands And Gardens By The Bay
itinerary.description: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival in Singapore, embark on a city tour, visiting landmarks such as the Sri Mariamman Temple and the Merlion statue for scenic views of the Singapore River. Discover Chinatown's bustling markets, then check-in at the hotel. Enjoy evening vistas from the Marina Bay Sands observation deck and explore Gardens By The Bay's futuristic Supertree Grove before getting transferred back to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: V Hotel Lavender / Hotel Boss / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Sentosa Island | Enjoy Madame Tussauds & Wings of Time Show
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning today and later, get transferred to Sentosa Island, famous for its pristine beaches and luxury resorts. Once on the island, visit Madame Tussauds wax museum, where you can pose with your favourite celebrities and enjoy an immersive experience. Later, witness the spectacular Wings of Time show, a breathtaking light, sound, and special effects display set against the backdrop of the sea. Later, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: V Hotel Lavender / Hotel Boss / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Kick off your day with an exhilarating visit to Southeast Asia's only Universal Studios theme park, famed for its thrilling rides and seven movie-themed zones. Dive into the glamour of Hollywood, meet your favourite characters, and experience the adrenaline rush in Sci-Fi City with its electrifying rides. Embark on epic Jurassic Park adventures in the Lost World. Each zone offers unique attractions and excitement for everyone. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: V Hotel Lavender / Hotel Boss / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer from Singapore to Kuala Lumpur | Via Putrajaya
itinerary.description: Check-out from the hotel and embark on your journey to Kuala Lumpur in a coach, with a brief stop at Putrajaya. Here, you can explore the city's futuristic architecture and lush green landscapes, with iconic sites like Perdana Putra and the Seri Wawasan Bridge on your own. You can even take a leisurely stroll through the Botanical Gardens or enjoy a boat ride on Putrajaya Lake. Afterwards, continue your journey to reach Kuala Lumpur and check-in at the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Furama Bukit Bintang / KIP Hotel Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia / Similar

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour | Visit To KL Tower
itinerary.description: Get ready for a city tour of Kuala Lumpur. Start by visiting iconic landmarks such as the National Mosque, King's Palace, Sultan Abdul Samad Building, Merdeka Square, National Monument, and Cocoa House. Afterwards, head to the majestic KL Tower, where you can explore attractions like the Mini Zoo, and the Blue Coral Aquarium, or experience the Sky Box with its captivating glass-floor view (at an additional cost). In the evening, explore local markets before getting transferred back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Furama Bukit Bintang / KIP Hotel Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip To Genting Highlands | Visit Batu Caves
itinerary.description: Get transferred for a picturesque journey to the Genting Highlands. Along the way, stop at the majestic Batu Caves, a limestone hill housing cave temples and a shrine dedicated to Lord Murugan, a Hindu deity. Then, proceed to the Genting Skyway Lower Station to board a cable car to the peak. Upon arrival, immerse yourself in the vibrant casino resort and explore the wonders of Snow World. Conclude your day with a transfer back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Furama Bukit Bintang / KIP Hotel Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Depart from your hotel and bid adieu to Malaysia as you are transferred to the airport. Board your flight back home with pleasant memories.

name: Dubai Luxurious Family Vacation | From Skyscrapers to Desert Adventures
description: Treat your family to an elite international holiday with our 'Dubai Luxurious Family Vacation | From Skyscrapers to Desert Adventures' package, structured across 5 Nights and 6 Days. Anchor your stay in a premium luxury hotel property for five nights with hot daily hotel breakfasts included. Cruise past the skyline on a premium sunset yacht ride along Dubai Marina and experience a desert safari upgrade with a VIP Majlis arrangement. This top-tier family itinerary also packs in full admission tokens to IMG Worlds of Adventure, KidZania, Dubai Safari Park with the Explorer Safari train tour, and the iconic Burj Khalifa 124 and 125 level observation decks combined with a premium rooftop meal.

highlights: Sail past iconic illuminated coastal landmarks during a premium sunset yacht ride along Dubai Marina.
Savor gourmet Arabian hospitality inside an exclusive VIP Majlis seating area during your desert safari.
Enjoy a premium rooftop lunch or dinner overlooking downtown landmarks from the heights of Burj Khalifa.
Track exotic wild animals from an open-air vehicle during the guided Explorer Safari train tour.
Watch your kids try real-world interactive professions inside the massive indoor city of KidZania.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai | Evening Yacht Experience

In the evening, get driven to Dubai Marina for a luxurious yacht experience. Admire the city's towering landmarks like Burj Al Arab & the Palm Jumeirah casting reflections on the water as the sun goes down. Relax with your family & capture stunning pictures, making unforgettable memories under Dubai's skyline.

itinerary.title: Dubai Desert Safari Experience
itinerary.description: Escape into the heart of the Arabian desert for an evening filled with excitement & cultural experiences. From the hotel, board the 4X4 vehicle & get driven to Dubai's golden dunes on a thrilling dune-bashing ride. Upon arriving, you & your little ones can try camel ride or sandboarding. Moreover, witness a beautiful sunset over the dunes before heading to the VIP Majlis area where you will be served a lavish dinner under the stars as you watch entertaining fire shows & belly dancing.

itinerary.title: Visit to IMG World of Adventures
itinerary.description: Today, step into the world of fantasy at IMG Worlds of Adventure, where iconic Marvel superheroes & Cartoon Network characters create an amazing vibe. Feel the rush on gravity-defying roller coasters, watch action-packed 4D experiences, & explore themed zones that spark excitement in kids & adults alike. Whether it's meeting Spider-Man, racing through Lost Valley’s prehistoric jungle, or enjoying themed meals, make the most of your time with your family at the world’s largest indoor theme park.

itinerary.title: Visit to Dubai Safari Park & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: Begin your day by making the first stop at Dubai Safari Park, where animals roam in their natural habitats. From mighty lions to playful elephants & rare white tigers, capture a glimpse of Dubai's animal kingdom. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel to relax for the noon. Later, in the evening, get driven to the iconic Burj Khalifa. Ascend to its 124th level & marvel at Dubai's skyline gleaming beautifully. End the night with a rooftop meal & try various delicious multi-cuisine dishes.

itinerary.description: Let your little one step into a world of imagination at KidZania, where children take on real-world roles in a mini-city built just for them. From being a firefighter to running a restaurant, interactive experiences keep young minds engaged while you can relax or explore Dubai Mall. With plenty of laughter, hands-on learning, & immersive play, enjoy a perfect mix of fun & education, wrapping up the day with smiles & cherished family memories.

name: Dubai & Abu Dhabi Discovery Tour | Classic Traveler Delight
description: Explore the absolute best of the United Arab Emirates with our 'Dubai & Abu Dhabi Discovery Tour | Classic Traveler Delight' package, tightly mapped across 4 Nights and 5 Days. Base your stay for four nights at Arabian Park Dubai, an Edge by Rotana Hotel with standard daily breakfasts included. Discover the cultural heritage of Deira and Bur Dubai on a shared sightseeing drive, climb the massive Dubai Frame, visit the Wings of Mexico, and ascend the Burj Khalifa during non-prime hours followed by the Dubai Fountain Show. This extensive loop also features a premium desert safari with a barbecue meal, a luxury Lotus Mega Yacht dinner cruise, and a complete Abu Dhabi city sightseeing tour.
shortDescription: monumental 4N/5D bi-city itinerary highlighting landmark architectural frames, mega yacht cruises, and Abu Dhabi exploration.
highlights: Sail past iconic skyscrapers while enjoying a premium dinner layout on the massive Lotus Mega Yacht.
Witness spectacular 360-degree views of old and new city quadrants from the high Dubai Frame walkways.
Capture iconic artistic photographs standing before the famous Wings of Mexico bronze sculpture.
Watch the spectacular synchronized musical water performances during the evening Dubai Fountain Show.
Experience high-octane dune bashing adventures over high sand tracks inside a rugged 4x4 safari vehicle.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai | Lotus Mega Yacht Dinner Experience
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Venice of the Gulf! Upon arrival at Dubai Airport, board your transfer and get driven to the hotel. Post check-in, relax for a while. In the evening, get driven to Dubai Marina Harbour and board the luxurious Lotus Mega Yacht dinner cruise. Sail past the glittering skyline and world-famous landmarks as you savor a lavish buffet spread. With live entertainment, a serene ambience, and starlit views over the Arabian Gulf, the cruise experience is unforgettable.

itinerary.description: Today, set out on a full-day Dubai City Sightseeing Tour. Begin with a drive along Sheikh Zayed Road and admire architectural marvels like Jumeirah Mosque. Also, enjoy stunning views of the Atlantis Palm Hotel from Jumeirah Beach before getting dropped off at the Dubai Mall. From there, just a short walk away, head to the Burj Khalifa. Once there, ascend to its 124th & 125th floors for panoramic views. Conclude your day with the dazzling Fountain Show and a photo stop at the Wings of Mexico.

itinerary.title: Dubai Frame | Dubai Premium Desert Safari with BBQ meal
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to visit the iconic Dubai Frame, where you will witness the perfect contrast between Old Dubai and the city’s futuristic skyline. Later, get driven to the hotel. In the afternoon, embark on an unforgettable Premium Dubai desert safari adventure. Feel the thrill of dune bashing, try camel rides, and enjoy henna painting before witnessing live Emirati performances like belly dancing, Khaliji, and Tanura. Conclude with a BBQ dinner under the starlit desert sky.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Abu Dhabi

Next, step back in time at the Heritage Village, where traditional crafts, Bedouin tents, & cultural exhibits reflect the emirate’s rich heritage. Conclude with a stop at the bustling Dates Market, famous for its wide variety of premium dates & local specialties, before getting driven to the hotel.

name: Luxurious Dubai | An Escape to the City of Gold
description: Immerse yourself in a premium urban vacation with our 'Luxurious Dubai | An Escape to the City of Gold' package, masterfully mapped across 6 Nights and 7 Days. Anchor your stay in a premium luxury hotel property for six nights with hot daily breakfasts included. Discover central heritage corridors on a shared half-day city tour and ascend the iconic Burj Khalifa 124th floor combined with access to the Dubai Aquarium. This high-end itinerary also features full entry passes to IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village with Miracle Garden, AYA Universe, The View at The Palm, Dubai Frame, Dubai Dolphinarium, a shared evening dhow dinner cruise, and an all-in-one shared evening desert safari complete with a barbecue dinner camp.
shortDescription: A premium 6N/7D comprehensive city circuit featuring high-altitude observation decks, immersive digital universes, and top-tier theme parks.
highlights: Witness spectacular 360-degree views of the city skyline from the 124th floor of Burj Khalifa.
Walk across the thrilling high-altitude glass-floored bridge inside the iconic 150-meter-tall Dubai Frame.
Step inside a surreal world of cosmic light and digital soundscapes inside the innovative AYA Universe.
Enjoy panoramic views of the world-famous Palm Jumeirah structure from the high decks of The View.
Experience high-octane dune bashing adventures over high sand tracks inside a rugged 4x4 safari vehicle.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai | Dhow Cruise Dinner
itinerary.description: Welcome to Dubai, Venice of the Gulf! Upon arrival at the Dubai Airport, get transferred to your hotel and check-in. Enjoy breathtaking views of city's modern skyline and coastline, savour a delicious dinner and a Tanoura dance show onboard. After a wonderful evening, board your transfer back to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

Later, board the transfer back to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to IMG Worlds of Adventure
itinerary.description: Today, start your day with getting transferred to IMG Worlds of Adventure, Dubai’s premier indoor theme park. Explore themed zones like Marvel, Lost Valley, Cartoon Network and IMG Boulevard. Next, experience exhilarating rides, meet superheroes, beloved cartoon characters, and create lasting memories. Conclude your adventure with boarding your transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dubai Sightseeing Tour | Visit the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Aquarium

Visit Jumeirah beach, Atlantis hotel, Dubai Museum and Jumeirah Mosque along with the Mall of Emirates and Dubai Mall. Next, explore Dubai Aquarium, housing thousands of aquatic animals in the world's largest suspended acrylic tank. Then, ascend to Burj Khalifa's 124th-floor observation deck for panoramic views of Dubai. Afterwards, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Visit Dubai Frame | Enjoy Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai | Day at Leisure

You can visit iconic spots like the Dubai Miracle Garden, which holds the Guinness World Record for the largest flower garden. You can also explore the Bollywood Parks, Dubai Garden Glow, & Dubai Fountain, among others. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dubai Sightseeing Tour | Visit to Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: In the morning, you'll be driven to explore Dubai on a sightseeing tour. Begin with a visit to the Dubai Museum, offering a glimpse into the roots and evolution of Dubai's cultural identity. Next, visit the iconic Sheik Zayed Road, the Dubai Creek, and many more attractions. Later, visit the Burj Khalifa and ascend to the 124th and 125th floors for breathtaking panoramic views of Dubai's skyline. Afterwards, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Visit to Dubai Frame | Museum of Future Tour

Then, get driven to the Museum of the Future, to experience cutting-edge technology. Also, explore the various visionary exhibits that showcase innovations shaping our world. Later, get transferred back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dubai Desert Safari Experience

description: Explore the ultimate wonders of the Emirates with our 'Splendid Dubai with Abu Dhabi' group holiday package, perfectly structured across 6 Nights and 7 Days. Split your stay comfortably between a deluxe hotel in Dubai for four nights and a super deluxe property in Abu Dhabi for two nights, inclusive of daily breakfasts and half-board meals. highlights: Witness spectacular 360-degree views of the city skyline from the 124th and 125th floors of Burj Khalifa.
Experience high-octane dune bashing adventures over high sand tracks inside a rugged 4x4 safari vehicle.
Ride world-record-breaking high-speed rollercoasters inside the indoor pavilions of Ferrari World Abu Dhabi.

name: Royal Rajasthan - Small Group Tour
description: Immerse yourself in imperial history with our 'Royal Rajasthan - Small Group Tour' package, masterfully mapped across 5 Nights and 6 Days. Split your comfortable stays between Jaipur for two nights, Jodhpur for one night, and Jaisalmer for two nights, inclusive of hot daily hotel breakfasts. Discover massive architectural marvels on a half-day Jaipur sightseeing circuit covering City Palace and Hawa Mahal, alongside an Amer Fort heritage tour. This curated group itinerary also features comprehensive city circuits across Jodhpur's Mehrangarh Fort, Jaisalmer Fort, traditional Havelis, and thrilling adventure activities on the Thar sand dunes.
shortDescription: A foundational 5N/6D royal circuit linking the majestic palaces of Jaipur, historic forts of Jodhpur, and golden desert dunes of Jaisalmer.
highlights: Explore the intricate pink sandstone windows and unique structural architecture of the iconic Hawa Mahal.
Ascend the massive hilltop ramparts of Amer Fort to witness spectacular panoramic views of the valley.
Walk through the living golden sandstone lanes and bustling markets inside the massive Jaisalmer Fort.
Stand atop the towering vertical cliff walls of Mehrangarh Fort overlooking the historic blue city of Jodhpur.
Experience a memorable evening riding camels over fine desert tracks inside the scenic Thar sand dunes.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Jaipur, the Pink City known for its royal charm and vibrant culture. Upon arrival at the airport\railway station, enjoy a smooth transfer to your hotel. After check-in, relax and explore the city at your own pace. Later, you may visit the Albert Hall Museum to admire its architecture, seek blessings at the Govind Dev Ji Temple, and experience Rajasthani culture, folk performances, and local cuisine at Chokhi Dhani. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Park Central / Similar

itinerary.title: Jaipur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, set out on a guided city tour of Jaipur. Begin at the City Palace, a grand fusion of Rajput and Mughal artistry, and continue to Jantar Mantar, a UNESCO site famed for the world’s largest stone sundial. Also, admire the intricate lattice windows of Hawa Mahal and the intricate marble architectur of Birla Mandir. Later, explore Amber Fort & witness the dazzling mirror work of Sheesh Mahal. Conclude your day, soaking in the panoramic Pink City views from famous Nahargarh Fort.
itinerary.accommodation: Park Central / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jodhpur | Jodhpur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: After check-out, enjoy a scenic drive through the Aravallis to Jodhpur, the Blue City. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and relax. Later, get driven for a half-day sightseeing tour. Explore the Mehrangarh Fort, offering stunning views of the blue-painted houses, and visit Jaswant Thada, a marble cenotaph admired for its intricate carvings. Continue to the grand Umaid Bhawan Palace, one of the world’s largest residences, before ending the day exploring the vibrant Ghanta Ghar market.
itinerary.accommodation: Treehouse Rajbagh, Jodhpur / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jaislamer | Jaisalmer Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: After check out, embark on a scenic drive through Rajasthan’s desert landscapes to Jaisalmer, the Golden City. Upon arrival, begin your exploration with a visit to the Jaisalmer War Memorial, a tribute to the courage and sacrifice of Indian soldiers. Continue to the stunning Jaisalmer Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the world’s few living forts, where golden sandstone walls house bustling markets, temples, and homes. Afterwards, get driven to the hotel and check-in.
itinerary.accommodation: Casa De Kaku / Similar

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Sightseeing Tour | Desert Camping & Adventure Activities
itinerary.description: Check-out & embark on a half-day exploration of Jaisalmer’s heritage. Begin at Gadisar Lake, a stunning reservoir dotted with shrines and ghats, before visiting the beautifully carved Patwon Ki Haveli, Salim Singh Ki Haveli, and Nathmal Ki Haveli—stunning examples of golden sandstone architecture. Later, get driven to the desert camp & check-in. Then, set out on a camel safari at the Sam Sand Dunes, where fiery sunsets, folk performances, & starry skies create an unforgettable desert experience.
itinerary.accommodation: The Mama's Resort and Camp In Jaisalmer / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Check-out & bid farewell to the Golden City as you drive back to Jodhpur, passing through the vast desert landscapes and glimpses of rural Rajasthan’s vibrant colors. Upon arrival, you’ll be dropped at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. Take with you unforgettable memories of Rajasthan—the regal palaces of Jaipur, the blue-washed charm of Jodhpur, and the golden sands of Jaisalmer—that together weave a journey of culture, history, and timeless beauty.

name: Time Travel In Rajasthan
description: Embark on an expansive heritage vacation with our 'Time Travel In Rajasthan' holiday circuit, completely structured across 6 Nights and 7 Days. Split your comfortable stays between Jaipur for two nights, Udaipur for two nights, Jodhpur for one night, and Jaisalmer for one night, inclusive of daily breakfasts. Discover massive architectural marvels on private Jaipur city tours covering City Palace, Hawa Mahal, and historic forts. This curated itinerary also features comprehensive full-day sightseeing across Udaipur's lakes and palaces, alongside targeted city circuits covering Jodhpur's Mehrangarh Fort and Jaisalmer's famous traditional Havelis.
shortDescription: A comprehensive 6N/7D royal circuit linking the iconic heritage palaces of Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, and Jaisalmer.
highlights: Explore the intricate pink sandstone windows and unique structural architecture of the iconic Hawa Mahal.
Capture beautiful photographs of the floating marble facades of Jal Mahal reflecting on the calm lake waters.
Witness spectacular panoramic lakeside views from the massive structures inside the Udaipur City Palace Complex.
Stand atop the towering vertical cliff walls of Mehrangarh Fort overlooking the historic blue city of Jodhpur.
Stroll past the highly intricate stone-carved balconies of the historic Patwaon Ki Haveli in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur | Half Day Jaipur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to Jaipur, the vibrant Pink City. After arrival, get transferred to your hotel and check in. Later, explore the royal City Palace and its museum, followed by a visit to the iconic Hawa Mahal, famed for its intricate façade. Continue to the historic Albert Hall Museum, showcasing art and artefacts from Rajasthan’s past. End your day at the serene Birla Mandir, admired for its marble architecture, tranquil atmosphere, and scenic city views.
itinerary.accommodation: Treebo Premium Baramasi By Jai Club Prime / Similar

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day by exploring Amer Fort, known for its grand courtyards & intricate architecture and the stunning Sheesh Mahal. Continue to Jaigarh Fort to witness the legendary Jaivana Cannon, followed by a visit to Nahargarh Fort for sweeping views of the Aravalli ranges. Later, stop at the iconic Jal Mahal for Instagram-worthy photos before visiting Govind Dev Ji Temple.
itinerary.accommodation: Treebo Premium Baramasi By Jai Club Prime / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Udaipur | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: After check-out, set off on a scenic drive to Udaipur, the romantic City of Lakes, as Rajasthan’s rugged landscapes slowly give way to serene valleys. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and unwind. Later, enjoy leisure time at your own pace—explore the lively Bapu Bazaar for local shopping or visit the Under the Sun Aquarium to discover a variety of fascinating aquatic species.
itinerary.accommodation: Kaner Bagh A Heritage Boutique Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Full Day Udaipur Highlights Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day exploring Udaipur with a visit to the hilltop Sajjangarh Fort (Monsoon Palace), offering views of the Aravalli ranges. Continue to Fateh Sagar Lake and stroll through the lush gardens of Saheliyon Ki Bari, once designed for royal maidens. Next, discover the grandeur of the City Palace Complex and the rare Crystal Gallery. Later, enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola (at extra cost), passing by the glowing Jagmandir Palace, before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Kaner Bagh A Heritage Boutique Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jodhpur | Jodhpur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: After check-out, enjoy a scenic drive to Jodhpur, the Blue City. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and take some time to relax. Later, explore the grand Mehrangarh Fort, rising above the blue-painted houses below. Continue to Jaswant Thada, a marble cenotaph known for its intricate carvings, and admire the grandeur of Umaid Bhawan Palace, one of the world’s largest royal residences. End your day at the lively Ghanta Ghar market, soaking in Jodhpur’s vibrant local charm.
itinerary.accommodation: The Kothi Heritage / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jaislamer | Jaisalmer Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: After check-out, set off on a journey across Rajasthan’s desert landscapes – Jaisalmer, the Golden City. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel. Later, enjoy sightseeing tour, starting with the serene Gadisar Lake, a reservoir lined with shrines and ghats. Continue to explore the intricate sandstone havelis—Patwon Ki Haveli, Salim Singh Ki Haveli, and Nathmal Ki Haveli—celebrated for their detailed carvings and rich desert heritage. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

name: Weekend Getaway to Ranthambore
description: Escape into the wild with our 'Weekend Getaway to Ranthambore' holiday circuit, perfectly mapped across 2 Nights and 3 Days. Base your stay inside a comfortable Ranthambore property for two nights with hot daily hotel breakfasts included. Track exotic wildlife inside a rugged open-air vehicle on a confirmed Jeep Safari at Ranthambore National Park. This well-managed weekend loop also packs in an exciting day trip to the National Chambal Gharial Sanctuary alongside a scenic historic trek up to the ancient Ranthambore Fort and Trinetra Ganesh Temple.
shortDescription: A refreshing 2N/3D wildlife break combining rugged national park jeep safaris, historic hill forts, and river sanctuary excursions.
highlights: Search for majestic Royal Bengal Tigers roaming freely inside their natural historic forest habitats.
Spot rare fish-eating Gharials and marsh crocodiles during a scenic excursion along the Chambal River.
Hike past massive stone gateways to explore the towering ruins of the ancient Ranthambore Fort.
Seek holy blessings at the unique historic three-eyed idol inside the Trinetra Ganesh Temple.
Enjoy peaceful evening bonfire hours hosted amidst the serene natural surroundings of your forest resort.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur | Transfer to Ranthambore
itinerary.description: Welcome to Jaipur! Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to Ranthambore. Once you reach, visit the historic Ranthambore Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its majestic architecture and scenic views. Next, visit the revered Ganesh Temple, nestled within the fort, housing the idol of the three eyed Ganesha. After your visit, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check in for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Ananta Palace / Ranthambore Bagh Villa / Similar

itinerary.title: Jeep Safari at Ranthambore National Park | Day trip to National Chambal Gharial Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Today, early in the morning get ready for an exciting Ranthambore Safari, and spot Bengal tigers, leopards, and sloth bears in one of India’s premier wildlife reserves. Afterward, get transferred to your hotel & relax for a while. Later, visit the National Chambal Gharial Sanctuary, known for its conservation of the endangered gharial crocodile. The sanctuary is home to rare species like river dolphins & migratory birds. Enjoy the rich flora & stunning landscapes of these protected areas.

name: Luxury Rajasthan, Smart Price - Full Circuit
description: Experience the grand lifestyle of kings with our 'Luxury Rajasthan, Smart Price - Full Circuit' package, masterfully mapped across 7 Nights and 8 Days. Split your premium stays between Jaipur for two nights, Udaipur for two nights, Jodhpur for one night, and Jaisalmer for two nights, inclusive of daily breakfasts. Discover massive architectural marvels on a guided Jaipur city tour covering City Palace and Hawa Mahal, alongside an Amer Fort heritage circuit. This extensive itinerary also features comprehensive full-day sightseeing across Udaipur's lakes, Jodhpur's Mehrangarh Fort, Jaisalmer Fort, traditional Havelis, and thrilling sand dune activities.
shortDescription: A premium 7N/8D grand heritage loop blending elite palace tours in Jaipur and Udaipur with golden desert safaris.
highlights: Explore the intricate pink sandstone windows and unique structural architecture of the iconic Hawa Mahal.
Witness spectacular panoramic lakeside views from the massive structures inside the Udaipur City Palace Complex.
Stand atop the towering vertical cliff walls of Mehrangarh Fort overlooking the historic blue city of Jodhpur.
Walk through the living golden sandstone lanes and bustling markets inside the massive Jaisalmer Fort.
Experience a memorable evening riding camels over fine desert tracks inside the scenic Thar sand dunes.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur | Half Day Jaipur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to Jaipur, the lively Pink City. After arrival, you will get transferred to your hotel and check in. Later, you can explore the City Palace and its museum, offering insight into Jaipur’s royal lifestyle. You may then visit the iconic Hawa Mahal and admire its detailed façade. Continue to the Albert Hall Museum to understand the city’s heritage. End your day with a peaceful visit to Birla Mandir, and later get driven back to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Treebo Premium Baramasi By Jai Club Prime / Similar

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day by exploring the grand Amer Fort, known for its impressive courtyards and scenic views. You can then walk towards the Sheesh Mahal to admire its mirror work. After that, you will get transferred to Jaigarh Fort to visit the famous Jaivana cannon. Continue your journey to Nahargarh Fort for panoramic views of the Aravalli range. Later, stop at Jal Mahal for pictures.
itinerary.accommodation: Treebo Premium Baramasi By Jai Club Prime / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Udaipur | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Check-out & enjoy a scenic drive towards Udaipur, the City of Lakes, watching Rajasthan’s landscapes shift from rugged terrains to serene valleys along the way. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and relax for a while. Later, enjoy leisure time at your own pace—explore the lively Bapu Bazaar for local shopping or visit the Under the Sun Aquarium to discover a variety of fascinating aquatic species.
itinerary.accommodation: Kaner Bagh A Heritage Boutique Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Full Day Udaipur Highlights Tour
itinerary.description: Today, set out to explore Udaipur on a full-day sightseeing tour. Begin at Sajjangarh Fort, or Monsoon Palace, perched high above the city and enjoy stunning views of the Aravalli hills. Continue to Fateh Sagar Lake, a serene waterbody surrounded by hills, before strolling through the charming Saheliyon Ki Bari gardens. In the evening, discover the grandeur of the City Palace Complex and its Crystal Gallery, then enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola to Jagmandir Palace glowing under the lights.
itinerary.accommodation: Kaner Bagh A Heritage Boutique Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jodhpur | Jodhpur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: After check-out, enjoy a drive through the scenic Aravallis to Jodhpur, the Blue City. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and relax. Later, enjoy a sightseeing tour & visit the famous Mehrangarh Fort, offering amazing views of its blue-painted houses. Also, visit Jaswant Thada, a marble cenotaph adorned with intricate carvings, and admire the grandeur of Umaid Bhawan Palace, one of the world’s largest residences. Conclude your day exploring the bustling Ghanta Ghar market.
itinerary.accommodation: Kothi Heritage / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jaislamer | Jaisalmer Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Check out & enjoy a scenic journey across Rajasthan’s desert landscapes to Jaisalmer, the Golden City. Upon arrival, begin your exploration with a visit to the Jaisalmer War Memorial, a tribute to the valor and sacrifice of Indian soldiers. Continue to the iconic Jaisalmer Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the world’s few living forts, where golden sandstone walls enclose bustling markets, ancient temples, and homes. Afterwards, proceed to your hotel for check-in & an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Antra Inn Jaisalmer / Similar

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Sightseeing Tour | Desert Camping & Adventure Activities
itinerary.description: After check-out, embark on a half-day tour of Jaisalmer’s architectural and cultural gems. Begin at Gadisar Lake, a stunning reservoir surrounded by shrines and ghats, before exploring the intricately carved Patwon Ki Haveli, Salim Singh Ki Haveli, and Nathmal Ki Haveli—each showcasing sandstone craftsmanship. Later, get driven to the desert camp for check-in and set out on a camel safari, where sunset views, folk performances, and starry skies create an unforgettable desert evening.
itinerary.accommodation: K.K. Resort & Camp, Jaisalmer / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: After check-out, bid farewell to Jaisalmer, the Golden City. upon arrival in Jodhpur, you will be dropped at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. As you depart, carry with you cherished memories of Rajasthan—from Jaipur’s regal palaces and Udaipur’s romantic lakeside charm to Jodhpur’s striking blue hues and Jaisalmer’s golden dunes—an unforgettable journey through India’s royal heartland.

name: Rajasthan Regal Retreat | Trails of Forts & Lakes
description: Immerse yourself in imperial history with our 'Rajasthan Regal Retreat | Trails of Forts & Lakes' package, completely structured across 4 Nights and 5 Days. Base your stay entirely inside a comfortable Udaipur property for four nights with hot daily hotel breakfasts included. Discover the romantic lake city layout on a private half-day tour featuring the Under the Sun Aquarium and the grand City Palace Complex. This curated private loop also packs in extensive day-trip excursions to explore the massive walls of Kumbhalgarh Fort, Badal Mahal, and the legendary fortress of Chittorgarh.
shortDescription: A majestic 4N/5D lake city circuit combining private palace tours in Udaipur with massive historical fort excursions.
highlights: Witness spectacular panoramic lakeside views from the massive structures inside the Udaipur City Palace Complex.
Explore exotic colorful marine life exhibits inside the massive Under the Sun Aquarium in Udaipur.
Walk along the historic 36-kilometer-long massive outer wall fortifications enclosing Kumbhalgarh Fort.
Ascend to the high cloud-touched corridors of the beautiful Badal Mahal palace inside Kumbhalgarh.
Discover the monumental Vijay Stambha tower and sprawling historic palace ruins inside Chittorgarh Fort.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Udaipur | Udaipur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to Udaipur! Upon arriving at Udaipur, you'll be transferred to the hotel for check-in. After you relax for some time, board the transfer for the sightseeing tour of the city. During this day trip, enjoy a walk through the Sahelio-ki-Bari and take-in the beauty of the Fateh Sagar Lake, which looks scenic in the monsoon season. Also, explore Under the Sun Aquarium, home to various exotic marine species. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Mewari Villa Udaipur / The Park Classic Hotel, Udaipur / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to City Palace | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Prepare yourself for an amazing experience and get transferred to the stunning City Palace, set on the scenic banks of Lake Pichola. Explore the Crystal Gallery within the palace and marvel at its stunning collection of crystal artifacts. Later, get transferred back to the hotel. Afterward, you can make time to see some other attractions in the city at your own pace, like Jagdish Temple and Bagore ki Haveli, among other famous spots. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Mewari Villa Udaipur / The Park Classic Hotel, Udaipur / Similar

itinerary.title: Excursion to Kumbhalgarh
itinerary.description: Enjoy a wonderful day trip from Udaipur as you get transferred from the hotel to Kumbhalgarh. Upon arriving, explore the ancient temples and the grand Badal Mahal palace. While you are there, also admire the stunning views from Kumbhalgarh Fort's expansive walls, second-longest continuous wall in the world. After an amazing day of exploration, board the transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Mewari Villa Udaipur / The Park Classic Hotel, Udaipur / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Chittorgarh
itinerary.description: Get ready to explore the historical Chittorgarh Fort on an amazing excursion. Board the transfer from the hotel to Chittorgarh. Upon arriving, pass through seven grand gates along a scenic road to reach the fort. Afterwards, climb upstairs to see the Vijay Stambh, adorned with Arabic engravings and admire the grandeur of the beautiful Padmini Palace. After a memorable day, you'll get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Mewari Villa Udaipur / The Park Classic Hotel, Udaipur / Similar

name: Luxury Rajasthan - Winter Flash Sale - Free Hotel Upgrade
description: Book our limited 'Luxury Rajasthan - Winter Flash Sale - Free Hotel Upgrade' holiday circuit, tightly structured across 5 Nights and 6 Days. Split your comfortable stays between Hotel Sajjan Niwas in Jaipur for two nights, Jodhpur for one night, and Jaisalmer for two nights, inclusive of daily breakfasts and a free hotel upgrade. Explore historic landmarks on private Jaipur city tours covering City Palace and Hawa Mahal. This curated winter loop also features comprehensive shared sightseeing across Jodhpur's Mehrangarh Fort, the Jaisalmer War Memorial, traditional Havelis, and desert sand dunes.
shortDescription: A premium 5N/6D winter flash deal featuring private Jaipur city tracks, Jodhpur fort tours, and a free hotel upgrade layout.
highlights: Enjoy an exclusive seasonal promotion featuring a complimentary comfort-tier hotel room upgrade.
Explore the intricate pink sandstone windows and unique structural architecture of the iconic Hawa Mahal.
Stand atop the towering vertical cliff walls of Mehrangarh Fort overlooking the historic blue city of Jodhpur.
Capture beautiful photographs of the floating marble facades of Jal Mahal reflecting on the calm lake waters.
Discover the monumental brick aviation exhibits displayed inside the historic Jaisalmer War Memorial.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur | Half Day Jaipur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to Jaipur, the vibrant Pink City. After arriving, you will get transferred to your hotel for check-in. Later, you can spend your afternoon exploring the royal City Palace and its museum, reflecting Jaipur’s rich heritage. Continue with a stop at the iconic Hawa Mahal, followed by a visit to the historic Albert Hall Museum. End your day with a peaceful visit to the beautiful Birla Mandir, where the calm surroundings offer a relaxing close, and later you will get driven back to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Sajjan Niwas / similar

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a visit to the majestic Amer Fort, famous for its grand courtyards and stunning hilltop views. Explore the beautiful Sheesh Mahal, known for its intricate mirror work. Continue to Jaigarh Fort to see the iconic Jaivana Cannon, followed by Nahargarh Fort for panoramic views of the Aravalli hills. Stop at Jal Mahal for photos and then you may visit serene Govind Dev Ji Temple for a peaceful evening. Later, get driven back to your hotel to relax.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Sajjan Niwas / similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jodhpur | Jodhpur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: After check-out, get driven to Jodhpur, the Blue City famed for its azure-painted houses and regal charm. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and relax. Later, explore the city on a sightseeing tour and explore the Mehrangarh Fort, towering above the city with stunning views of Jodhpur’s blue lanes. Next, visit Jaswant Thada, a marble cenotaph known for its delicate carvings & admire the Umaid Bhawan Palace, one of the world’s largest residences. Later, explore the bustling Ghanta Ghar market.
itinerary.accommodation: The Kothi Heritage / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jaislamer | Jaisalmer Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Post check-out, embark on a scenic drive across Rajasthan’s desert landscapes to Jaisalmer, the Golden City renowned for its timeless charm. Upon arrival, visit to the Jaisalmer War Memorial, honoring the bravery and sacrifice of Indian soldiers through inspiring exhibits. Continue to the iconic Jaisalmer Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site & one of the world’s few living forts, where golden sandstone walls enclose vibrant bazaars, temples, & homes. Later, get driven to the hotel for check-in.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Antra Inn / Similar

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Sightseeing Tour | Desert Camping & Adventure Activities
itinerary.description: Check out and embark on a half-day exploration of Jaisalmer’s golden heritage. Begin at Gadisar Lake, a reservoir adorned with shrines and ghats, once the city’s lifeline. Continue to admire the Patwon Ki Haveli, Salim Singh Ki Haveli, and Nathmal Ki Haveli, masterpieces of sandstone architecture that showcase Jaisalmer’s rich legacy. Later, get drievn to to your desert camp & check-in. Afterwards, head out for camel ride & indulge in cultural performances, creating unforgettable desert evening.
itinerary.accommodation: K.K. Resort & Camp, Jaisalmer / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Check out and bid farewell to Jaisalmer, the Golden City, as you drive back through Rajasthan’s vast desert landscapes, dotted with villages and glimpses of rural life in vibrant colors. On reaching Jodhpur, get dropped at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. Depart with cherished memories of Rajasthan—the royal grandeur of Jaipur’s palaces, the blue-hued beauty of Jodhpur, and the desert magic of Jaisalmer—blending into a journey rich in culture, history, and timeless charm.

Enjoy a peaceful evening boat ride or scenic stroll along the banks of the beautiful Nakki Lake.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Udaipur | Half Day Udaipur Tour

itinerary.title: Full Day Udaipur Highlights Tour

Continue to the Vintage Car Museum to admire the heritage automobile collection of the Mewar kings. itinerary.title: Transfer to Mount Abu | Mount Abu Sightseeing Tour

name: Golden Triangle Journey | Discover Delhi, Agra & Jaipur
description: Explore India's most famous cultural route with our 'Golden Triangle Journey | Discover Delhi, Agra & Jaipur' package, seamlessly mapped across 4 Nights and 5 Days. Split your comfortable stays between Delhi for one night, Agra for one night, and Jaipur for two nights, inclusive of hot daily breakfasts. Discover monumental history on curated half-day city tracks across old and new Delhi avenues, the heritage structures of Agra, and the vibrant fortifications of Jaipur. This foundational route also highlights a traditional cultural evening excursion to the famous Chokhi Dhani ethnic village.
shortDescription: A classic 4N/5D cultural circuit connecting the historical monuments of Delhi, the iconic Taj Mahal in Agra, and the pink forts of Jaipur.
highlights: Drive past iconic imperial monuments including India Gate and the historic Red Fort walls in Delhi.
Witness the spectacular white marble architecture of the world-famous Taj Mahal along the Yamuna River.
Explore the intricate pink sandstone windows and unique structural architecture of the iconic Hawa Mahal.
Ascend the massive hilltop ramparts of Amer Fort to witness spectacular panoramic views of the valley.
Experience authentic Rajasthani hospitality, folk dances, and cultural activities inside Chokhi Dhani village.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi | Delhi Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Delhi, check in to your hotel. Later, start exploring the city & visit Qutub Minar, the world’s tallest brick minaret & a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Next, see the iconic Rashtrapati Bhavan & explore the National War Memorial, dedicated to the Indian Armed Forces. Afterward, stroll down Rajpath, the site of the Republic Day parade, and and conclude your day at India Gate, inscribed with the names of 13,000 soldiers who gave their lives in World War I.
activities: Half-Day Delhi Sightseeing Tour Ticket Not Included
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Opera, New Delhi / Hotel Dream Palace, Delhi / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Agra | Agra Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Today, check out and travel to Agra. Once you reach, check in to your hotel. Later, start exploring the city with a visit to the iconic Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Next, explore Agra Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site where you'll discover the Diwan-i-Am, Khas Mahal and Shish Mahal, all reflecting Mughal grandeur. Also, visit the Akbar's Tomb, the final resting place of the great Mughal emperor. Later, wander through Kinari Bazaar before being driven back to the hotel.
activities: Agra Sightseeing Tour Ticket Not Included
Marble Artefacts Shopping near Taj Mahal
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Amar Yatri Niwas, Agra / Hotel Chanakya, Agra / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jaipur | Half Day Jaipur Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Check out and travel to Jaipur. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel. Later, discover the City Palace and its Mubarak Mahal, now a museum showcasing royal costumes and artifacts. Admire Jantar Mantar, one of the oldest astronomical observatories featuring the world’s largest stone sundial, and make a photo stop at Hawa Mahal, the 'Palace of Winds.' Then, seek blessings at Govind Dev Ji Temple and explore local markets, where you can shop for Jaipur's famous Bandhej sarees and juttis.
activities: Half-Day Jaipur Sightseeing Tour Ticket Not Included
itinerary.accommodation: Comfort Inn Sapphire / Shahpura Residency / Similar

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts Tour with Jal Mahal & Birla Mandir
itinerary.description: Today, visit the Nahargarh Fort, offering stunning city views. Next, visit Jaigarh Fort, home to the world’s largest cannon on wheels. Explore the grand Amber Fort, known for its King’s quarters & the beautiful Sheesh Mahal. Stop by the Instagram-famous Panna Meena Ka Kund. Conclude the tour at Birla Mandir before being driven back to the hotel. In the evening, visit Choki Dhani, where you can savor a traditional Rajasthani dinner.

name: Best of Rajasthan | FREE Jaisalmer Camping Experience
description: Experience the ultimate heritage journey with our 'Best of Rajasthan | FREE Jaisalmer Camping Experience' holiday package, beautifully mapped across 8 Nights and 9 Days. Split your comfortable stays between Jaipur (2N), Bikaner (1N), Jaisalmer (2N), Jodhpur (1N), and Mount Abu (2N), inclusive of daily hot breakfasts. Explore massive architectural marvels on private city circuits covering Jaipur's City Palace, Bikaner's Junagarh Fort, and Jodhpur's Umaid Bhawan Palace. highlights: Enjoy an exclusive seasonal promotion featuring a complimentary desert night stay inside traditional luxury tents.

name: Singapore & Malaysia | City Lights to Beach Bliss
description: Experience the ultimate Southeast Asian luxury with our 'Singapore & Malaysia | City Lights to Beach Bliss' holiday circuit, completely mapped across 6 Nights and 7 Days. Split your luxury stays between a Super Deluxe Singapore property for three nights and a Super Deluxe Langkawi beach property for three nights, inclusive of daily breakfasts. Discover world-class wonders on curated city tracks featuring Universal Studios Singapore, Night Safari tram rides, and Madame Tussauds. This high-end dual-country loop also packs in scenic cable car passes, the spectacular Wings of Time light show, and a dedicated tropical island tour of Langkawi.
shortDescription: An elite 6N/7D multi-country escape pairing futuristic Singapore city attractions with the tranquil tropical beaches of Langkawi.
highlights: Journey into the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park on an open-air night safari tram expedition.
Immerse yourself in Hollywood movie magic, high-speed rollercoasters, and themed zones at Universal Studios.
Glide across skyscrapers and harbor channels on the scenic round-trip Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass.
Witness a breathtaking multi-sensory laser, water, and fire structural display during the Wings of Time show.
Relax along the pristine turquoise coastlines and duty-free shopping avenues of tropical Langkawi island.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Singapore | Enjoy Night Safari in the Evening
itinerary.description: Welcome to the ‘Land of Lion’ - Singapore! Upon arrival at the airport, get transferred to your hotel. As you reach, check-in, and rest for a while before going to the night safari zoo. Walk through 7 distinct geographical zones, immersing yourself in the sights and sounds of over 2,500 nocturnal animals from around the world. Enjoy a tram ride through the jungle and a captivating night show at the park before being transferred back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Boss / Hotel Mi Bencoolen, Singapore / Similar

itinerary.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour | Day Trip to Sentosa Island
itinerary.description: Get ready to enjoy the attractions of Singapore with a half-day tour. Discover famous landmarks such as Suntec City, the Merlion Statue, Helix Bridge and more. Later, get transferred to Sentosa Island by taking a cable car ride. Visit Madame Tussauds Wax Museum, which houses life-size wax statues of famous personalities from around the world. Further, enjoy the stunning night show set in the open sea, Wings of Time. After a fun-filled day, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Boss / Hotel Mi Bencoolen, Singapore / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Tour of Universal Studios Singapore
itinerary.description: In the morning, prepare to embark on a day tour of the renowned Universal Studios Singapore. Immerse yourself in this cinematic wonderland, which brings blockbuster movies to life. Enjoy adrenaline-pumping adventures with cutting-edge rides and attractions. Watch the Hollywood Dreams Light Up Parade and indulge in various activities before being transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Boss / Hotel Mi Bencoolen, Singapore / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Langkawi
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel and get transferred to Singapore Airport for your flight to Langkawi (flight tickets not included). Upon arrival, get transferred to the hotel. Check in and take this day at your own pace. You can visit attractions such as Galeria Perdana, a museum showcasing rare artifacts, Taman Lagenda Langkawi, a themed park dedicated to the folklore and myths of Langkawi, or the tranquil beach of Pulau Beras Basah. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bayview Hotel Langkawi / Dayang Bay Resort Langkawi / Similar

itinerary.title: Half-Day Langkawi Island Tour
itinerary.description: Get ready to embark on a half-day island tour of Langkawi. Start by visiting Atma Alam to learn about the traditional batik printing process. Next, take a scenic cable car ride to the Mount Mat Cincang Cable Car and enjoy panoramic views of Langkawi. Continue your journey to Kuah Town, where you can experience the local culture and savor traditional Malaysian cuisine. Conclude your tour with a visit to Eagle Square before transferring back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Bayview Hotel Langkawi / Dayang Bay Resort Langkawi / Similar

itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Langkawi
itinerary.description: This day is for you to explore Langkawi at your own pace. You can head out to discover the natural beauty and unique attractions of the island. Try visiting Durian Perangin Waterfall and take a refreshing dip, or head to Black Sand Beach, known for its unique dark-colored sand. Take a leisurely walk along the shore, soaking in the scenic views. For a cultural experience, consider visiting the Langkawi Craft Complex, where you can see traditional Malaysian crafts. Later, head back to the hotel.

name: Malaysia with Cameron Highlands | Coastal Adventures & Cultural Gems
description: Explore the full diverse landscape of the peninsula with our grand 'Malaysia with Cameron Highlands' package, mapped across 9 Nights and 10 Days. Split your deluxe accommodations between Kuala Lumpur for two nights, Cameron Highlands for two nights, Penang for two nights, and Langkawi for three nights, inclusive of daily breakfasts. Discover world-class cities, misty hills, and tropical shores with confirmed Petronas Twin Towers entry tickets, a guided Cameron hill trek, the historic Kek Lok Si Temple circuit, and an exhilarating Langkawi speedboat island-hopping tour.
shortDescription: A grand 9N/10D peninsular grand circuit merging Kuala Lumpur city wonders, chilly highland tea trails, and Langkawi speedboat safaris.
highlights: Stand on the high-altitude observation glass deck inside the world-famous Petronas Twin Towers.
Stroll through misty high-altitude trails, vibrant strawberry farms, and sprawling tea estates in Cameron Highlands.
Ride the historic funicular railway line up Penang Hill to catch stunning panoramic ocean views.
Explore the majestic multi-tiered shrines and towering statues inside the historic Kek Lok Si Temple.
Speed across turquoise Andaman waves to relax along the pristine white shores of legendary Langkawi islets.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur– The Klang Valley
itinerary.description: Welcome to the capital of Malaysia! Upon arrival at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, get transferred to your hotel for check-in. Spend your day at leisure by exploring city’s history and culture. You can visit Merdeka Square and experience Kampung Baru's houses. Also, you can discover the ancient Sze Ya Temple and explore the streets of Central and Petaling market. Later, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Arenaa Star Hotel, Kuala Lumpur / Hilton Garden Inn Kuala Lumpur - North / Similar

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour | Petronas Tower Tickets
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to KL Tower for stunning views of Kuala Lumpur's skyline. Next, visit Istana Negara, Malaysia's National Palace. Pay homage at Tugu Negara, honoring fallen heroes at the National Monument. Marvel at the Moorish architecture of Sultan Abdul Samad Building and sample local delights at Cocoa Boutique. Find serenity at the National Mosque and conclude with the breathtaking views from Petronas Twin Towers' observation deck before getting transferred to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Arenaa Star Hotel, Kuala Lumpur / Hilton Garden Inn Kuala Lumpur - North / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cameron Highlands | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Post-check out, get driven on a scenic drive to the picturesque countryside, Cameron Highlands. Check-in at your hotel, rest for a while and spend the day at leisure. You can take a stroll through the lush tea plantations and learn about the culture with visits to local attractions like the Lavender Garden and Sam Poh Temple. Next, you can indulge in a delightful afternoon tea session at one of the charming colonial-style tea houses and later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Copthorne Hotel Cameron Highlands / Similar

itinerary.title: Cameron Highlands Day Tour
itinerary.description: Discover the beauty and charm of the Cameron Highlands with a day tour. Begin your journey with a visit to the renowned Boh Tea Plantations, where you can explore the lush tea fields and beautiful landscapes. Next, stop at the Butterfly Garden, where you can marvel at more than 5000 butterflies. Explore the scenic beauty of the Lata Iskandar Waterfall Tapah and finally, indulge in honey-tasting sessions at the Bee Farm. Later, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Copthorne Hotel Cameron Highlands / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Penang | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Post check-out, start your journey to Penang- ‘Pearl of the Orient’. Upon arrival, check-in and spend the day at your own pace. You can stroll along the historic streets of George Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and indulge in a traditional Penang lunch. Next, you can soak yourself in the island's rich heritage with visits to iconic landmarks such as the Khoo Kongsi clan house or simply relax on the shores of Batu Ferringhi Beach. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Garden Inn Hotel / Tune Hotel George Town / Similar

itinerary.title: Day trip to Penang Hill and Kek Lok Si Temple
itinerary.description: Begin your journey by getting driven to the Penang Hill Funicular Railway, ascending to the summit for breath-taking panoramic views of the island and beyond. Explore the lush landscapes and you can visit attractions like the historic David Brown's Restaurant and Tea Terraces. Next, make your way to Kek Lok Si Temple, Southeast Asia's largest Buddhist temple, featuring the Seven-Tier Pagoda and the majestic Kuan Yin statue. Soak up the spiritual ambiance, and get transferred to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Garden Inn Hotel / Tune Hotel George Town / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Langkawi
itinerary.description: Check-out from your hotel and head to Langkawi, the Jewel of Kedah. Upon arrival, check-in and spend your day at leisure. You can discover Langkawi's unique mangrove ecosystem on a guided boat tour through Kilim Karst Geoforest Park and Tanjung Rhu. Encounter a variety of different animals at Langkawi Wildlife Park and a visit to Bird Paradise, home to over 2500 birds. You can also buy unique handicrafts and souvenirs before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Recommended Enrich your day with experiences Fill up your day with some of the highly recommended experiences.
itinerary.accommodation: Bella Vista Waterfront Langkawi / De Baron Resort Langkawi / Similar

itinerary.title: Langkawi Island Hopping Speedboat Tour
itinerary.description: Prepare for an exciting Langkawi island hopping speedboat tour to discover some of the region's most popular islands, including Dayang Bunting, Singa Besar, and Beras Basah. Experience the thrill of eagle watching from the boat at Big Lions Island, where you can witness these majestic birds in their natural habitat. Also, explore Pulau Dayang Bunting, home to the famous Lake of the Pregnant Maiden, and enjoy yourself in the serene beauty of this natural wonder. Later, return to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Bella Vista Waterfront Langkawi / De Baron Resort Langkawi / Similar

itinerary.title: Leisure day at Langkawi
itinerary.description: Today, rest and spend the day at leisure. You can take a ride on the Langkawi Cable Car, one of the steepest cable car rides in the world and explore the underwater wonders of the Andaman Sea at Underwater World. Next, you can admire the iconic Eagle Square, symbolizing Langkawi's name and indulge yourself in island's agricultural heritage at Laman Padi Rice Garden. Visit Galeria Perdana Museum and experience the lively atmosphere of Langkawi's night markets, before returning to your hotel.
activities: Recommended Enrich your day with experiences Fill up your day with some of the highly recommended experiences.
itinerary.accommodation: Bella Vista Waterfront Langkawi / De Baron Resort Langkawi / Similar

itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Malaysia and check-out from the hotel. Now, get transferred to the airport, with your bag full of memories.
