name: Your Ultimate Bhutan Kingdom Cultural & Himalayan Expedition
description: Immerse yourself in the magical land of thunder dragons with our premium Bhutan Kingdom Cultural and Himalayan Expedition mapped across 7 Nights and 8 Days. This comprehensive mountain journey begins with a smooth pickup from Bagdogra Airport or NJP station, transferring you safely to the border town of Phuentsholing before ascending into the pristine valleys of Thimphu, Punakha, and Paro. Stay comfortably for seven nights on a double or triple sharing basis in handpicked 3-to-4-star standard hotels, featuring a convenient MAP meal plan with daily hot breakfasts and heavy dinners included. Travel hassle-free as this package completely covers the vital Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) and all local municipal entry permits. You will be accompanied by a professional licensed Bhutanese tour guide while exploring iconic fortresses, ancient monasteries, and beautiful suspension bridges. From the bustling streets of the capital city Thimphu to the breathtaking final hike up to the legendary Tiger's Nest Monastery in Paro, every single transit is managed in clean, hygienic private group vehicles like a Toyota Coaster or Tempo Traveller.
shortDescription: An extensive 7N/8D Himalayan mountain loop covering Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, and Paro with SDF charges and expert guides included.
highlights: Hike up the breathtaking mountain trail to visit the iconic Tiger's Nest Monastery in Paro.
Explore the giant Buddha Dordenma statue and the historic Tashichho Dzong fortress in Thimphu.
Walk across one of Bhutan's longest traditional suspension bridges hanging over the Po Chhu river.
Drive through the scenic Dochula Pass to witness panoramic views of the snow-capped Himalayas.
Cross the India-Bhutan border gate and experience the unique local lifestyle of Phuentsholing.

itinerary.title: Bagdogra Airport/NJP Railway Station Pickup & Transfer to Phuentsholing
itinerary.description: Your grand Himalayan adventure officially springs into action as you land at the Bagdogra Airport [IXB] or arrive at the NJP Railway Station, where our private representative warmly greets your group of 20 adults and escorts everyone to your spacious Private Tempo Traveler . Embark immediately on your scenic drive from Bagdogra/NJP to Phuentsholing and watch the flat plains transition into rolling green hills as your driver winds along the highway towards the Indo-Bhutan border. Upon arriving in this offbeat little border town of Phuentsholing/Jaigaon, proceed directly to your cozy deluxe hotel, complete your smooth check-in formalities, and unwind in your double room. Spend your afternoon relaxing or step out to haggle in the long lines for a tourist permit to secure your official documentation for the upcoming mountain transit. Conclude your first day on the border by enjoying a freshly prepared, warm evening at your leisure to absorb the local atmosphere before gathering for your first grand dinner at the hotel and settling in for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Gaki Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Phuentsholing/Jaigaon to Thimphu Transfer & Gateway to the Capital
itinerary.description: Fuel up your group with a wholesome morning breakfast at the hotel and pack up your travel belongings before completing your check-out to meet your private driver and your dedicated, licensed Travel Guide (Bhutan). Today is completely dedicated to a spectacular drive from Phuentsholing to Thimphu as you board your comfortable Private Toyota Hiace Bus, precisely arranged to provide a smooth ride during the steep mountain ascent. Travel along a stunning intercity highway ascending parallel to roaring river valleys, watching the emerald green slopes give way to the dramatic, stark snow-capped mountains, waterfalls, streams and the unspoiled greenery that frames this pristine route. En-route, take short stopovers to break in the trip and linger a while to stretch your legs, allowing everyone to admire the top view of Chukha Dam and capture panoramic group photos. Upon arrival in the capital and largest city of Bhutan, Thimphu, check into your designated premium 4-star property, enjoy a marvelous multi-cuisine spread for dinner at the hotel, and turn in for a peaceful overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Park / Similar

itinerary.title: Thimphu - Fullday Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Savor a nutritious morning breakfast at the hotel while listening to the birds chirping over the valley before boarding your Private Toyota Hiace Bus for a spectacular day of wilderness exploration. Today, your driver and guide will take your group on a scenic day drive of Thimphu Sightseeing,, Meander through the colorful streets of the semi-developed markets Catch the glimpse of National Flag hoisting Take in the view of the enormous Thimphu Dzong Explore the Changlimithang Monasteries, Semtokha Dzong and Tashichho Dzong Take a stroll through the Takin Zoo and meet smiling Takins, the national animal of Bhutan Go for an art expedition here: National Library, Thimphu National Museum, School of Arts & Crafts, Handicrafts & Textile Museum, and Handmade Paper Factory Trail up to the Bhutan Broadcasting Service (BBS) Tower and watch the whole town settling in Overnight stay at Thimphu, enjoy a marvelous multi-cuisine spread for dinner at the hotel, and turn in for a peaceful overnight stay.
activities: Art Tour: National Library, National Museum, School of Arts & Crafts, Handicrafts & Textile Museum, aur Handmade Paper Factory.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Park / Similar

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Punakha Transfer via Dochula Pass & Local Excursion
itinerary.description: Indulge in a hot morning breakfast at the hotel before completing your check-out formalities to head towards the subtropical valleys of the interior. Board your Private Toyota Hiace Bus with your guide and begin your drive from Thimphu to Punakha, tracing winding mountain roads for approximately three hours as you descend towards the former capital of Bhutan. Stop along the way at an altitude of 10,171 feet to admire the beautiful 108 chortens built on a high mountain pass, Dochu la pass, taking in the breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks. Continue your journey to pay a visit to an unusual temple, Chimi Lhakhang also known as the fertility temple, walking through beautiful village rice paddies to explore its unique history. Afterward, drive down to sit by the river confluence and immerse into the beauty of this huge white castle, the Punakha Dzong, marveling at its spectacular wooden architecture and lakeside settings. End the excursion with an hour-long trek to Druk Wangyal Lhakhang, a walk on the hanging bridge and a visit to the Wangdue Phodrang before checking into your hotel for a delicious dinner at the hotel and an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Punakha Residency / Similar

itinerary.title: Punakha to Paro Transfer via Simtokha Dzong, Phobjikha & Historic Fortresses
itinerary.description: Enjoy a piping hot breakfast at the hotel before completing your front desk check-out formalities and loading your bags into your Private Toyota Hiace Bus to travel toward the historic valley of Paro.Today, your driver and guide will take your group on a scenic day drive from Punakha to Phobjikha, traversing pristine pine forests to reach one of the most beautiful glacial valleys in the entire kingdom. After arrival at Phobjikha, proceed directly to visit Gangtey Monastery, an ancient and imposing seat of the Nyingma school of Buddhism that overlooks the sweeping marshlands below.After that  Embark on your scenic intercity drive from  Paro, making a special stopover en route to visit Simtokha Dzong, an incredible fortress built in 1627 that stands as the oldest in Bhutan and now houses the institute for language and culture studies. Arrive in Paro by afternoon and proceed immediately with your private vehicle to visit Ta Dzong, once a watchtower, built to defend Rinpung Dzong during inter-valley wars of the 17th century, which was beautifully inaugurated as Bhutan’s national museum in 1968. Afterwards, walk down a hillside trail to visit Rinpung Dzong, built in 1646 by Shabdrung Ngawang Namgyal, the first spiritual ruler of Bhutan, which houses the district administrative offices and monastic body. Conclude your excursion by approaching the dzong through a traditional covered bridge called Nemi Zam before checking into your premium 4-star resort for a grand dinner at the hotel and overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Gakyidiana / Similar

itinerary.title: Paro Local Excursion | Thrilling Trek to Tiger’s Nest & Half-Day Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Arise fresh amidst unpolluted expanses and gorge on a delicious morning breakfast at the hotel to prepare your group for an incredible, adrenaline-packed day. Board your Private Toyota Hiace Bus and hit the road early to experience a thrilling trek to Tiger’s Nest, also widely known as Paro Taktsang, the legendary monastery perched on a sheer cliff offering spectacular scenery of blue pine and rhododendrons forest. Beginners and experienced trekkers alike will ascend the mountain pass with your dedicated guide, who will share stories of how Guru Rinpoche flew here on a tigress' back to meditate for three months. After completing your down-mountain hike and relaxing your weary self, transition directly into a beautiful Paro half-day sightseeing as time permits to maximize your day in the valley. Drive into the main hub to explore local historical structures, visit the ancient Kichu Lhakhang Monastery, or browse the traditional handicraft markets for souvenirs depending on your group's remaining daylight hours. Return to your premium 4-star hotel to un-wind completely, gather at the restaurant for a grand hot dinner at the hotel, and settle into your rooms for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Gakyidiana / Similar

itinerary.title: Paro to Phuentsholing via Chele La Pass Scenic Excursion & Transfer
itinerary.description: Wake up early to catch a beautiful sunrise over the valley and enjoy a wholesome morning breakfast at the hotel before completing your check-out formalities. Board your Private Toyota Hiace Bus with your luggage secure and set off with your guide on a majestic mountain detour to scale the breathtaking Chele La Pass, the highest motorable point in Bhutan running between the Paro and Haa valleys. Arrive at the freezing, windy summit to catch sight of the Tiger's Nest Monastery from between the clouds in the far distance and snap spectacular photographs against thousands of colorful, fluttering prayer flags. Take a moment to stretch your legs, sip on hot tea, and marvel at the staggering road views of monasteries and far-off snow peaks before beginning your long winding descent back down the highway. Board your vehicle for your final intercity transfer as you drive smoothly from Paro to Phuentsholing, watching the tall pine trees change back into lush sub-tropical forests as you reach the border hub. Check into your deluxe 3-star border hotel for a farewell dinner at the hotel and a relaxing final overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Gaki Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Phuentsholing/Jaigaon to Bagdogra Airport/NJP Railway Station Drop
itinerary.description: Indulge in your final included morning breakfast at the hotel, savoring a warm cup of coffee while sharing stories from your Himalayan adventure with your companions. Pack up your travel belongings, secure your mountain souvenirs, and complete your smooth hotel check-out formalities at the front desk with our private representative's assistance. Meet your driver in the lobby and board your spacious Private Tempo Traveler to begin your final road transit leaving the border town behind. Get chauffeured smoothly from Phuentsholing/Jaigaon to Bagdogra Airport [IXB] or NJP Railway Station, watching the green mountain slopes transition back into the wide open plains of the region. Your driver brings your group of 20 adults safely to the departure terminal gates, allowing everyone to board their onward flights or trains to return with unforgettable memories as our premium private services officially conclude here.

description: Book this perfectly synchronized 4 Nights and 5 Days Thailand romantic getaway designed to give couples a seamless experience across the shores of Pattaya and the skyline of Bangkok with deluxe hotel stays and daily breakfasts. Your getaway starts with a 2-night stay in coastal Pattaya, where you will enjoy a dazzling evening at the famous Alcazar Cabaret Show with standard seating and exclusive private transfers, followed by a sun-soaked trip to Coral Island by speedboat with a local lunch included. Next, you will transition to Bangkok for another 2 nights of comfortable stay to experience the best entertainment the capital city offers. Here, you will spend a thrilling day exploring Safari World and Marine Park with entry tickets, a shared transfer, and an included lunch, capped off with a romantic evening sailing on the iconic Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise. Complete with standard daily breakfasts and dedicated itinerary inclusions, this strict land-only package offers an incredibly well-paced international holiday for couples and honeymooners.

name: Thailand Islands & City Highlights | A Perfect All-in-One Couple Trip
description: Book this spectacular 8 Nights and 9 Days comprehensive Thailand itinerary delivering a complete tropical experience across Phuket, Krabi, Pattaya, and Bangkok with deluxe hotel stays and daily breakfasts. Your journey begins in Phuket with a 2-night stay featuring a thrilling Phi Phi Island speedboat excursion with lunch, followed by a private intercity road transit to Krabi that includes an enroute Phuket City Tour. After 2 nights in Krabi exploring the natural Emerald Pool and Hot Springs on a jungle tour, you will take an internal transit to coastal Pattaya for another 2 nights of comfortable stay. In Pattaya, you will enjoy the premium Alcazar Cabaret Show with standard seating and private transfers, alongside a shared speedboat trip to Coral Island with an included local lunch. Your grand vacation concludes with 2 nights in Bangkok, where you will experience a full-day tour of Safari World and Marine Park with lunch and an elegant evening on the Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise. Perfectly organized to touch every major highlight, this land-only package provides a completely seamless international tour for couples and families.
shortDescription: The ultimate 9-day grand Thailand journey spanning across Phuket, Krabi, Pattaya, and Bangkok featuring elite island tours, nature treks, and premium city cruises.
highlights: Speed across turquoise waters on a speedboat to explore the iconic shores of Phi Phi Island.
Trek through lush forest tracks to swim in Krabi's natural Emerald Pool and relaxing Hot Springs.
Watch the spectacular dance and colorful music of the Alcazar Cabaret Show with private transfers.
Sail through Bangkok's glowing night skyline during a luxury evening on the Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Phuket | Transfer & Free Time
itinerary.description: Welcome! Once you reach the airport, get driven to the hotel. Upon arriving, check in & relax for a while. Later, enjoy your free day in the city. You can visit Phuket Weekend Market, one of the most vibrant local experiences in Phuket. Open on weekends, this bustling market is a paradise for food lovers & bargain shoppers. You can also enjoy the Phuket FantaSea show, offering a full evening entertainment experience, among various other places.
itinerary.accommodation: Phuket Andakira Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Phuket | Phi Phi Island Tour by Speedboat
itinerary.description: Today, enjoy an exciting island-hopping experience as you set out to explore Phi Phi Islands. Get driven from the hotel to Rassada Pier to board the speedboat to cruise across the serene Andaman Sea. Upon reaching Phi Phi, you can explore scenic bays & pristine beaches full of marine life or enjoy your free time & swim in warm tropical waters. Also, relish a delicious lunch before continuing your exploration. After an amazing experience, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Phuket Andakira Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Phuket to Krabi | Phuket City Tour & Transfer
itinerary.description: Today, check out from the hotel & set out on Phuket city tour. Visit Phuket Big Buddha, perched on Nakkerd Hill, offering scenic views of Phuket’s coastline. Also, stop at Samet Nangshe Viewpoint in Phang-Nga, famed for its breathtaking views over Phang-Nga Bay. Don't miss exploring the vibrant lanes of Old Phuket Town, known for its colorful Sino-Portuguese buildings. After that, get driven to Krabi. Once you reach, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Krabi | Jungle Tour with Emerald Pool & Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Today, get ready for the Krabi Jungle Tour. Spend time at Emerald Pool, known for its clear turquoise waters, which offer a refreshing spot for a swim. Also, visit Krabi Hot Springs, where warm waters cascade over smooth rock formations, creating natural "bathtubs". Don't miss exploring Tiger Cave Temple, famous for its steep staircase climb leading to a hilltop viewpoint that rewards you with views of limestone cliffs & forests before getting transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Fly from Krabi to Bangkok | Transfer to Pattaya & Alcazar Show
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel & get driven to the airport to take the flight to Bangkok. Once you reach, get driven to the hotel in Pattaya. After check in, relax for some time. In the evening, enjoy Pattaya’s famous Alcazar Cabaret, which offers a glamorous evening of world-class performances. After you settle in, enjoy a spectacular show featuring vibrant costumes & choreographed dance routines inspired by cultures from around the world. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

On arrival, you enjoy the free time & relax on the soft white beaches, swim in crystal-clear waters, or opt for thrilling water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, or banana boat rides (at an additional cost). name: Thailand Full Moon Party Special | Phuket, Koh Samui & Krabi Trip
description: Experience the ultimate tropical nightlife and island-hopping adventure with this exclusive 7 Nights and 8 Days Thailand group holiday covering Phuket, Koh Samui, and Krabi with deluxe hotel stays and daily breakfasts. Your high-energy tour starts in Phuket with a 2-night stay, where you will cruise via shared speedboat to the stunning Phi Phi Islands for snorkeling with a local lunch and island entry fees fully included. Next, you will transition to the scenic island of Koh Samui for a 3-night stay to attend the world-famous Full Moon Party at Haad Rin Beach on Koh Phangan, featuring round-trip shared speed boat transfers and entry tickets. Your epic journey concludes with a 2-night stay in Krabi, where you will experience the legendary Krabi 4 Island tour by speedboat with lunch and island fees included. Complete with super deluxe airport pickups, hassle-free internal island coordination, and daily hotel breakfasts, this land-only package is perfectly tailored for friends and group travelers chasing beach parties and tropical shores.
shortDescription: An ultimate 8-day island-hopping party tour covering Phuket, Krabi, and the legendary Full Moon Party at Koh Phangan with entry fees and speedboats included.
highlights: Explore the crystal-clear waters of Phi Phi Island on a speedboat tour featuring snorkeling setups.
Dance all night at the legendary Full Moon Party on Haad Rin Beach in Koh Phangan with shared transits.
Discover the famous limestone cliffs and hidden lagoons during the scenic Krabi 4 Island speedboat tour.
Enjoy hassle-free travel with all mandatory national park and island conservation fees pre-paid in the plan.

itinerary.title: Phuket | Arrival & Free Time to Enjoy Nightlife
itinerary.description: Once you arrive at the airport, get driven to the hotel & check in. Later, meet your fellow travellers & have an orientation about your trip ahead. Later, you can spend your evening at Bangla Street. As the streets come alive, watch talented street performers & browse vibrant shops, all that makes Patong so popular around the world. You can also explore the open-air bars lining the street or step into one of the many clubs featuring live DJs & EDM beats.
itinerary.accommodation: Phuket Fishermen's Harbour / Phuket Andakira Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Phuket | Phi Phi Islands Hopping & Snorkelling
itinerary.description: Today, from the hotel, get driven to Rassada Pier & take the speedboat for the Phi Phi Islands tour. Explore Maya Bay, made famous by the movie- The Beach. Also, explore Pileh Lagoon, famed for its towering cliffs & Viking Cave, known for its ancient wall paintings. Don't miss Monkey Beach, known for being home to a number of monkeys, along with enjoying snorkelling at vibrant coral gardens. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Phuket Fishermen's Harbour / Phuket Andakira Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Phuket to Koh Samui | Ferry Journey & Free Time
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel & get driven to Donsak Pier. From there, take the ferry to Koh Samui. Once you reach, get driven to the hotel & check in. Later, get driven to Ark Bar Beach Club, one of the island’s most popular beachfront party venues, where you will get to see the fire show. Moreover, you can experience Koh Samui’s famous nightlife by marvelling at other beachside entertainment & relish refreshing drinks at shacks. Later, return on your own to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Chaba Cabana Beach Resort / Mai Samui Beach Resort & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Koh Samui | Full Moon Party at Haad Rin Beach in Koh Phangan
itinerary.description: Spend the morning the way you want, enjoying Samui's experiences & attractions. Then, spend the noon preparing with your group- dressing in party outfits & applying neon body paints to get ready for the Full Moon Party. Once ready, get driven to Koh Samui Pier to take the speedboat to Haad Rin Pier. Once there, walk to the beach to enjoy the party. Dance beneath the moonlit sky while diving into music zones, international DJs, dazzling fire shows & electric party atmosphere for the whole night.
activities: Moon Party at Ko Pha Ngan - Full-Moon Party at Haad Rin Beach with Shared Transfer Ticket Included
itinerary.accommodation: Chaba Cabana Beach Resort / Mai Samui Beach Resort & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Koh Samui | Free Day to Explore
itinerary.description: After a memorable night at the party, take it easy. Wake up & head to the pier to take the speedboat which is put on standby back to Koh Samui. Once there, get driven to the hotel. After relaxing for a while, you can spend time exploring the island. You can rent a scooter & discover the island's scenic roads or visit the famous Hin Ta & Hin Yai Rocks, known as Grandmother & Grandfather Rocks. You can also spend time at Fisherman's Village Walking Street & shop for amazing souvenirs.
itinerary.accommodation: Chaba Cabana Beach Resort / Mai Samui Beach Resort & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Koh Samui to Krabi | Ferry Journey & Free Time
itinerary.description: Once you check out from the hotel, get driven to Nathon Pier to take the ferry to Donsak Pier. Once there, get driven to the hotel in Krabi. After you check in, relax for some time. Later, you can explore the city on your own. You can head to Ao Nang Beach, where you can watch a stunning sunset over the Andaman Sea as the sky transforms into shades of orange & pink. Alternatively, you can explore Ao Nang Night Market & try authentic Thai street food or tropical desserts, amongst others.
itinerary.accommodation: Krabi Apple A Day Resort / Sugar Marina Hotel - Cliffhanger - Aonang / Similar

itinerary.title: Krabi | 4 Islands Tour & Snorkelling
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to Krabi Pier & take the speedboat for the 4 islands of Krabi. Visit Tup Island, famous for its unique sandbar that emerges during low tide & Chicken Island, named after its unique rock formation. While there, also enjoy snorkelling, enjoying the marine life of the island. Also, explore Poda Island, known for its powdery white sand beaches & swaying palm trees, along with Phra Nang Beach Cave, admired for its dramatic limestone cliffs. Later, get transferred back to the hotel.

name: Phuket & Krabi Delights | A Seaside Romantic Retreat
description: Whisk your partner away on an enchanting tropical escape with this 5 Nights and 6 Days Phuket and Krabi seaside romantic retreat offering super deluxe resort stays and daily fresh breakfasts. Your coastal journey begins with a smooth shared airport pickup from Phuket International Airport to your premium hotel for a 3-night stay, where you will experience a comprehensive Phuket City Tour and a thrilling shared speedboat excursion to the iconic Phi Phi Islands with a local buffet lunch included. On the fourth day, you will head to the majestic town of Krabi for a 2-night stay, starting with an immersive nature tour to the famous Emerald Pool and the historical Tiger Cave Temple. The absolute highlight of your Krabi stay is the legendary 7 Islands Sunset Tour by speedboat, where you will witness a magical sunset, enjoy a premium beachside BBQ dinner, and experience an unforgettable night swim among glowing bioluminescent plankton. Complete with end-to-end airport and resort transits, specialized island activities, and complete operations visa assistance, this precise land-only plan is the ultimate recipe for a romantic international vacation.

Your adventure kicks off in the capital city of Bangkok for a 2-night stay, featuring a full-day excursion to Safari World and Marine Park and a scenic evening on the Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise. Your magnificent holiday concludes with 2 nights in tropical Phuket, where you will explore major cultural sights during a Phuket City Tour and speed across the blue waters for a full-day Phi Phi Island tour by speedboat with an included buffet lunch. itinerary.title: Krabi Rainforest Discovery Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, board your transfer for an exciting Krabi rainforest discovery tour. Start by visiting the Thung Teao Forest Natural Park, where you can take a refreshing swim in the stunning Emerald Pool, renowned for its therapeutic properties. Next, visit the Tiger Cave Temple and witness the famous tiger paw prints in the cave. Also, explore the diverse flora and soak-in breathtaking views of the Andaman Sea coastline. After this amazing tour, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Cher ​mantra​ Aonang​ Resort & Pool​ Suite / Krabi Resort / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Phuket | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Today, after check-out, board your transfer to Phuket. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can relax at the scenic shores of Patong Beach, famous for water sports like parasailing and jet skiing. You can also explore the Banana Beach, known for its vibrant coral reefs and diverse marine life. You can also witness mind bending exhibits at the Phuket Trickeye Museum. After an amazing day, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: The Marina Phuket Hotel /Journeyhub Phuket Patong / Similar

itinerary.title: Phuket City Tour | Visit to Tiger Kingdom
itinerary.description: In the morning, board your transfer and enjoy a city tour of Phuket. Start by visiting the Wat Chalong, Phuket's largest Buddhist temple, and later, stroll through the Old Phuket Town. Also, visit the Karon View Point before getting transferred back to your hotel. Later, get driven to the Tiger Kingdom and get a chance to interact closely with tigers and learn about conservation efforts. Later, get driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: The Marina Phuket Hotel /Journeyhub Phuket Patong / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Phi Phi Island
itinerary.description: Today, board your transfer to Phuket Marina and upon reaching, hop on your speedboat to explore the Phi Phi Island. Visit the Maya Bay and Pileh Lagoon, where you can swim in calm emerald waters and admire the wall paintings of the Viking Caves. Also visit Monkey Beach and encounter playful monkeys. Later, visit Phi Phi Don Island, Bamboo Island, and Khai Nok Island, where you can indulge in thrilling water activities. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Maya Bay, Koh Phi Phi Ley
itinerary.accommodation: The Marina Phuket Hotel /Journeyhub Phuket Patong / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Today, check-out from your hotel and board your transfer. Upon reaching Phuket International Airport, board your flight back home. This marks the end of your amazing Thailand trip!

name: Best of Bangkok & Pattaya | Group Tour Package
description: Take your team or family on an incredible pocket-friendly international escape with this 4 Nights and 5 Days group tour package specially designed to explore Thailand's two most famous neighboring hubs. Your trip starts directly upon your arrival at Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport, from where you will be transferred straight to your deluxe hotel in Pattaya for a comfortable 3-night stay. The prime highlight of your beach stay is an action-packed excursion to the beautiful Coral Island (Koh Larn) on a shared speedboat, where you can swim in crystal-clear waters or enjoy beachside relaxation with your travel group. After 3 nights of coastal fun, you will journey back to the capital city of Bangkok for a 1-night stay at a super deluxe hotel to enjoy city sightseeing, majestic temple architecture, and famous local street shopping hubs. Complete with daily morning buffet breakfasts, pre-arranged group airport transits, and complete operations visa assistance, this land-only package is highly optimized for corporate groups, families, and budget-conscious backpackers looking for a seamless holiday.

Explore Pattaya’s famous street lanes, local markets, and lively beach promenades at your own pace.
Travel along the scenic highway track connecting the coastal beauty of Pattaya to the high-rises of Bangkok.

Spend the evening visiting some more iconic attractions in Pattaya like Pattaya Sheep Farm, Mimosa Pattaya, and Pattaya Floating Market. name: Backpacking Tour of Thailand | An Unforgettable Journey
description: Set out on an unforgettable international journey with this 5 Nights and 6 Days Thailand backpacking tour package, specifically optimized for solo travelers, friends, and budget-conscious groups. Your trip begins with a shared ground transfer from Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport directly to your deluxe hotel in Pattaya for a 3-night stay. In this vibrant coastal city, you will hop onto a shared speedboat for a thrilling full-day excursion to Coral Island to enjoy white-sand beaches and pristine blue waters. Next, your backpacking group will journey to the capital city of Bangkok for a 2-night stay at a standard hotel. Here, you will dive deep into Thailand's rich cultural heritage during a comprehensive shared Full Day Bangkok City Tour to see the iconic architectural landmarks and sacred Buddhist temples. Complete with standard daily breakfasts, return airport transits, and dedicated operations visa assistance, this land-only package offers a completely hassle-free, high-value international holiday template.
shortDescription: An ideal 6-day pocket-friendly backpacking tour covering 3 nights in coastal Pattaya with a Coral Island speedboat trip and 2 nights in Bangkok with a full-day city temple tour.
highlights: Cruise across the gulf waters on a shared speedboat to swim and relax on the shores of Coral Island.
Explore Pattaya’s famous walking streets, local night markets, and beach promenades at your own pace.
Discover Bangkok's rich spiritual heritage during a comprehensive full-day shared city temple tour.
Bargain for clothes and souvenirs at Bangkok's massive local street markets and shopping complexes.
Experience an incredibly fun international group journey backed by reliable local operations staff.

Also, you can visit Pattaya Night Bazaar, which is famous for its lively atmosphere, and the opportunity to experience local Thai culture and cuisine. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

Upon arrival, witness the pristine white sands and crystal-clear waters of Tawaen Beach. You can engage in thrilling watersports (at an extra cost) such as parasailing, and snorkelling, or simply relax and soak in the beauty of the surroundings. After an action-packed day, you'll be transferred back to your hotel in Pattaya for an overnight stay.

You can visit the beautiful Nong Nooch Garden, which features a host of ornamental gardens and vibrant flowers. Learn about the vibrant sea life as you visit the Underwater World in Pattaya. You can also enjoy a Muay Thai (Thai martial art) boxing match at one of the stadiums. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

name: Discover Bangkok and Pattaya | Thailand Vibrant Duo
description: Experience the ultimate snapshot of Thailand with this premium 4 Nights and 5 Days dual-city vacation package, carefully curated for travelers who want maximum entertainment and comfort. Your journey kicks off with a smooth ground transfer from Bangkok's airport directly to your deluxe hotel room in Pattaya for a 2-night stay. On your very first evening, you will be treated to standard seat tickets for the world-famous Alcazar Cabaret Show to witness a dazzling display of lights, music, and dance. The next day brings a thrilling speedboat trip across the Gulf of Thailand to explore the white sands and turquoise waters of Coral Island. From Pattaya, you will transition to the bustling capital city of Bangkok for a 2-night stay at a super deluxe hotel property. Your evenings in the capital are elevated by an elegant night out on the Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise, featuring an international buffet against an illuminated city skyline. You will also spend a full day exploring the massive Safari World and Marine Park with a single-day comprehensive access pass to watch wild animal safaris and spectacular live stunt shows. Complete with daily morning breakfasts, comfortable intra-city transfers, and operations visa assistance, this land-only package ensures a brilliant luxury holiday.
shortDescription: A premium 5-day escape capturing the best of Thailand, blending the high-energy beachfront entertainment of Pattaya with the spectacular landmarks and safaris of Bangkok.
highlights: Watch a spectacular, world-renowned dance and musical performance at the famous Alcazar Cabaret Show.
Cruise to Coral Island on a speedboat to relax on white sands or dive into optional turquoise water sports.
Sail past Bangkok's beautifully lit temples during a luxury evening on the Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise.
Drive through an open-world wild animal habitat and watch exotic dolphin stunts at the massive Safari World.
Discover the ultimate contrast between Pattaya's lively nightlife tracks and Bangkok's modern urban style.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok | Transfer to Pattaya | Alcazar Cabaret Show
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bangkok! Upon your arrival at Bangkok Airport, you'll be transferred to Pattaya. After you check in, take some time to relax. Later, in the evening, you'll be driven from the hotel for the Alcazar Show, a spectacular cabaret performance renowned for its vibrant sets and stunning displays. Enjoy traditional Thai dances and Broadway-style musical numbers and enjoy the ambience of the place. Later, you'll be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Golden Sea Pattaya / Centara Pattaya Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Coral Island
itinerary.description: In the morning, get ready and board the transfer from the hotel to Bali Hai Pier. Upon arrival, take the speedboat for the Coral Island tour. Once you reach the island, admire its pristine beaches and turquoise waters. For an added thrill, you can try water sports like jet skiing and snorkelling (at extra cost). While you are there, take a leisurely stroll along the white sands of Tawaen Beach and enjoy your time there. Later, you'll be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Golden Sea Pattaya / Centara Pattaya Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Bangkok | Chao Phraya Cruise Experience
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from the hotel and board your transfer to Bangkok. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and take some time to relax. In the evening, you'll be driven to Asiatique Pier No. 1 to embark on the Chao Phraya Cruise experience. Savour delightful Thai cuisine while enjoying live Thai music and dance performances as you admire the stunning nighttime views of the iconic landmarks of Bangkok. After the cruise, you'll be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bangkok Palace Hotel /Ambassador Hotel Bangkok / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Safari World
itinerary.description: Get ready for an exciting day at Safari Park and Marine Park. From your hotel, you'll be transferred to Safari World, where you can explore a wide variety of wildlife and marine life. Watch animals like giraffes, zebras, sharks, and seals in their natural habitats and learn about their conservation. Also, enjoy thrilling live performances, including the Hollywood Cowboy Stunt Show, Dolphin Show and Orangutan Show, among others. Later, you'll be driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

name: Wonders of Thailand | Culture, Corals and Coastlines
description: Immerse your family in the rich heritage and scenic coastal landscapes of Thailand with this elite 7 Nights and 8 Days grand tour package offering a beautiful blend of city culture and tropical islands. Your journey starts with a comfortable ground transfer from Suvarnabhumi Airport directly to your deluxe hotel in Pattaya for a 2-night stay, featuring an exciting speedboat excursion to Coral Island. Next, you will transition to the capital city of Bangkok for a 2-night stay at a premium hotel property, where your evenings are elevated by a luxury buffet on the Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise, alongside a full-day wildlife safari track at Safari World and Marine Park. Your magnificent vacation wraps up with a premium 3-night stay in tropical Phuket, where you will cruise to the world-famous Phi Phi Islands via speedboat with lunch included and experience a thrilling close-up Big Tiger Encounter at the Tiger Kingdom with exclusive private transfers. Complete with standard daily hotel breakfasts and dedicated ground logistics support, this land-only package delivers a dream international holiday.
shortDescription: A premium 8-day multi-destination holiday across Pattaya, Bangkok, and Phuket featuring a luxury river cruise, wildlife safari parks, and an exclusive big tiger encounter.
highlights: Cruise to Coral Island on a shared speedboat to relax on white sands or dive into optional coastal water sports.
Sail past Bangkok's beautifully lit monuments during a luxury evening on the Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise.
rive through open wild animal enclosures and watch exotic dolphin stunts at the massive Safari World Park.
Step inside a premium wildlife zone to click pictures with a majestic big tiger at Phuket Tiger Kingdom.
Speed across turquoise waters on a shared speedboat to explore the stunning shores of the Phi Phi Islands.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok | Transfer to Pattaya | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bangkok! Upon arrival at the airport, board your transfer and get driven to Pattaya. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend your day at leisure. You can explore the city on your own and visit the Sanctuary of Truth, which features intricate carvings depicting themes from Buddhism. Also, you can relax or stroll at Jomtien Beach, known for its sandy shoreline. Next, you can visit the Art in Paradise Museum, where art defies reality. Later, return to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Centara Pattaya Hotel / Golden Sea Pattaya / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Coral Island
itinerary.description: In the morning, get driven to Bali Hai Pier and hop on a speedboat for Coral Island Tour. Upon arrival, witness the idyllic white-sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. Also, you can indulge in thrilling activities like snorkeling among colorful marine life or jet-skiing and parasailing. You can enjoy a leisurely stroll at Tawaen Beach. Conclude your island adventure with a scenic speedboat ride back to Pattaya, and from the pier get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Centara Pattaya Hotel / Golden Sea Pattaya / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Bangkok | Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise
itinerary.description: Post check-out, get driven to the capital of Bangkok, Thailand. Upon arrival, check-into your hotel and relax. In the evening, get driven to Asiatique Pier and hop on your cruise on the Chao Phraya River. Then, glide past iconic landmarks like the Grand Palace and riverside markets. Next, treat your taste buds to a delicious Thai dinner onboard while enjoying Thai performances and live music. Afterwards, get transferred back to your hotel from Asiatique Pier.
itinerary.accommodation: Bangkok Palace Hotel / Ambassador Hotel Bangkok / Similiar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Safari World
itinerary.description: In the morning, get transferred to Safari World for an amazing day. Explore Thailand's largest open zoo, home to more than 400 species of animals. You can observe animals like lions, tigers, and elephants in their natural habitats at Safari World. Also, witness the dolphins and sea lions showcasing their impressive skills and variety of shows at the Marine Park. After an amazing day of encountering wildlife, get driven back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Bangkok Palace Hotel / Ambassador Hotel Bangkok / Similiar

itinerary.title: Flight to Phuket | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Today, after check-out, get transferred to Bangkok Airport and board your flight to Phuket. Upon arrival in Phuket, get driven to your hotel. Post check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can step into another world at Trickeye Museum and explore its variety of themed zones. Next, you can soak-in the vibrant atmosphere of Patong Beach. Later, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Journeyhub Phuket Patong /The Marina Phuket Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Phi Phi Island
itinerary.description: In the morning, get transferred to Phuket Marina and enjoy a journey to discover Phi Phi Island. Once you arrive, board a speedboat to the renowned Maya Bay. Next, visit the Pileh Lagoon for a refreshing swim in its tranquil emerald waters and explore the Viking Caves' wall paintings. Continue to Monkey Beach to interact with its playful monkeys. Also, visit Phi Phi Don Island, Bamboo Island, and Khai Nok Island before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Maya Bay, Koh Phi Phi Ley
itinerary.accommodation: Journeyhub Phuket Patong /The Marina Phuket Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Tiger Kingdom
itinerary.description: Today, board your transfer and get driven to the Tiger Kingdom, home to diverse types of tigers. Once there, encounter and get close to tigers, from playful cubs to majestic adults. Also, capture stunning photos with the tigers and learn deeply about them and their behavior before getting driven to your hotel. Later, you can head out and witness the traditional Chinese architecture of Tha Rua Shrine, or you can explore Phuket Aquarium & more. Afterwards, return to your hotel on your own.
itinerary.accommodation: Journeyhub Phuket Patong /The Marina Phuket Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, check-out from your hotel and get driven to Phuket Airport. Upon arrival, board your flight back home, marking the end of this amazing trip.

Your grand holiday begins with a comfortable private arrival transfer from Baku's Heydar Aliyev International Airport straight to the premium Atlas Hotel Baku for a 4-night stay. During your time in the capital, you will enjoy complete privacy with exclusive private ground transits for a comprehensive Baku City Sightseeing Tour and a detailed Baku Old City Tour to explore ancient stone towers. Your itinerary also includes a private day trip to the spectacular Gobustan National Park to stand right next to rare bubbling mud volcanoes. To make this deal irresistible, we have included a complimentary Absheron Peninsula Tour on a private basis to see the eternal fire monuments. Finally, you will transition to the mountains for a magnificent 1-night stay in Shahdag, highlighted by an adventurous private day trip to the famous Shahdag Mountain Ski Resort to witness alpine peak tracks. Complete with daily morning buffet breakfasts, return private airport transits, and included visa charges, this premium land-only itinerary is ready to go.
shortDescription: An elite 6-day private Azerbaijani exploration blending modern Baku, historical Old City, mud volcanoes, and a scenic night stay at Shahdag Mountain Resort.
highlights: Explore the historic, stone-paved paths and ancient stone palace architecture inside Baku's famous Old City.
Witness the striking contrast between Baku's modern glowing Flame Towers and the Caspian Sea boardwalk lines.
Stand next to rare bubbling natural mud volcanoes and see prehistoric rock carvings inside Gobustan Park.
Discover the eternal flames of the Ateshgah Fire Temple during your complimentary private Absheron tour.
Experience breathtaking cable car rides or thrilling winter snow activities at the Shahdag Mountain Ski Resort.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Baku | Baku City Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome to the City of Winds - Baku! Upon your arrival at the Baku airport, you will get transferred to your hotel. After checking in and resting, go on an exciting Baku City Sightseeing Tour. Begin by exploring the modern side of Baku, with visits to architectural marvels like the Flame Towers & Heydar Aliyev Center. Afterwards, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Atlas Hotel Baku / Similar

itinerary.title: Baku Old City Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, step back in time as you go on the old city tour of Baku. Explore the amazing streets of Baku's Old City, also known as Icherisheher. Admire the architectural wonders of the Palace of the Shirvanshahs, and ascend the ancient Maiden Tower for breathtaking views of the city skyline. Further, visit Juma Mosque and witness the intricate craftsmanship. Afterward, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Atlas Hotel Baku / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Shahdag | Day Trip to Shahdag Mountain Ski Resort
itinerary.description: In the morning, check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Shahdag. Upon reaching, check-in at your hotel and rest for a while before going for the Shahdag Ski Tour. Enjoy the scenic slopes and snowy landscapes as you glide down the mountains. After a thrilling day, transfer back and relax at the hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Day Trip to Shahdag Mountain Ski Resort
itinerary.accommodation: Zirve Hotel,Shahdag / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Baku | Gobustan National Park & Mud Volcanoes Tour
itinerary.description: Check-out from the hotel in Shahdag and get transferred to Baku. Upon reaching, check-in at your hotel, and rest for a while before going out for the Gobustan Museum & Mud Volcanoes Tour. Explore the fascinating Gobustan Museum, and dive into Azerbaijan's ancient history and culture. Further, visit the Mud Volcanoes for a unique natural spectacle. Witness the bubbling mud pits and lunar-like landscapes, admiring nature's wonders. After the tour, transfer back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Atlas Hotel Baku / Similar

itinerary.title: Absheron Peninsula Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, get ready to go on a fascinating journey to the Absheron Peninsula, beginning with a visit to Yanar Dag, the legendary "Burning Mountain." Continuing your exploration, dive into the region's rich history at the Ateshgah Fire Temple, an ancient Zoroastrian pilgrimage site. As the tour concludes, transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Atlas Hotel Baku / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Check-out from the hotel, and get transferred to Heydar Aliyev International Airport for your onward journey. Depart Azerbaijan with cherished memories of your unforgettable adventures and the warm hospitality of its people.

name: Azerbaijan and Georgia Tour Package
description: Offer your premium travelers the ultimate cross-border Caucasus exploration with this professionally structured 6 Nights and 7 Days Azerbaijan and Georgia combo vacation layout. This expansive itinerary avoids rushed journeys by providing a perfectly balanced route: 2 nights in the modern Caspian capital of Baku, 1 scenic night in the lush valleys of Gabala, and 3 nights in the historic Georgian capital of Tbilisi, all complete with daily hot morning buffet breakfasts. The tour features full ground assistance starting with a private transfer from Heydar Aliyev Airport to your super deluxe hotel property. Guests will experience a detailed Baku City Sightseeing loop, a cultural Baku Old City walk, and an exploration of the eternal flames on the Absheron Peninsula, followed by a historical transit through Sheki City. Upon entering Georgia, the holiday track escalates into an iconic Tbilisi walking tour, including complimentary Mother of Georgia Cable Car tickets. The mountain tracks feature a full day trip to the snow-capped Gudauri Ski Resort, the Panorama Gudauri viewpoint, the ancient Ananuri Fortress Complex, and the breathtaking Gergeti Trinity Church. Concluding with a organized departure transit to Tbilisi International Airport, this land-only package is a masterpiece of operational engineering.
shortDescription: A magnificent 7-day multi-country private Caucasus itinerary seamlessly blending the heritage of Azerbaijan with the scenic alpine valleys and ancient churches of Georgia.
highlights: Walk past historic stone walls, ancient palaces, and signature watchtowers inside Baku's iconic Old City.
Witness the legendary eternal gas flames at Ateshgah Fire Temple and the burning hillside of Yanar Dag.
Explore the historic trading tracks of Sheki City and the alpine beauty of the scenic Gabala valleys.
Ride the famous Mother of Georgia Cable Car and discover the colorful wooden balconies of Old Tbilisi.
Capture spectacular mountain views from the Gudauri Panorama and the isolated Gergeti Trinity Church peak.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Baku | Baku Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your incredible Azerbaijan and Georgia tour with a warm welcome in Baku. After landing at the airport, get driven to the hotel & check in. Later, embark on city tour to discover Baku's rich heritage. Start at Highland Park, where you can enjoy views of city’s skyline & Caspian Sea. Next, marvel at Flame Towers, whose design reflects Azerbaijan’s ancient fire-worshipping culture. Continue to Nizami Street, an avenue filled with boutiques & cosy cafés. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Atlas Hotel Baku / Premier Palace Baku / Similar

itinerary.title: Baku Old City Tour | Absheron Peninsula Tour
itinerary.description: Begin today's day by exploring Baku's old town. Explore Maiden Tower & Shirvanshahs Palace, narrating stories of city’s ancient heritage. Next, visit National Carpet Museum, highlighting carpet weaving history & National History Museum, featuring exhibits on modern history, among other attractions. Then, get driven to Absheron Peninsula & explore Heydar Aliyev Center, designed by world-famous architect, Zaha Hadid & Fire Temple, dedicated to fire-worshiping. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Atlas Hotel Baku / Premier Palace Baku / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Gabala | Enroute Sheki Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Check out & get driven to Gabala. En route, make a stop at Sheki. As you reach, visit Sheki Khan's Palace, which highlights a blend of Persian & Azerbaijani architecture. Next, explore Sheki Karvansaray where you can shop for textiles & handicrafts. While you're there, also try Sheki Pakhlava, a pastry with nuts & spices & Piti, a hearty lamb stew cooked in a clay pot that defines Azerbaijani culture. Continue the journey to Sheki & upon arrival, check in at the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Deluxe Park Qusar Resort & Spa Hotel / Qafqaz Karvansaray Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Tbilisi | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: After you check out, get transferred to your new destination in Georgia and Azerbaijan tour​, Tbilisi. Upon arriving at the hotel, check in & relax for some time. Later, you can explore the city at your own pace. You may visit Chronicles of Georgia which highlights the country's history. Alternatively, you can visit the Georgian National Museum, where you can see various archaeological artefacts or Anchiskhati Basilica, Tbili's oldest surviving church. Later, head back to the hotel on your own.
itinerary.accommodation: Courtyard Tbilisi / Hotel Iveria Inn / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Zinvali Reservoir, Ananuri Complex & Gergeti Church | Trip to Gudauri
itinerary.description: Today, start your journey with a visit to the beautiful Zhinvali Reservoir, located along the Aragvi River. Next, head to the Ananuri Complex, an ancient fortress known for its vintage church & bell tower. Continue your exploration to Kazbegi & visit the iconic Gergeti Church, offering panoramic views of Mt. Kazbek. Finish the day in Gudauri, where at Gudauri Ski Resort you can try thrilling activities & then marvel at Russia-Georgia Friendship Monument, adorned with vibrant Soviet-era mosaics.
itinerary.accommodation: Courtyard Tbilisi / Hotel Iveria Inn / Similar

itinerary.title: Tbilisi Walking Tour | Cable Car Ride to Mother of Georgia
itinerary.description: Today, explore Tbilisi on a walking tour. Begin with the old town, where you can spend time at the city's sulphur pools & stop at two iconic photo points—the Bridge of Love & the Bridge of Peace. Continue the journey & marvel at Tbilisi Clock Tower, known for its leaning design. Also, stroll along Rustaveli Avenue, full of cafes & theatres & Tsminda Sameba, Georgia's largest cathedral. Then, head to Rike Park & take the cable car to Mother of Georgia Viewpoint, a symbol of Georgia's strength.
itinerary.accommodation: Courtyard Tbilisi / Hotel Iveria Inn / Similar

itinerary.description: Reflect on the amazing memories you've made during your Georgia and Azerbaijan tour. After you check out, get driven to the airport to board your flight back home. This marks the end of your trip.

name: Escape to Vietnam with Boat Ride to Tam Coc Caves
description: This 5-day itinerary brings out the absolute best of Northern Vietnam without rushing the experience. Based out of the cozy HM Boutique Hotel right in the heartbeat of Hanoi's Old Quarter, your guests will experience local life up close. The trip takes them down south to Ninh Binh for a peaceful rowboat ride through the quiet Tam Coc caves—often called Halong Bay on land—paired with a classic bicycle ride down to the hidden Bich Dong pagoda. The real showstopper is a full 24-hour overnight cruise inside Halong Bay, where guests sleep on the water surrounded by thousands of limestone peaks, with all onboard meals covered. From smooth airport pickups to handling all the internal road transfers and ferry tickets back to Hanoi, this package keeps operations 100% stress-free while giving your clients an authentic, deeply satisfying vacation.
shortDescription: A perfectly paced northern Vietnam getaway featuring old-quarter charm in Hanoi, a slow traditional boat ride through Tam Coc’s towering cliffs, and a luxury overnight cruise stay on Halong Bay.
highlights: Explore the buzzing, lantern-lit streets and colonial café culture of Hanoi's historic 36 streets.
Row through giant limestone tunnels on a traditional wooden boat along the peaceful Ngo Dong River in Tam Coc.
Pedal past scenic rice paddies and cliffside trails to reach the ancient, three-tiered Bich Dong cave temple.
Watch a spectacular sunset from the sundeck of your cruise ship deep inside the emerald waters of Halong Bay.
Wake up early for a calming Tai Chi session on deck or kayak through hidden lagoons and secret floating villages.

Admire the iconic red The Huc Bridge leading to the temple and enjoy serene views of Hoan Kiem Lake. Conclude your day by returning to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

Afterwards, explore the limestone caves of Tam Coc on a boat ride (at an extra cost) from Hao Lu. From there, enjoy a cycling adventure to Bich Dong Pagoda before getting transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

name: Romantic Vietnam | FREE Ba Na Hills Cable Car Tickets
description: Why settle for just one region when you can show your clients the entire length of Vietnam in one perfect, seamless sweep? This massive 8-day package covers the complete northern, central, and southern loops. We handle the logistics from start to finish: picking them up in Hanoi, checking them into the beautiful HM Boutique Hotel in the Old Quarter, sending them off on a luxury overnight cruise in Halong Bay with all meals included, and flying them over to coastal Da Nang. There, they'll stay at the premium Luxtery Da Nang, walk the historic lanes of Hoi An at night, and ride the breathtaking cable car up to the famous Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills—with tickets fully covered. To top it off, they'll fly south to the bustling streets of Saigon, check into Avanti Saigon Hotel, and dive deep into history at the iconic Cu Chi Tunnels. With both domestic flight tickets fully included, this is the most stress-free and highly satisfying premium tour itinerary you can offer to families and couples.
shortDescription: The definitive 8-day cross-country Vietnam journey linking the mist-shrouded peaks of Halong Bay, the coastal charm of Da Nang, and the high-octane history of Saigon.
highlights: Walk past the bustling cafés, narrow railway tracks, and historic French-colonial buildings in Hanoi's Old Quarter.
Sail between giant limestone peaks, kayak through hidden lagoons, and sleep on the calm water in Halong Bay.
Take the world's longest single-cable car up to the Ba Na Hills and photograph the famous stone hands of the Golden Bridge.
Stroll through the glowing, colorful paper-lantern streets of Hoi An's historic riverside market area at sunset.
Squeeze into the historic underground tunnels of Cu Chi and explore the high-energy skyline of Ho Chi Minh City.

name: Vietnam Couple EXCLUSIVE | FREE Candle Light Dinner
description: Tailored specifically for couples looking for the perfect mix of culture, history, and romance, this 7-day itinerary seamlessly bridges the two distinct halves of Vietnam. Starting in the charming northern capital of Hanoi, your guests will enjoy a base at the HM Boutique Hotel in the center of the Old Quarter, take a scenic boat trip through Ninh Binh's quiet rivers, and experience a magical 24-hour overnight stay on a premium cruise ship floating through Halong Bay's iconic limestone pillars. After taking an included domestic flight down south, the vibe shifts to the lively streets of Ho Chi Minh City at Avanti Saigon Hotel. The southern track brings them right to the historical Cu Chi Tunnels and a quiet day exploring the floating life of the Mekong Delta. With smooth operations from airport to airport and a complimentary candlelit dinner setup, this land-and-flight combo is an easy sell for high-converting honeymoon packages.
shortDescription: A curated 7-day romantic journey spanning Northern and Southern Vietnam, featuring old-world Hanoi charms, a luxury overnight cruise in Halong Bay, and a vibrant escape to Saigon.
highlights: Walk hand-in-hand through the lantern-lit streets, classic French buildings, and lively markets of Hanoi.
Row past towering limestone cliffs on a traditional small boat along the peaceful waters of Ninh Binh.
Watch the stars from your cruise sundeck and catch a gorgeous sunrise over the emerald waters of Halong Bay.
Cruise down the winding channels of the Mekong Delta under the shade of massive water coconut trees.
Explore the vast underground military networks at Cu Chi and see the modern skyline of Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arrival at the Noi Bai International Airport, you will be transferred to the hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day at leisure exploring various attractions in the capital city, Hanoi. You can visit Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Huc Bridge, and Ngoc Son Temple Hanoi, among other attractions. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi  / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh
itinerary.description: In the morning, you'll get transferred to Hoa Lu in Ninh Binh district. Explore the ancient temples of the Le and Dinh Dynasties, marveling at their well-preserved architecture. After immersing yourself in the rich heritage, embark on a serene boat trip through Tam Coc. As you glide through the tranquil waters, witness stunning limestone formations, lush rice paddies and beautiful caves. Afterward, get driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Hoa Lu temples of the Dinh & Le Dynasties
itinerary.accommodation: Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi  / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise
itinerary.description: Post check out from your hotel, get driven through scenic routes to Tuan Chau Marina. Upon your arrival, board a traditional sailing cruise, check in and enjoy the beautiful views of floating villages and limestone formations. Enjoy various entertainment options and engage in activities such as kayaking through the calm, clear waters or swimming in the bay’s refreshing depths. Afterward, return to your cabin for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Halong Royal Palace Cruise / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City via Hanoi | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Wake up early to witness a beautiful sunrise over Halong Bay. Enjoy breakfast and go on a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest cave in Halong Bay and admire its scenic beauty. Then, deboard the cruise and get transferred to Hanoi for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival, get transferred from the Tan Son Nhat International Airport to the hotel for check in. Spend the rest of the day at your leisure exploring various attractions, and later having an overnight stay at the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh / Similar

itinerary.title: Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels | Ho Chi Minh City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, get driven to Cu Chi Tunnels, an extensive network of underground passages used during the Vietnam War. Next, get transferred for a half-day tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Visit the Presidential Palace, a historical building that was once the residence of South Vietnam's president. Explore the War Remnants Museum, and marvel at the Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica, a beautiful French colonial architecture. Visit the Central Post Office, before getting driven back to your hotel.
activities: Cu Chi Tunnel Half Day Tour
itinerary.accommodation: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh / Similar

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta Tour
itinerary.description: On this day, get ready to go on the Mekong Delta tour. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, the biggest pagoda (multi-tiered Buddhist temple tower) of the Mekong Delta, before you set sail on a boat ride along the Mekong River. Explore My Tho, the floating market city of Vietnam, and Tortoise Islet during the ride. After the fun-filled day, you will be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of your hotel and get transferred to the Tan Son Nhat International Airport to board the flight for your onward journey. This marks the end of your trip.

name: Escape to Vietnam | FREE Halong Bay Cruise Excursion
description: This seamless 7-day itinerary covers Vietnam's must-see landmarks with complete pre-booked land inclusions. Your vacation begins with a 2-night stay at HM Boutique Hotel Hanoi, featuring a scenic shared day tour to Ninh Binh for a Tam Coc rowboat ride and a private cycling trail to Bich Dong. Next, step onboard a premium cruise ship for a full 1-night overnight cabin stay inside Halong Bay, complete with all main meals served hot on the water. You will then head to Central Vietnam for a 2-night stay at Luxtery Da Nang, including full-day tickets to the stunning Ba Na Hills cable car track. Conclude your trip with a 1-night overnight stay at Hoi An Rose Garden Hotel, letting you experience the famous glowing paper lantern streets at your own pace without any rush.
shortDescription: Discover the ultimate blend of culture and coastal beauty on this perfectly structured 7-day Vietnam getaway. Explore the historic charm of Hanoi's Old Quarter, settle into a luxury premium overnight cabin cruise inside Halong Bay, and walk across the world-famous Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills. Wrap up your journey with a magical overnight stay inside the beautifully lit ancient river town of Hoi An.
highlights: Explore the historic narrow lanes, bustling local cafes, and old French colonial landmarks of Hanoi.
Row on a traditional wooden boat through Tam Coc's river caves and cycle past Ninh Binh's green peaks.
Sip a cold drink on the sundeck of your cruise ship as the sun sets over the emerald water of Halong Bay.
Take the massive cable car up to the Ba Na Hills to snap photos on the iconic Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands.
Walk past the historic yellow merchants' houses and float a wishing candle on the Hoai River in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arrival at the Noi Bai International Airport, you’ll get transferred to your hotel for check in. Once done with all the formalities, you can spend the remaining day at your own pace. You can visit various attractions like Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and the Huc Bridge. After exploring the place, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi / Similar

itinerary.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh
itinerary.description: Today, board your pre-booked transfer from the hotel and get ready to go on the Ninh Binh City tour. Visit the former capital of Vietnam - Hao Lu, and its temples of the Dinh & Le Dynasties. Then, board the boat from Hao Lu to Tam Coc, and enjoy a ride through karst landscapes and rice fields, while admiring the limestone caves. Upon reaching Tam Coc, cycle through the Vietnamese villages and rocky formations, reaching Bich Dong Pagoda. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Hoa Lu temples of the Dinh & Le Dynasties
Cycle Tour to Bich Dong on a Shared basis
itinerary.accommodation: Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Halong Bay Cruise
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel and embark on a scenic drive to Halong Bay, passing through the countryside of Northern Vietnam. Upon arrival at the Tuan Chau Marina, board your traditional sailing cruise and get ready to enjoy the views as you sail through the bay. Later, visit the Ti Top Island, and Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like kayaking and swimming. Savour local flavours and engage in lively entertainment options onboard. Later, have an overnight stay on the cruise.
itinerary.accommodation: Halong Royal Palace Cruise / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Da Nang via Hanoi
itinerary.description: Begin your day by enjoying various activities on the cruise, including Chinese martial art - Tai Chi. Later, go on a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest cave in Halong Bay and witness its cave formations hanging from the ceiling. After lunch, disembark from the cruise and get transferred to Hanoi for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival at Da Nang International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel for check in and an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Luxtery Da Nang / Similar

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hill Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, get ready to explore Ba Na Hills by getting transferred to Suoi Mo Station for a cable car ride to Marseille Station. Upon reaching, your first stop will be the Golden Hand Bridge, situated nearly 1000 feet above sea level and offering stunning views of the mountains and the city below. Further, visit Linh Ung Pagoda, one of the largest pagodas (a tower-like structure) in Da Nang, along with Debay Wine Cellar, and Fantasy Park. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Luxtery Da Nang / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Hoi An | Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel in Da Nang and board your pre-booked transfer to Hoi An. Upon arrival, proceed with your check in formalities, and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can explore places such as the Fujian Assembly Hall and Hoi An Night Market, or you can stroll around the beautiful An Bang Beach. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hoi An Rose Garden Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and get transferred to the Da Nang International Airport to board your flight for an onward journey. This is where your trip ends.

name: EXCLUSIVE Vietnam with Fansipan Mountain Trek & Cave Excursion
description: This action-packed 7-day Northern Vietnam itinerary is perfectly designed to give you an authentic taste of both mountain adventure and coastal luxury. Your journey features a 4-night stay at the centrally located HM Boutique Hotel in Hanoi, from where you will enjoy a shared day tour to Ninh Binh for a cave boat trip and a private cycling tour to Bich Dong. Travel high up into the misty peaks for a 1-night stay in Sa Pa, exploring the local tribal culture of Cat Cat Village and heading up the mighty Fansipan Mountain. Wrap up your northern loop with a 1-night stay in a private cabin on a premium Halong Bay overnight cruise, inclusive of hot meals prepared on the water. With round-trip airport transits handled in air-conditioned comfort, this itinerary delivers a complete, hassle-free vacation.
shortDescription: Conquer the roof of Indochina and explore historic valley trails on this immersive 7-day Northern Vietnam journey. Settle into the old-world charm of Hanoi, experience the misty mountain ridges and tribal culture of Sa Pa, and spend a magical night aboard a luxury cruise ship in Halong Bay.
highlights: Wander through the busy market streets, hidden local alleyways, and colonial French cafes inside Hanoi's Old Quarter.
Row a traditional wooden boat through deep river caves and cycle past green rural rice fields in Ninh Binh.
Walk alongside local ethnic minority communities and see beautiful cascading waterfalls inside Cat Cat Village.
Stand on the high ridges of Fansipan Mountain, known widely as the iconic Roof of Indochina.
Watch the stars from your cruise deck and kayak through calm hidden lagoons inside emerald Halong Bay.

In the evening, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

itinerary.description: Begin this day with a transfer for a day trip to Ninh Binh city. Visit Hoa Lu and its ancient temples of the Dinh and Le Dynasties. Following that, explore the limestone caves of Tam Coc, on a boat ride from Hao Lu. From there, enjoy a cycling adventure to Bich Dong Pagoda before getting transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.description: On this day, check out of the hotel, and get driven to your hotel in Sa Pa. Then, embark on a nearly 3-km downhill trek through rice terraces to Cat Cat Village, home to the Black H'mong ethnic group. Learn more about their rich culture and immerse yourself in the natural beauty surrounding the Tien Sa Waterfall. Conclude your day by trekking back to the hotel in Sa Pa, for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Fansipan Mountain Tour | Transfer to Hanoi
itinerary.description: Embark on a thrilling day trip to Fansipan, the 3,147-metre-high mountain, also called 'Roof of Indochina' as it is the highest peak in Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia. Soar above the clouds on a cable car ride and enjoy views of breathtaking mountain scenery. Also, visit the Kim Son Bao Thang Temple situated at the top of the mountain. Post that, return to the hotel in Sa Pa before checking out and transferring to Hanoi for an overnight stay.

Stop by Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village, and enjoy water activities like kayaking. Learn the art of Vietnamese cuisine with a cooking demonstration onboard. Conclude your day with an overnight stay on the cruise, surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of Halong Bay.

itinerary.description: Start your day with an exciting Tai Chi (martial art) lesson before exploring the awe-inspiring Sung Sot Cave, the largest in Halong Bay. Then, deboard at Tuan Chau Harbour and get transferred to the hotel in Hanoi to check in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring the place on your own. Immerse yourself in the city's history with visits to iconic landmarks like Temple Of Literature and Hanoi Opera House. Conclude the day by returning to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

name: Best of South Vietnam Tour Package
description: This highly efficient 4-day Southern Vietnam itinerary is built to deliver a comfortable and highly rewarding city getaway. Your package includes a 3-night stay at the centrally located Avanti Saigon Hotel with daily breakfast. You will explore the historic network of the Cu Chi Tunnels on a shared half-day tour, and discover French-colonial landmarks like the Notre Dame Cathedral during a city tour. Head out on a full-day shared excursion to the Mekong Delta to experience traditional local boat rides and floating community lifestyles. Completed with private airport transfers to and from Tan Son Nhat International Airport, this is a perfectly packaged, hassle-free tour.
shortDescription: Dive into the vibrant heart of Southern Vietnam on this action-packed 4-day metropolitan escape. Stay in the center of District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City, crawl through the historic underground Cu Chi Tunnels, and cruise the lush palm-fringed waterways of the Mekong Delta.
highlights: Wander past colonial French monuments including the historic Central Post Office and Opera House.
Experience the underground bunker system, hidden traps, and wartime meeting rooms at Cu Chi.
Glide on a traditional wooden boat past coconut orchards and stilt houses along the Mekong River.
Sample sweet local honey tea, tropical fruits, and listen to traditional folk music in the delta.
Bargain for local souvenirs and try legendary street food at the world-famous Ben Thanh Market.

itinerary.description: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at the Tan Son Nhat International Airport, get transferred to the hotel and check in. Rest for a while before heading out to explore the local attractions on your own. Visit Thien Hau Temple, Chinese goddess Mazu’s temple, go on a shopping spree at Pham Ngu Lao Street, and witness Ho Chi Minh City's vibrant nightlife on Bui Vien Walking Street and Landmark 81. Conclude your day by returning to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

Then, head to some famous attractions of Ho Chi Minh City like the War Remnants Museum and Reunification Palace. Also, visit the Saigon Central Post Office, an architectural marvel designed in French colonial style. Later, get dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

name: Escape to Vietnam with Scenic Boat Ride to the Mekong Delta
description: This highly efficient 6-day itinerary is perfectly structured to show you both the spectacular North and vibrant South of Vietnam in a single trip. Your getaway begins with a 2-night stay at HM Boutique Hotel Hanoi, featuring a shared day trip to Ninh Binh for a cave rowboat ride and a scenic shared cycle tour around Bich Dong. Next, enjoy a 1-night overnight cabin cruise inside Halong Bay, complete with all main meals served fresh on the water. You will then transition to the energetic streets of Ho Chi Minh City for a 2-night stay at Avanti Saigon Hotel. The southern loop concludes with an unforgettable shared full-day excursion to the scenic waterways of the Mekong Delta. With pre-arranged airport transits and intercity harbor pickups included, this package keeps your travel comfortable and completely stress-free.
shortDescription: Experience the perfect transition from Northern culture to Southern river life on this 6-day Vietnam adventure. Walk through the historic streets of Hanoi, wake up inside a luxury cabin on Halong Bay, and cruise past the lush coconut groves of the famous Mekong Delta.
highlights: Explore the buzzing, narrow historic lanes and legendary local café culture of Hanoi's Old Quarter.
Row past towering limestone cliffs in Ninh Binh and pedal to the ancient cliffside Bich Dong pagoda.
Watch the sunset from your cruise sundeck and sleep under the stars in emerald Halong Bay.
Sip fresh coconut water and glide on a wooden sampan boat along the narrow canals of the Mekong Delta.
Discover the colonial architecture and lively street-side shopping districts in Ho Chi Minh City.
