name: Vietnam Romantic Escape | Honeymoon Special
description: This beautifully curated 6-day honeymoon getaway perfectly blends coastal exploration with island relaxation for couples. Your romantic escape begins with a 3-night stay at a deluxe hotel in Da Nang, featuring a full-day trip to Ba Na Hills to see the iconic Golden Bridge and a half-day Cam Thanh coconut basket boat ride. You will then fly to the pristine tropical island of Phu Quoc for a 2-night stay, enjoying the vibrant atmosphere of the Grand World complex. Your island retreat is complete with a thrilling ride on the world's longest oversea cable car, an island-hopping tour, and fun-filled water slides at Aquatopia Waterpark. With daily breakfasts, included entry fees, and all airport transits fully pre-arranged, this package is designed to deliver a smooth, dreamlike vacation.
shortDescription: Escape on a romantic 6-day journey combining the coastal charms of Da Nang with the tropical beach paradise of Phu Quoc Island. Walk hand-in-hand across the famous Golden Bridge, ride a traditional coconut basket boat, and explore the Venetian-style canals of Grand World.
highlights: Walk past the misty mountain ridges and pose together on the giant stone hands of the Golden Bridge.
Spin through the quiet coconut jungle waterways in a traditional bamboo basket boat at Cam Thanh.
Cruise along the beautiful Venice-inspired canals and watch the colorful street shows inside Grand World Phu Quoc.
Fly over the turquoise ocean on the famous high-speed Phu Quoc cable car for stunning island views.
Splash through world-class water rides and lounge on pristine white-sand beaches at Aquatopia.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Da Nang | Cam Thanh Basket Boat Trip
itinerary.description: Welcome to Da Nang! Upon arrival at the Da Nang International Airport, you will get transferred to the hotel for check in. Rest for a while before boarding your pre-booked transfer to Hoi An. Experience a unique boat ride through the Bay Mau Coconut Forest on a traditional bamboo basket boat. En route, get a glimpse into the daily lives of local fishermen and have a go at paddling. Conclude your day by getting dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Bay Mau Coconut Forest, Hoi An
itinerary.accommodation: Luxtery Da Nang / Diamond Sea Hotel, Da Nang / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Ba Na Hills
itinerary.description: Today, visit Ba Na Hills by getting transferred from the hotel. Take a cable car ride, witnessing beautiful views of the area. Moreover, stroll through the 150-metre long Golden Hand Bridge, supported by the huge hands. Further, visit Linh Ung Pagoda, home to a 67-metre high Lady Buddha statue, and Debay Wine Cellar, to learn about wine making secrets. Next, head to Fantasy Park and enjoy several fun games. Later, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Luxtery Da Nang / Diamond Sea Hotel, Da Nang / Similar

itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Da Nang
itinerary.description: This day is for you to explore the city at your own pace. You can indulge in various activities or explore iconic attractions including My Khe Beach, Dragon Bridge, and Con Market. After exploring, head back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Luxtery Da Nang / Diamond Sea Hotel, Da Nang / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Phu Quoc | Grand World Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get driven to the Da Nang International Airport to board your flight to Phu Quoc. Upon arrival at Phu Quoc International Airport, get driven to your hotel to check in. Later, board your pre-booked transfer to go to Grand World Phu Quoc, an entertainment and shopping complex. While there, you can watch captivating performances, go on a shopping spree, and savour delicious cuisine (at an extra cost). Finally, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phu Quoc Island Tour | Visit to Aquatopia Waterpark
itinerary.description: Begin your adventure by getting transferred to An Thoi Station and taking the world's longest sea-crossing cable car from there to Hon Thom Island. Continue your fun by visiting Aquatopia Water Park and experiencing the world of excitement with over 20 games and 6 themed zones designed for all ages. After an adventurous day, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

name: Vietnam Getaway with FREE Cu Chi Tunnels Visit
description: This highly organized 5-day itinerary offers a deeply satisfying and focused exploration of Southern Vietnam based out of a single deluxe hotel property. Your package includes a 4-night stay in Ho Chi Minh City with fresh daily breakfasts and private round-trip airport transfers. You will discover iconic French-colonial architecture on a shared half-day guided city sightseeing tour. The trip also features a full-day shared river excursion to the beautiful Mekong Delta to experience traditional local boat rides and floating community lifestyles. Complete your holiday with a small-group guided tour to the historic underground tunnels of Cu Chi, all managed with pre-booked entry permits.
shortDescription: Immerse yourself in the high-energy pulse and rich history of Southern Vietnam on this seamless 5-day holiday hub. Settle into deluxe comfort in Ho Chi Minh City, cruise past the scenic coconut groves of the Mekong Delta, and explore the legendary underground network of the Cu Chi Tunnels.
highlights: Wander past classic French-colonial monuments like the historic Central Post Office and Opera House.
Experience the underground bunker systems, hidden trap doors, and meeting rooms inside Cu Chi.
Glide on a traditional wooden sampan boat past green coconut orchards along the peaceful Mekong channels.
Sample sweet local honey tea, tropical fruits, and listen to traditional folk music inside the delta villages.
Bargain for unique local souvenirs and try legendary local drip coffee at the famous Ben Thanh Market.

name: Rediscover Vietnam - A Complete Honeymoon Tour
description: This comprehensive 9-day honeymoon itinerary is carefully structured to showcase the best romantic corners of Northern, Central, and Southern Vietnam. You will start with a 2-night stay at HM Boutique Hotel in Hanoi with a guided Ninh Binh excursion and a private cycle tour to Bich Dong. Enjoy a magical 1-night stay on a shared overnight cruise floating through the towering limestone karsts of Halong Bay. Next, relax with a 3-night coastal stay at Luxtery Da Nang featuring a day excursion up to the famous Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills. Conclude your trip with a 3-night stay at Avanti Saigon Hotel in Ho Chi Minh City to explore the Mekong Delta channels and the historic Cu Chi Tunnels.
shortDescription: Celebrate your love across three breathtaking regions of Vietnam on this ultimate 9-day romantic getaway. It is the perfect blend of natural wonders, historic charm, and modern city lights.

Walk hand-in-hand across the giant stone hands of the famous Golden Bridge in the clouds.
Explore the quiet water coconut channels of the Mekong Delta on a rustic hand-rowed sampan boat.

name: Vietnam Highlights with FREE Ban Gioc Waterfall Tour
description: This meticulously planned 8-day itinerary offers an immersive exploration of Northern Vietnam's most celebrated landscapes and hidden gems. Your trip includes a 4-night stay in a deluxe hotel in Hanoi, complete with a shared city sightseeing tour and a scenic day excursion to Ninh Binh. You will experience a magical 1-night shared overnight cruise across the breathtaking emerald waters of UNESCO-listed Halong Bay. The adventure then heads north for a 2-night stay in Cao Bang to marvel at the spectacular Ban Gioc Waterfall, one of Southeast Asia's most stunning natural icons. Enjoy daily breakfasts, all entrance fees pre-arranged, and smooth private airport transfers to complete your holiday.
shortDescription: Embark on an extraordinary 8-day journey into the raw natural beauty and cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Witness the colossal, multi-tiered Ban Gioc Waterfall tucked away in the lush borders of Cao Bang and sail among limestone karsts in Halong Bay. This unique package perfectly blends historic city charms with off-the-beaten-path mountain wonders.
highlights: Stand in awe before the roaring turquoise waters and mist-shrouded green cliffs of the remote Ban Gioc Waterfall.
Glide past ancient rivers and towering green mountains on a traditional rowboat during your Ninh Binh excursion.
Stroll through the lively, historic streets of Hanoi's Old Quarter and marvel at French-colonial architecture.
Capture unmatched landscape photographs as you travel deep into the misty, terraced mountain passes of Cao Bang.
Watch a glorious golden sunset from the sundeck of your ship floating through the quiet corners of Halong Bay.

itinerary.description: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, transfer to your hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day exploring the destination at your own pace. You can visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the resting place of the Vietnamese revolutionary leader Ho Chi Minh, and the Lake of the Restored Sword, a significant cultural and historical site in Hanoi, along with other attractions. After a fun-filled day, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

Visit the former capital of Vietnam - Hao Lu, and its temples of the Dinh & Le Dynasties. After exploring the temples, board the boat from Hao Lu to Tam Coc, and enjoy a ride through limestone karst (rock formation) landscapes and rice fields, while admiring the caves formed over millions of years. Later, transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

name: Wonders of Vietnam with FREE Visit to Fansipan Mountain
description: This dynamic 6-day itinerary beautifully captures the dramatic contrast between Vietnam's towering misty peaks and legendary emerald seascapes. Your package features a 3-night deluxe base stay in the historic capital of Hanoi with private round-trip airport transfers. Journey high into the terraced northern highlands for a 1-night stay in Sa Pa, including a guided half-day cultural walk through ethnic Cat Cat Village. Scale new heights with a pre-booked shared excursion up the iconic Fansipan Mountain to enjoy panoramic above-cloud vistas. Wrap up your northern exploration with a 1-night shared overnight cruise across the world-famous limestone karsts of stunning Halong Bay.
shortDescription: Uncover the spellbinding natural diverse wonders of Northern Vietnam on this perfectly action-packed 6-day mountain and sea escape. Conquer the Roof of Indochina with a majestic cable car journey up misty Fansipan Mountain and trek through traditional tribal valleys in Sa Pa. Complete your holiday with an unforgettable luxury overnight cruise across the magical waters of Halong Bay.
highlights: Stand above a sea of thick rolling clouds at the panoramic summit temple complex of Fansipan Mountain.
Hike past rolling green terraced rice fields and bamboo bridges to meet local weavers in Cat Cat Village.
Watch a breathtaking twilight sunset from the open-air wooden sundeck of your Halong Bay cruise ship.
Kayak or swim inside the quiet, hidden emerald lagoons and limestone arches of the Halong archipelago.
Try legendary egg coffee or wander through the narrow French-colonial street layouts of Hanoi's Old Quarter.

name: Offbeat Vietnam Sightseeing Tour
description: This epic 9-day grand itinerary is expertly designed to show you both the famous highlights and spectacular offbeat wilderness hubs of Vietnam. Your comprehensive package begins with a 2-night stay at HM Boutique Hotel Hanoi, featuring a shared Ninh Binh day tour and a countryside cycle tour to Bich Dong. Enjoy an extended 3-night experience in Halong Bay, highlighted by a magical 1-night shared premium overnight cabin cruise layout with all main meals included on the water. The adventure turns offbeat as you transfer to the spectacular Phong Nha Lake House Resort for a full-day guided exploration of the massive Phong Nha Caves. Next, head down to Central Vietnam for a 2-night stay at Luxtery Da Nang, featuring a full-day shared excursion to the iconic Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills. Conclude your mega vacation with a 1-night stay at Avanti Saigon Hotel in Ho Chi Minh City, complete with a shared half-day tour to the historic Cu Chi Tunnels.
shortDescription: Uncover the perfect mix of iconic landmarks and hidden natural wonders on this grand 9-day cross-country Vietnam exploration. Settle into the charm of Hanoi, cruise through emerald Halong Bay, and journey deep into the mystical underground rivers of Phong Nha Caves. Complete your dream vacation walking across Da Nang's famous Golden Bridge and diving into Saigon's historic wartime secrets.
highlights: Glide past mystical limestone rivers in Ninh Binh and cycle along peaceful rural village paths to Bich Dong.
Watch the stars from your cruise deck and kayak inside the quiet, hidden emerald lagoons of Halong Bay.
Board a local wooden boat to cruise inside the illuminated wet passages and ancient stalactites of Phong Nha Cave.
Ride the world's longest single-cable car track up to the misty mountain ridges of the Ba Na Hills complex.
Crawl through the legendary underground military bunker systems and hidden trap doors inside the Cu Chi Tunnels.

name: Highlights of Vietnam | Group Tour Package
description: This comprehensive 7-day group itinerary is smartly tailored to showcase Vietnam’s most legendary highlights across three distinct regions with flawless logistics. Start with a 2-night deluxe stay in Ho Chi Minh City, featuring a guided city sightseeing circuit and a deep dive into the wartime history of the Cu Chi Tunnels. Fly into Central Vietnam for a 1-night stay in Da Nang, packed with a scenic daytime excursion to Ba Na Hills to witness the iconic Golden Hands Bridge. Immerse yourself in heritage with a walking tour of ancient Hoi An followed by a relaxing traditional boat ride along the historic Thu Bon River. Conclude your tour with a 3-night deluxe base in Hanoi, highlighted by a tranquil day cruise across UNESCO-listed Halong Bay and a scenic day trip to Ninh Binh.
shortDescription: Experience the definitive essence of Vietnam on an incredible 7-day social group journey tracing from the southern energy of Saigon to the northern charms of Hanoi. Explore the historic underground networks of Cu Chi Tunnels, cross the world-famous Golden Hands Bridge in the misty Ba Na Hills, and stroll through lantern-lit streets in Hoi An. Cap off your vibrant holiday with a majestic day cruise sailing past the towering limestone karsts of Halong Bay.
highlights: Crawl inside the legendary hidden trapdoors and complex wartime bunker networks of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels.
Ride a modern cable car up through the clouds to reach the beautiful French-inspired village at Ba Na Hills.
Watch the magical evening glow of handmade silk lanterns reflecting over the calm waters of the Thu Bon River.
Immerse yourself in Northern Vietnam's jaw-dropping rural landscapes during a guided excursion to Ninh Binh.
Savor a delicious fresh lunch served on deck while cruising past iconic rocky islets in the middle of Halong Bay.

name: The Vietnam Adventure
description: This premium 7-day country-wide itinerary is highly optimized for travelers looking for top-tier comfort and heavy adventure inclusions. Your holiday features a 2-night stay at a premium Super Deluxe Hotel in Ho Chi Minh City, highlighted by an action-packed full-day combo tour to both the Cu Chi Tunnels and the Mekong Delta waterways. Fly to Central Vietnam for a 2-night super deluxe stay in Da Nang, complete with a shared half-day walking city tour of ancient Hoi An and a full-day excursion up to Ba Na Hills that includes a complimentary hot buffet lunch. Conclude your tour with a 1-night premium base stay in Hanoi, featuring an incredible shared full-day sightseeing cruise across the legendary waters of Halong Bay. Supported by expert local guides and all airport transits, this package delivers a perfect hassle-free loop.
shortDescription: Thrill your senses across three majestic regions on this ultimate 7-day cross-country Vietnam adventure. Stay in premium super deluxe comfort while exploring historic wartime underground channels and lush river deltas in the south. Take stunning photos on Central Vietnam's iconic Golden Bridge and cruise past the iconic emerald limestone peaks of Halong Bay.
highlights: Experience crawling inside the complex wartime underground military bunker networks at Cu Chi.
Glide past tropical coconut orchards on a rustic hand-rowed sampan boat along the Mekong channels.
Walk past the massive stone hands of the iconic Golden Bridge for sweeping mountain photographs.
Stroll through the beautifully preserved, mustard-yellow lantern streets inside historic ancient Hoi An.
Savor a delicious fresh lunch served on deck while cruising past iconic rocky islets in Halong Bay.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City | Meet Your Travel Crew
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam’s buzzing southern capital packed with life, color, and energy, get transferred to your hotel. Check in at the hotel before meeting your travel group. Spend the afternoon chilling by the pool, grabbing coffee at a local spot, or exploring the nearby streets together. In the evening, head out with your new friends for a relaxed dinner or casual drinks as you kick off your Vietnam adventure.

itinerary.title: Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels & Mekong Delta
itinerary.description: Today, head out with your group to uncover Vietnam’s history and charm. Explore the famous Cu Chi Tunnels and see how locals once lived and fought underground during the war. Later, cruise through the Mekong Delta, passing lush green fields and quiet riverside villages. Enjoy tropical fruits, local snacks, and the calm rhythm of river life before returning to Ho Chi Minh City for the night.

itinerary.title: Flight to Da Nang | Hoi An Evening Tour
itinerary.description: Fly to Da Nang with your group and check in before setting out together for an evening walking tour of Hoi An. Explore the Japanese Covered Bridge, Sa Huynh Museum, and Phuoc Kien Assembly Hall. Watch local artisans make silk, shop at the lively Central Market, and capture the charm of lantern-lit streets with your travel crew before heading back to the hotel for the night.

Sail through thousands of monolithic limestone islands on a comprehensive full-day Halong Bay cruise.
Travel seamlessly with pre-arranged airport transits and professional English-speaking guide services.

name: Vietnamese Odyssey | Group Tour Package
description: This meticulously organized 8-day group itinerary offers the perfect blend of country-wide exploration and premium comfort. Your package features a 2-night super deluxe stay in Hanoi with a shared city sightseeing circuit, followed by a 1-night overnight cabin cruise experience through Halong Bay with all main meals served on board. Fly into Central Vietnam for a 2-night stay in Da Nang, highlighted by a full-day shared tour to the iconic Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills and a guided walking tour of ancient Hoi An. Conclude your trip with a 2-night stay in Ho Chi Minh City, complete with a shared half-day combo tour of the city and the historic Cu Chi Tunnels. Managed fully in air-conditioned vehicles with included visa assistance and daily Indian dinners, this package promises a seamless vacation.
shortDescription: Embark on a grand 8-day social group journey showcasing the absolute highlights of Vietnam in premium super deluxe comfort. Settle into luxurious properties from Hanoi to Saigon, wake up to a magical sunrise on a Halong Bay overnight cruise, and marvel at the famous Golden Bridge. Complete your hassle-free holiday with the comfort of familiar tastes featuring delicious Indian dinners.
highlights: Walk through the historic French-colonial street layouts and peaceful lakeside temples of Hanoi.
Watch the sunset over thousands of limestone karsts from the open-air wooden sundeck of your cruise ship.
Ride a modern high-speed cable car track through the clouds up to the scenic hills of Ba Na.
Explore the atmospheric, lantern-lit alleys and yellow merchant houses of UNESCO-listed Hoi An.
Crawl through the historic hidden trapdoors and underground military bunker networks at the Cu Chi Tunnels.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description: Welcome to Hanoi, known as the City of Soaring Dragon! Upon landing at Noi Bai International Airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel for check-in and relaxation. Once you're settled, you can get ready to explore the vibrant atmosphere of Hanoi at your own pace. Take a leisurely walk around Hoan Kiem Lake, soak in the sights of Thap Ruo Tower, and wander the streets to try local delicacies and shop for souvenirs. Finally, wrap up your day with an overnight stay at your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Beryl Charm Hotel and Spa / Hanoi Calista Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: City Tour of Hanoi
itinerary.description: Today, you'll be transferred to explore the gems of Hanoi with a visit to the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, followed by Quan Thanh Temple and Tran Quoc Pagoda. Then, explore the Bat Trang pottery village, discover the Ethnology Museum and pay respects to the Temple of Literature. Later, soak in the vibrant atmosphere of Old Quarter's 36 streets. You can end your day with a traditional Water Puppet Show [at an extra cost] before transferring back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Beryl Charm Hotel and Spa / Hanoi Calista Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Stay at Cruise
itinerary.description: In the morning, check-out and get transferred on a scenic journey from Hanoi to Halong Bay to enjoy an overnight stay aboard a luxurious cruise. Upon arrival at the pier, check-into your cruise and experience the beauty of the limestone caves and emerald waters as you cruise along the Hanoi Bay waters. Relax on deck, enjoy delicious meals, and take part in exciting activities like kayaking and cave exploration. Later in the night, settle in your cabin amidst the surrounding landscapes.
itinerary.accommodation: Majestic Halong Cruise / Era Cruises Halong / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer from Hanoi to Da Nang
itinerary.description: Today, get transferred to admire the beauty of Ba Na Hills. Begin with a scenic cable car ride from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station, soaking in the stunning views along the way. Upon reaching the summit, visit the iconic Golden Bridge. Then, explore the Le Jardin D'Amour, find peace at Linh Ung Pagoda and discover the Debay Wine Cellar followed by a Vietnamese buffet lunch. Afterwards, you can enjoy at Fantasy Park [at an extra cost]. Finally, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Eden Hotel Vietnam / Haian Beach Hotel & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge
itinerary.description: Today, get transferred to admire the beauty of Ba Na Hills. Begin with a scenic cable car ride from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station, soaking in the stunning views along the way. Upon reaching the summit, visit the iconic Golden Bridge. Then, explore the Le Jardin D'Amour, find peace at Linh Ung Pagoda and discover the Debay Wine Cellar followed by a Vietnamese buffet lunch. Afterwards, you can enjoy at Fantasy Park [at an extra cost]. Finally, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Eden Hotel Vietnam / Haian Beach Hotel & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Hoi An City Tour | Transfer from Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: Post check-out, you'll be transferred to explore the ancient town of Hoi An! Visit the Japanese Covered Bridge Pagoda, the Sa Huynh Museum, the Phuoc Kien Assembly Hall, the Silkworm Workshop and the bustling Central Market. Post the tour, transfer back to Da Nang hotel to collect your bags and head to the airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Once you arrive, get transferred to your hotel and check-in for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Liberty Hotel Saigon Parkview / Vien Dong Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Half-Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour with Cu Chi Tunnel
itinerary.description: Today, get transferred to explore the vibrant streets of Ho Chi Minh City. Start at the Independence Palace, a symbol of Vietnam's rich history. Then, visit the Notre Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office, showcasing French architecture. Then, discover the War Remnants Museum, a reminder of Vietnam's resilience. Later, conclude your day with the Cu Chi Tunnels, where you'll uncover insights into the country's wartime secrets. Afterwards, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Liberty Hotel Saigon Parkview / Vien Dong Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: As your Vietnamese adventure comes to an end, it's time to bid farewell to the beautiful memories and amazing experiences you've gathered. After checking out, your journey back home begins with a transfer to the airport. Don't forget to cherish those Insta-worthy shots you've captured along the way.

name: Vietnam Odyssey | A Tale of Majestic Bays and Tropical Shores
description: This grand 10-day comprehensive itinerary offers the absolute complete exploration of Vietnam with all internal domestic flights seamlessly pre-booked for you. Your mega vacation begins with a 2-night deluxe stay in Hanoi featuring a guided Ninh Binh day tour and a countryside cycle trip around Bich Dong. Experience a magical 1-night overnight cabin cruise floating through Halong Bay with fresh meals served right on the water. Fly directly to Central Vietnam for a 2-night stay in Da Nang to witness the iconic Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills. Continue your flight journey to the stunning tropical paradise of Phu Quoc Island for a relaxing 2-night beachside escape. Conclude your tour with a 2-night deluxe stay in Ho Chi Minh City to cruise past the lush orchards of the Mekong Delta.
shortDescription: Embark on the ultimate 10-day pan-Vietnam voyage combining northern limestone marvels, central coastal gems, southern delta life, and a tropical island escape. Sail through the emerald waters of Halong Bay, walk among the clouds on the Golden Bridge, and lounge on the pristine beaches of Phu Quoc Island. It is the definitive cross-country holiday tracking from Hanoi to Saigon in complete deluxe comfort.
highlights: Glide past mystical ancient caves in Ninh Binh and cycle along peaceful rural village paths to Bich Dong.
Watch a golden tropical sunset from the open sundeck of your luxury overnight ship inside Halong Bay.
Ride a high-speed scenic cable car track up to the beautiful French-inspired mountain village at Ba Na.
Unwind on the world-class white sand beaches and clear turquoise waters of tropical Phu Quoc Island.
Float along the narrow palm-fringed river canals of the Mekong Delta on a traditional wooden boat.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Once you check in, enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. You can visit the stunning St. Joseph's Cathedral, an iconic landmark with beautiful French Gothic architecture. You can also visit Hoan Kiem Lake and explore Ngoc Son Temple, a picturesque temple situated on a small island in the middle of the lake. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi / The Light Hotel Hanoi / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh
itinerary.description: Today, you'll board the transfer to Ninh Binh. Here, you'll explore the ancient capital and visit the historic temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. Afterward, embark on a picturesque boat ride from Hoa Lu to Tam Coc, gliding through scenic waterways framed by towering limestone karsts. Later, enjoy a peaceful cycling adventure along quiet village roads from Tam Coc to Bich Dong Pagoda, where you can explore the cluster of ancient cave temples. Lastly, get driven back to the hotel.
activities: Hoa Lu temples of the Dinh & Le Dynasties
itinerary.accommodation: Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi / The Light Hotel Hanoi / Similar

itinerary.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from the hotel and get driven to Tuan Chau Port in Halong Bay City. Upon arrival, board your traditional cruise and check into your room. As the cruise sets sail into Halong Bay, enjoy a delicious lunch featuring fresh seafood and local delicacies while admiring the stunning views of caves, Duck Islet and many more. You’ll also have the opportunity to participate in optional activities such as swimming and kayaking. Afterwards, return to your room for an overnight stay.
activities: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise Ticket Included
itinerary.accommodation: Halong Royal Palace Cruise / Similar

itinerary.title: Halong Bay to Da Nang via Hanoi
itinerary.description: Wake up early to enjoy the stunning sunrise views from your deck. Afterward, participate in a Tai Chi session on the sundeck or take a tour of Surprise Cave to explore its impressive natural beauty. Later, check out from the cruise and board the transfer from Tuan Chau Harbor to Hanoi Airport. Catch your flight to Da Nang, and upon arrival, check into your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Luxtery Da Nang / Diamond Sea Hotel, Da Nang / Similar

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hill Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll be driven to Ba Na Hills, where you’ll start your adventure with a cable car ride from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station. Upon arrival, admire the Golden Hand Bridge, which offers stunning 360° views of the surrounding landscape. Explore the French Village, where you can experience a blend of French-style architecture and cuisine. Next, take a leisurely stroll around Linh Ung Pagoda and visit the historic Debay Wine Cellar. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
activities: Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge Day Tour Ticket Included
itinerary.accommodation: Luxtery Da Nang / Diamond Sea Hotel, Da Nang / Similar

itinerary.title: Da Nang to Phu Quoc | Day at Lesiure
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from the hotel and transfer to Da Nang Airport for your flight to Phu Quoc. Upon arrival, you’ll be driven to your hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day at your leisure, exploring options such as Phu Quoc National Park or visiting the nearby Ham Ninh Fishing Village. In the evening, you can relax by the beautiful Long Beach, enjoying the serene sunset. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Praha Phu Quoc Hotel /Amarin Resort & Spa, Phu Quoc / Similar

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Phu Quoc
itinerary.description: This day is yours to explore the enchanting emerald island of Phú Quốc on your own. You can rent a motorbike and visit Suoi Tranh Waterfall for a refreshing swim amidst beautiful natural surroundings. Next, head to Vinpearl Safari, where you can see a diverse range of wild animals in their natural habitat. You can also explore VinWonders for its thrilling water slides and other attractions. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Praha Phu Quoc Hotel /Amarin Resort & Spa, Phu Quoc / Similar

itinerary.title: Fly to Ho Chi Minh | Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Today, you'll check out from the hotel and board the transfer to Phu Quoc Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Once you arrive, get driven to your hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day leisure. You can visit the Independence Palace and War Remnants Museum. At the museum, you'll get a glimpse into the impacts of the Vietnam War through exhibits and photographs. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh / Lotus Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh / Similar

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, you’ll be driven to My Tho, known as the floating market city of Vietnam. Start your tour with a visit to the Vinh Trang Pagoda, a stunning example of ornate Vietnamese architecture. Next, enjoy a relaxing boat ride along the village canals, where you can observe the traditional river life and vibrant local markets. Stop by Tortoise Islet, famous for its picturesque landscapes and cultural significance. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh / Lotus Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get transferred to the Airport for your flight back home.

name: Mauritius Offshore Romance Honeymoon Special
description: This premium 6-day honeymoon itinerary is meticulously structured to offer couples an intimate boutique coastal experience blended with iconic island sightseeing. Your romantic holiday features a 5-night stay at the beautifully designed Tropical Attitude Hotel, complete with everyday fresh hot breakfasts to kickstart your mornings. Cruise past the island's sparkling east coast on an unforgettable day excursion to the white-sand paradise of Ile aux Cerfs. Dive into cultural history with a full-day guided tour of North Island covering Port Louis and the Citadel Fort, alongside a comprehensive South Island loop to witness the Seven Coloured Earths at Chamarel. Handled with private round-trip airport transfers, this package guarantees a seamless and deeply romantic tropical escape.
shortDescription: Celebrate your union with an enchanting 6-day premium beachfront honeymoon on the romantic coastlines of Mauritius. Settle into the cozy, intimate charm of a boutique tropical resort featuring direct turquoise lagoon access and stunning ocean vistas. Bask in the sun with curated day trips to historical cities, scenic southern craters, and a spectacular speed-boat cruise to Ile aux Cerfs.
highlights: Stroll hand-in-hand along the tranquil, postcard-perfect beaches surrounding your boutique resort.
Try exciting optional water sports or swim in the crystal-clear shallow waters of Ile aux Cerfs.
Capture panoramic island photos from the top of the ancient Trou aux Cerfs volcanic crater.
Stand in awe before the majestic Chamarel Waterfall cascading down a sheer volcanic cliffside.
Visit the sacred crater lake of Grand Bassin (Ganga Talao) and its towering spiritual monuments.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mauritius
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Paradise Island! Upon your arrival at Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport, you will be transferred to your pre-booked hotel. Check-in and unwind in the serene surroundings of your hotel. You can also choose to head out on your own to explore the island, visiting the lush SSR Botanical Gardens, snorkeling at the vibrant Balaclava Marine Park, or relax at the Balaclava Beach. Later, head back to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
activities: Recommended Enrich your day with experiences Fill up your day with some of the highly recommended experiences.
itinerary.accommodation: Tropical Attitude Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Ile aux Cerfs Day Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will board your transfer and enjoy a full-day tour to the exquisite Île aux Cerfs. Cruise through the crystal-clear waters via speed boat to this stunning island known for its sandy beaches and vibrant lagoon. While you are at the island, you can enjoy various activities such as parasailing, tube ride, undersea walk (at extra cost), or simply bask in the sun on the beautiful beaches. Afterwards, you will be driven back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Tropical Attitude Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: North Island Day Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will embark on a tour of North part of the Paradise Island. Your tour will start with the capital, Port Louis, where you will explore significant sites including the Fort Adelaide (Citadel), and the Aapravasi Ghat Museum, a UNESCO World Heritage site that is a testament to the history of labor migration. After a full day of exploration, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: Kuanfu Ripe Black Tea Art Center & Museum
Le Port Ship Model Factory and Showroom
itinerary.accommodation: Tropical Attitude Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: South Island Day Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will be driven to the key attractions of the southern part of the island. Start at the Valley of Colors, an adventure park built on an ancient volcanic site, offering activities like zip-lining and quad biking (additional costs apply). Next, visit the Trou aux Cerfs, a dormant crater, and Grand Bassin, a sacred spot with a 108-foot Shiva statue and a holy lake. After this full day tour, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: La Vallee Des Couleurs Nature Park
itinerary.accommodation: Tropical Attitude Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Local Market Shopping Experience
itinerary.description: Today you will dedicate your day to exploring the local markets and shops of the island. Head out to the Central Market in Port Louis and shop for souvenirs, discover local handicrafts, and sample traditional street food. Spend the day strolling around the market and dive deep into the vibrant Mauritian culture. Afterwards, you will head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

name: Mauritius Offshore Romance | Journey to the Coastal Wonders
description: This meticulously planned 7-day romantic master itinerary is crafted for couples seeking the perfect balance of beachfront luxury and exotic ocean experiences. Settle into a 6-night majestic stay at the highly-rated Sunrise Attitude Hotel, where you will enjoy peaceful adults-only privacy and delicious hot breakfasts served daily by the shore. Sail away together on a magnificent full-day luxury catamaran cruise to the white sands of Ile aux Cerfs, complete with an onboard live BBQ lunch and unlimited drinks. The package also includes an unforgettable marine boat safari to spot wild dolphins and whales, a culture-rich North Island loop to Port Louis, and a dedicated South-West tour to see Chamarel’s volcanic sands. Handled with private round-trip airport transfers, this layout ensures a flawless honeymoon.
shortDescription: Celebrate your love story on the magical coastlines of Mauritius with this ultimate 7-day premium couple's retreat. Stay at the eco-chic, adults-only Sunrise Attitude Hotel right on the pristine Belle Mare lagoon. Indulge in an exclusive full-day catamaran cruise to Ile aux Cerfs with an onboard BBQ lunch, alongside thrilling dolphin and whale watching safaris.
highlights: Relax and lounge along the pristine, uncrowded powder-white sands of Belle Mare beach.
See exotic African wildlife, giant tortoises, and colorful birds up close inside Casela Park.
Witness the surreal geological phenomenon of the Seven Coloured Earth sand dunes at Chamarel.
Capture panoramic island photos from the rim of the ancient Trou aux Cerfs volcanic crater.
Visit the sacred crater lake of Grand Bassin (Ganga Talao) and its towering spiritual monuments.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mauritius | Welcome to the paradise on Earth
itinerary.description: Welcome to Mauritius! Upon arrival at the airport, you will be transferred to your hotel. Check-in and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can visit some attractions on your own, such as the historic Aapravasi Ghat, a UNESCO World Heritage site or the Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam Botanical Garden to see giant water lilies and other exotic plants. Alternatively, visit Rochester Falls to witness the rectangular-shaped lava rocks and natural swimming pool. Later, return to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Sunrise Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Mauritius South Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll be driven for a South West Mauritius tour, starting with a visit to Trou Aux Cerfs, a dormant volcanic crater formed nearly 2 million years ago. Then, head to Voiliers de L'Océan, a Model Ship Factory, followed by a visit to the sacred crater lake, Grand Bassin, where you can also visit the nearby Hindu temple. You'll also visit other sites including the Chamarel Waterfall, the highest in Mauritius and the unique Seven Coloured Earths formation. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Sunrise Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Casela World Of Adventures
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll be driven to explore the Casela World of Adventures, a popular wildlife and adventure park offering many activities. Enjoy wildlife encounters, including a safari tour and walking with lions under guided supervision. Feel the thrill of adventure activities like quad biking, zip-lining, and canoeing. Explore the park's four thematic worlds and walk through the bird aviary interacting with colorful bird species. After a fun-filled day, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Sunrise Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Ile aux Cerfs Tour by speedboat
itinerary.description: In the morning, board your transfer to the Trou d'Eau Douce port and embark on a speedboat ride to Île aux Cerfs, an island paradise known for its white sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters. En route, enjoy the views of the scenic Grand River South East waterfall. At Île aux Cerfs, you can relax on the idyllic beaches, swim in the calm lagoons, and explore the underwater world through snorkeling. End your tour with a barbecue lunch at Mangénie Island before being transferred back to the hotel.
activities: Full Day Ile Aux Cerfs Tour by Speedboat
itinerary.accommodation: Sunrise Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Whale and Dolphin Watching Boat Tour
itinerary.description: Get ready for a fun-filled day on our Whale and Dolphin Watching Boat Tour. Today, you’ll be driven to La Jetée Road, where you’ll embark on your ocean adventure. You can dive into the ocean and swim alongside wild dolphins or enjoy watching them from the comfort of the boat. Relax and enjoy the stunning views of the Mauritian coastline. You can even opt for snorkeling and witness the vibrant marine life before being transferred back to the hotel.
activities: Whale and Dolphin Watching Boat Tour
itinerary.accommodation: Sunrise Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Mauritius
itinerary.description: You can take this full day at your own pace, either relaxing at your hotel or exploring the island on your own. You can visit the bustling Central Market of Port Louis and the Blue Penny Museum to learn about the island's history. Take a stroll along the Caudan Waterfront, where you can indulge in café hopping or shopping. You can also relax on some of the pristine beaches of Mauritius, such as Grand Baie and Belle Mare. Afterward, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Sunrise Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to the charming island of Mauritius and get driven to the airport. Board your flight back home, taking with you a plethora of memories to cherish forever.

As your journey starts, admire the beauty of the turquoise waters of Mauritius. Upon reaching, enjoy activities like snorkelling and swimming (at your own expense) in the lagoons of the island. After that, take-in the views of the beautiful GRSE Waterfalls, surrounded by lush greenery all around, followed by a BBQ Lunch onboard. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Four Seasons Resort at Anahita / Similar

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Take the day to explore Mauritius at your own pace and see some of its famous spots. In the morning, you can explore Port Louis, a perfect blend of modernity and history or relax on the shores of Belle Mare, a beautiful white sand beach. Around noon, you can visit Chamarel, a unique geological formation in Mauritius. In the evening, you may see the Underwater Waterfall, Grand Bassin, and Chamarel Waterfalls, among other places. Afterwards, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Four Seasons Resort at Anahita / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Reflect on the wonderful experiences and beautiful memories made in Mauritius. Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the airport to board your flight back home.

name: The Residence: Royal 5-Star Beachfront Heritage Resort
description: This highly versatile 5-day master itinerary offers a completely seamless tropical holiday designed to match the travel style of families, couples, solo adventurers, and groups alike. Settle into a 6-night lavish stay at the prestigious 5-star The Residence Mauritius, beautifully positioned along the mile-long white sands of Belle Mare with nostalgic plantation-style elegance, complete with delicious hot breakfasts served fresh daily. To keep every traveler engaged, the package bundles high-octane island highlights including a full-day guided North Mauritius city loop to Port Louis and a scenic South-West scenic mountain tour to Chamarel. Zoom across the crystal lagoons on an exhilarating full-day speedboat cruise to Ile aux Cerfs, and set sail on an unforgettable wild dolphin and whale watching boat safari. Completed with round-trip airport transits, this layout promises a stress-free island dream.
shortDescription: Celebrate your love story on the magical coastlines of Mauritius with this ultimate 5-day Royal couple's retreat. Settle into the beautiful The Residence, offering majestic mountain backdrops and direct beach access. Sail away together on a magnificent full-day luxury catamaran cruise to Ile aux Cerfs with a live onboard BBQ lunch.
highlights: Relax along the pristine reef-protected lagoon and sandy beaches surrounding your premium resort.
Sip tropical drinks on the open deck of your luxury catamaran as you glide across turquoise shallow lagoons.
Witness the surreal geological phenomenon of the Seven Coloured Earth sand dunes at Chamarel.
Stand in awe before the majestic Chamarel Waterfall cascading down a sheer volcanic cliffside.
Capture panoramic island photos from the rim of the ancient Trou aux Cerfs volcanic crater.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mauritius | Welcome to the Paradise on Earth
itinerary.description: Welcome to the paradise! Upon arrival at the Mauritius airport, you'll be transferred to your resort. En route, you'll witness the captivating beauty of the vibrant streets that this island has to offer. After you reach the hotel, complete the check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Later, you can go to Mont Choisy Beach, stroll around the Mauritius National Botanical Garden or explore the local markets. Afterwards, return to your resort for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: The Residence Mauritius Or Similar

itinerary.title: Mauritius South West Day Tour | Explore Trou aux Cerfs
itinerary.description: Today, board your transfer for the South West Day Tour of Mauritius. Start with a visit to Trou Aux Cerfs, a dormant volcanic crater with the Island's panoramic views. Then, head to Mare Aux Vacoas, the largest reservoir and continue to Grand Bassin, a sacred lake with a giant Lord Shiva statue. Next, marvel at Alexandra Falls in the Black River Gorges followed by the La Vallée des Couleurs Nature Park. Conclude the day at Gris Gris Beach before transferring to your hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: La Vallee Des Couleurs Nature Park
itinerary.accommodation: The Residence Mauritius Or Similar

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Make the most of your leisure day in Mauritius with endless possibilities. You can relax, sunbathe or swim on pristine beaches like Belle Mare or Trou aux Biches. Explore local markets in Port Louis, indulge in water sports at Blue Bay or snorkel in the coral reefs of Ile aux Cerfs. Also, you can visit Casela Nature Park for serene walks amidst exotic plants and end your day with delicious Mauritian cuisine at a beachside restaurant before heading back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: The Residence Mauritius Or Similar

itinerary.title: Full-Day Catamaran Cruise to Île aux Cerfs with BBQ Lunch
itinerary.description: Today, get transferred to the pier to board the catamaran cruise to Île aux Cerfs. Firstly, you'll sail to the Grand River South East waterfall, where you can spot playful monkeys and enjoy snorkeling, swimming or sunbathing at the shore, followed by a BBQ lunch onboard. After that, sail to Ile aux Cerfs to relax on the white sandy beaches. Finally, enjoy Mauritian sega music and spot friendly dolphins during the sail back to the port. Later, transfer to your resort for an overnight stay.
activities: Full-Day Catamaran Cruise to Ile aux Cerfs with BBQ Lunch
itinerary.accommodation: The Residence Mauritius Or Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: In the morning, check-out from your hotel and board your transfer to the airport for your flight back home with a bag full of memories and souvenirs. This marks the end of your paradise island trip!

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mauritius | Leisure
itinerary.description: Welcome to Mauritius, also called as Mini India. Upon arrival at Mauritius Airport, get driven to your hotel for check-in. Rest for some time and spend your day at leisure. You can explore Casela Adventure Park, offering activities like ziplining, quad biking, and encounters with wildlife such as lions and giraffes. Next, you can visit Flic-en-Flac Beach, known for its white sands and experience local markets for shopping and savouring famous cuisines. Later, return to your hotel.

itinerary.title: North Mauritius Tour
itinerary.description: Discover the highlights of northern Mauritius on this immersive tour. Begin by boarding your transfer to Cap-Malheureux, explore exotic flora at SSR Botanic Garden, and enjoy panoramic views from Citadel Fort. Next, gain historical insights at Aapravasi Ghat, delve into local culture at Le Caudan Waterfront and Le Craft Market. Later, experience vibrant local life at Central Market and learn history at the Blue Penny Museum. Afterwards, explore Champ de Mars before getting driven to your hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Trou aux Biches Beachcomber Golf Resort & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: South West Mauritius
itinerary.description: Discover Mauritius cultural heritage on this full-day tour. Begin with getting driven to Trou Aux Cerfs, a volcanic crater with stunning views. Next, visit Mare aux Vacoas, the island's largest reservoir, and Grand Bassin, a sacred lake. Then, explore Alexandra Falls, encounter monkeys at Black River Gorges National Park, and marvel at Seven Colored Earth's vibrant dunes. Conclude your day at Gris Gris Beach for beautiful sea cliffs before boarding your transfer back to the hotel.
activities: La Vallee Des Couleurs Nature Park
itinerary.accommodation: Trou aux Biches Beachcomber Golf Resort & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Full-Day Catamaran Cruise to Île aux Cerfs
itinerary.description: Embark on a full-day catamaran cruise to Isle aux Cerfs. Start by boarding your transfer to Pointe Jerome Jetty and dive into the crystal-clear waters for snorkeling and swimming, or simply soak up the sun on beautiful beaches. Then, Explore the Grand River South East waterfalls for wildlife sightings and indulge in a delicious barbecue lunch onboard. Keep an eye out for playful dolphins and unwind to the rhythms of Mauritian sega music. Later, get driven back to your hotel in Mauritius.
itinerary.accommodation: Trou aux Biches Beachcomber Golf Resort & Spa / Similar

itinerary.title: Whale and Dolphin Watching Boat Tour
itinerary.description: Get ready for a fun-filled day on our Whale and Dolphin Watching Boat Tour. Today, you’ll be driven to La Jetée Road, where you’ll embark on your ocean adventure. You can dive into the ocean and swim alongside wild dolphins or enjoy watching them from the comfort of the boat. Relax and enjoy the stunning views of the Mauritian coastline. You can even opt for snorkeling and witness the vibrant marine life before being transferred back to the hotel.
activities: Whale and Dolphin Watching Boat Tour

itinerary.description: You can take this full day at your own pace, either relaxing at your hotel or exploring the island on your own. Take a stroll along the Caudan Waterfront, where you can indulge in café hopping or shopping. You can also relax on some of the pristine beaches of Mauritius, such as Grand Baie and Belle Mare. Afterward, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

Settle into a 5-night lavish stay at the beautiful 4-star Veranda Pointe aux Biches Hotel, uniquely designed around a "barefoot bliss" concept on the sun-kissed northern coast, featuring sandy floors and authentic Creole architecture, complete with delicious hot breakfasts served fresh daily. The island of Mauritius sets the perfect romantic backdrop for couples with its powdery white-sand beaches, swaying palm trees, and turquoise lagoons. Travelers can immerse themselves in stunning natural landscapes, relax by the ocean, or experience a wide range of exciting island activities, from thrilling water sports and coastal explorations to peaceful nature walks. This layout promises a stress-free, customizable tropical dream.
shortDescription: Celebrate your love story on the magical coastlines of Mauritius with this ultimate 6-day premium retreat.
highlights: Stroll hand-in-hand along the tranquil, postcard-perfect beaches surrounding your boutique resort.
Try exciting optional water sports or swim in the crystal-clear shallow waters of Ile aux Cerfs.
Capture panoramic island photos from the top of the ancient Trou aux Cerfs volcanic crater.
Stand in awe before the majestic Chamarel Waterfall cascading down a sheer volcanic cliffside.
Visit the sacred crater lake of Grand Bassin (Ganga Talao) and its towering spiritual monuments.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mauritius
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Paradise Island! Upon your arrival at Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport, you will be transferred to your pre-booked hotel. Check-in and unwind in the serene surroundings of your hotel. You can also choose to head out on your own to explore the island, visiting the lush SSR Botanical Gardens, snorkeling at the vibrant Balaclava Marine Park, or relax at the Balaclava Beach. Later, head back to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Ile aux Cerfs Day Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will board your transfer and enjoy a full-day tour to the exquisite Île aux Cerfs. Cruise through the crystal-clear waters via speed boat to this stunning island known for its sandy beaches and vibrant lagoon. While you are at the island, you can enjoy various activities such as parasailing, tube ride, undersea walk (at extra cost), or simply bask in the sun on the beautiful beaches. Afterwards, you will be driven back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Veranda Pointe aux Biches Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: North Island Day Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will embark on a tour of North part of the Paradise Island. Your tour will start with the capital, Port Louis, where you will explore significant sites including the Fort Adelaide (Citadel), and the Aapravasi Ghat Museum, a UNESCO World Heritage site that is a testament to the history of labor migration. After a full day of exploration, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.accommodation: Veranda Pointe aux Biches Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: South Island Day Tour
itinerary.description: In the morning, you will be driven to the key attractions of the southern part of the island. Start at the Valley of Colors, an adventure park built on an ancient volcanic site, offering activities like zip-lining and quad biking (additional costs apply). Next, visit the Trou aux Cerfs, a dormant crater, and Grand Bassin, a sacred spot with a 108-foot Shiva statue and a holy lake. After this full day tour, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
activities: La Vallee Des Couleurs Nature Park
itinerary.accommodation: Veranda Pointe aux Biches Hotel / Similar

itinerary.title: Local Market Shopping Experience
itinerary.description: Today you will dedicate your day to exploring the local markets and shops of the island. Head out to the Central Market in Port Louis and shop for souvenirs, discover local handicrafts, and sample traditional street food. Spend the day strolling around the market and dive deep into the vibrant Mauritian culture. Afterwards, you will head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

name: Coin de Mire Attitude : Superior Authentic Mauritian Boutique Resort
description: This highly versatile 7-day master itinerary offers a completely seamless tropical holiday designed to match the travel style of families, couples, solo adventurers, and groups alike. Settle into a 6-night lavish stay at the charming  superior Coin de Mire Attitude, beautifully situated on the northern coast overlooking the iconic majestic rock of Coin de Mire, complete with delicious hot breakfasts served fresh daily. The island of Mauritius sets the perfect romantic backdrop for couples with its powdery white-sand beaches, swaying palm trees, and turquoise lagoons. Travelers can immerse themselves in stunning natural landscapes, relax by the ocean, or experience a wide range of exciting island activities, from thrilling water sports and coastal explorations to peaceful nature walks. This layout promises a stress-free, customizable tropical dream.
shortDescription: Celebrate your love story on the magical coastlines of Mauritius with this ultimate 7-day premium retreat.
highlights: Relax and lounge along the pristine, uncrowded powder-white sands of Belle Mare beach.
See exotic African wildlife, giant tortoises, and colorful birds up close inside Casela Park.
Witness the surreal geological phenomenon of the Seven Coloured Earth sand dunes at Chamarel.
Capture panoramic island photos from the rim of the ancient Trou aux Cerfs volcanic crater.
Visit the sacred crater lake of Grand Bassin (Ganga Talao) and its towering spiritual monuments.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mauritius | Welcome to the paradise on Earth
itinerary.description: Welcome to Mauritius! Upon arrival at the airport, you will be transferred to your hotel. Check-in and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can visit some attractions on your own, such as the historic Aapravasi Ghat, a UNESCO World Heritage site or the Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam Botanical Garden to see giant water lilies and other exotic plants. Alternatively, visit Rochester Falls to witness the rectangular-shaped lava rocks and natural swimming pool. Later, return to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Coin de Mire Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Mauritius South Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll be driven for a South West Mauritius tour, starting with a visit to Trou Aux Cerfs, a dormant volcanic crater formed nearly 2 million years ago. Then, head to Voiliers de L'Océan, a Model Ship Factory, followed by a visit to the sacred crater lake, Grand Bassin, where you can also visit the nearby Hindu temple. You'll also visit other sites including the Chamarel Waterfall, the highest in Mauritius and the unique Seven Coloured Earths formation. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Coin de Mire Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Casela World Of Adventures
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll be driven to explore the Casela World of Adventures, a popular wildlife and adventure park offering many activities. Enjoy wildlife encounters, including a safari tour and walking with lions under guided supervision. Feel the thrill of adventure activities like quad biking, zip-lining, and canoeing. Explore the park's four thematic worlds and walk through the bird aviary interacting with colorful bird species. After a fun-filled day, get driven back to the hotel.
itinerary.accommodation: Coin de Mire Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Ile aux Cerfs Tour by speedboat
itinerary.description: In the morning, board your transfer to the Trou d'Eau Douce port and embark on a speedboat ride to Île aux Cerfs, an island paradise known for its white sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters. En route, enjoy the views of the scenic Grand River South East waterfall. At Île aux Cerfs, you can relax on the idyllic beaches, swim in the calm lagoons, and explore the underwater world through snorkeling. End your tour with a barbecue lunch at Mangénie Island before being transferred back to the hotel.
activities: Full Day Ile Aux Cerfs Tour by Speedboat
itinerary.accommodation: Coin de Mire Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Whale and Dolphin Watching Boat Tour
itinerary.description: Get ready for a fun-filled day on our Whale and Dolphin Watching Boat Tour. Today, you’ll be driven to La Jetée Road, where you’ll embark on your ocean adventure. You can dive into the ocean and swim alongside wild dolphins or enjoy watching them from the comfort of the boat. Relax and enjoy the stunning views of the Mauritian coastline. You can even opt for snorkeling and witness the vibrant marine life before being transferred back to the hotel.
activities: Whale and Dolphin Watching Boat Tour
itinerary.accommodation: Coin de Mire Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Mauritius
itinerary.description: You can take this full day at your own pace, either relaxing at your hotel or exploring the island on your own. You can visit the bustling Central Market of Port Louis and the Blue Penny Museum to learn about the island's history. Take a stroll along the Caudan Waterfront, where you can indulge in café hopping or shopping. You can also relax on some of the pristine beaches of Mauritius, such as Grand Baie and Belle Mare. Afterward, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Coin de Mire Attitude / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to the charming island of Mauritius and get driven to the airport. Board your flight back home, taking with you a plethora of memories to cherish forever.

name: Hotel Riu Palace Mauritius : Premium Beachfront Sanctuary
description: This highly versatile 4-day master itinerary offers a completely seamless tropical holiday designed to match the travel style of families, couples, solo adventurers, and groups alike. Settle into a 3-night lavish stay at the stunning 4-star superior Hotel Riu Palace Mauritius, an exclusive adults-only resort spectacularly situated right on the white sands of the Le Morne Peninsula at the foot of the iconic Le Morne Brabant mountain, complete with delicious hot breakfasts served fresh daily. The island of Mauritius sets the perfect romantic backdrop for couples with its powdery white-sand beaches, swaying palm trees, and turquoise lagoons. Travelers can immerse themselves in stunning natural landscapes, relax by the ocean, or experience a wide range of exciting island activities, from thrilling water sports and coastal explorations to peaceful nature walks. This layout promises a stress-free, customizable tropical dream.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Mauritius
itinerary.description: This highly versatile 7-day master itinerary offers a completely seamless tropical holiday designed to match the travel style of families, couples, solo adventurers, and groups alike. Settle into a 6-night lavish stay at the legendary 5-star Four Seasons Resort Mauritius at Anahita, beautifully nestled within a lush private sanctuary featuring individual luxury pool villas, complete with delicious hot breakfasts served fresh daily. To keep every traveler engaged, the package bundles high-octane island highlights including a full-day guided North Mauritius city loop to Port Louis and a scenic South-West scenic mountain tour to Chamarel. Zoom across the crystal lagoons on an exhilarating full-day speedboat cruise to Ile aux Cerfs, and set sail on an unforgettable wild dolphin and whale watching boat safari. Completed with round-trip airport transits, this layout promises a stress-free island dream.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Riu Palace Mauritius / Similar

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Ile Aux Cerf Island Catamaran Cruise
itinerary.description: From your hotel, board the transfer to Pointe Jerome Jetty to take the catamaran for Île aux Cerfs. As your journey starts, admire the beauty of the turquoise waters of Mauritius. Upon reaching, enjoy activities like snorkelling and swimming (at your own expense) in the lagoons of the island. After that, take-in the views of the beautiful GRSE Waterfalls, surrounded by lush greenery all around, followed by a BBQ Lunch onboard. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Riu Palace Mauritius / Similar

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Take the day to explore Mauritius at your own pace and see some of its famous spots. In the morning, you can explore Port Louis, a perfect blend of modernity and history or relax on the shores of Belle Mare, a beautiful white sand beach. Around noon, you can visit Chamarel, a unique geological formation in Mauritius. In the evening, you may see the Underwater Waterfall, Grand Bassin, and Chamarel Waterfalls, among other places. Afterwards, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel Riu Palace Mauritius / Similar

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Reflect on the wonderful experiences and beautiful memories made in Mauritius. Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the airport to board your flight back home.
